sea-tran-dynasty: 1226, Thăng Long (Hanoi): in the courtyard of a timber palace hall with curving tiled roofs and red lacquered pillars, a very young emperor seen small and from behind on a throne receives court officials in robes and black hats who bow in rows, guards with halberds and banners, a willow-lined lake beyond. Painted in the style of traditional Vietnamese silk painting, soft reds, golds and greens, formal composition.
sea-sukhothai: c. 1238, Sukhothai in northern Thailand: a new walled city with moats and earthen ramparts, laterite temples with lotus-bud stupas, and wooden houses on stilts; Thai warriors on elephants ride in through a gate as people celebrate with drums, offerings of flowers and fruit, rice paddies and green hills around. Painted in the style of Thai temple mural painting, flat red, gold and green, decorative figures, bright daylight.
sea-mongol-burma: 1287, Bagan on the Irrawaddy: seen from across the plain, the countless brick temples and golden stupas of the capital stand half-deserted, while Yuan cavalry in fur-trimmed helmets with banners ride in the distance and townspeople flee by boat down the wide river; dust and smoke on the horizon, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and light colour on silk, panoramic.
sea-ramkhamhaeng-inscription: c. 1292, Sukhothai: in a palace garden, a squared four-sided stone pillar stands on a platform beneath a sugar palm, its faces covered in rows of small indistinct carved marks, while a king seen small and from behind sits on a stone throne among monks and courtiers, lotus ponds and temple stupas around. Painted in the style of Thai temple mural painting, flat gold, red and green, serene; no legible writing.
sea-majapahit: 1293, the plains of East Java: Yuan soldiers in Mongol armour retreat in the distance to big Chinese junks on the river mouth, while Javanese warriors with krises, spears and shields under parasols advance, a brick-walled city with red-brick gateways rising behind; volcanoes and rice terraces. Painted in the style of East Javanese temple reliefs (Candi Penataran), soft volcanic-stone tones with gentle colour, figures small, no bloodshed.
sea-samudera-pasai: 1297, Samudera Pasai on the north coast of Sumatra: a quiet seaside town with wooden houses on stilts, palm trees and a small timber mosque with a tiered roof, a stone tomb with carved decorative patterns in a grassy cemetery, merchants from Arabia and India in long robes trading pepper on the beach, ships with lateen sails offshore. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, flat jewel-like colours, calm daylight; no legible script.
sea-palapa-oath: 1336, the Majapahit court at Trowulan: in a red-brick pavilion with carved wooden roofs, a minister in Javanese court dress, seen from behind, kneels and raises his hand in a solemn oath before the queen and courtiers, attendants with parasols and offerings; beyond the walls, a fleet of outrigger ships sets out across the sea. Painted in the style of East Javanese temple reliefs and Balinese Kamasan painting, warm reds and golds.
sea-ayutthaya: 1351, an island on the Chao Phraya River: workers build the first brick walls and temples of a new capital, timber houses on stilts and boats crowding the rivers that encircle the island, a king seen small on a white elephant beneath a tiered parasol inspecting the work, monks and courtiers nearby. Painted in the style of Thai temple mural painting, flat gold, red and green, decorative.
sea-lan-xang: 1353, Luang Prabang at the meeting of the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers: a great procession of elephants, hundreds of them with riders and parasols, crosses a green valley toward a wooden palace and temple roofs with sweeping eaves, Lao warriors and monks walking beside, forested mountains and morning mist. Painted in the style of Lao temple mural painting, gold and red on dark ground, flowing figures.
sea-nagarakretagama: 1365, the Majapahit court at Trowulan: a poet in Javanese court dress sits cross-legged on a mat writing on palm-leaf strips with a stylus, while in the background a royal procession with elephants, carts and banners winds through red-brick gateways and courtyards, rice fields and volcanoes beyond. Painted in the style of Balinese Kamasan wayang-style painting, flat reds, ochres and blues; palm-leaf marks indistinct.
sea-malacca-sultanate: c. 1400, the Malacca river mouth on the Malay peninsula: a prince with followers, seen small, rests under a tree near the beach, watching a mouse deer turn on his hunting dogs; behind them a small fishing village of stilt houses, boats on the strait and forested hills. Painted in the style of a Malay manuscript illumination with Persian influence, flat jewel-like colours, decorative vegetation, calm light.
sea-zheng-he-malacca: 1409, Malacca: enormous Ming treasure ships with many masts and red sails anchored in the strait, smaller junks unloading porcelain and silk at a wooden pier, a stockaded warehouse compound on the shore, Malay townspeople in sarongs and Chinese sailors in tunics trading under palm trees. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting with a woodblock-print influence, ink and colour on silk, detailed, bright day.
sea-malacca-islam: c. 1414, Malacca: a wooden mosque with a tiered pyramid roof beside the river, Malay townsfolk in sarongs and songkok-like caps gathering for prayer, merchants from Gujarat, Arabia and China at the busy waterfront with ships of many kinds, palm trees and the hill palace beyond. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting with Malay motifs, jewel-like colours, flat perspective.
sea-later-le: 1428, Thăng Long (Hanoi): on a green lake in the city, a golden turtle rises from the water as a boat with a royal figure, small and seen from behind, offers back a sword; on the shore, victorious soldiers with banners and townspeople in robes celebrate before timber palaces with tiled roofs. Painted in the style of traditional Vietnamese Đông Hồ woodblock prints, bright flat colours on textured paper, festive.
sea-siam-angkor: 1431, Angkor: seen from a distance, Siamese warriors on elephants and on foot pass through the stone face-tower gate of Angkor Thom, while Khmer families with carts and boats leave along the moat; temple towers rise above the forest, a dim smoky sky, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of Thai temple mural painting, flat red, gold and green, stylised figures, solemn mood.
sea-le-champa-1471: 1471, the Cham capital Vijaya near Bình Định: seen from far off, Đại Việt war junks and foot soldiers with banners surround a walled city with tall brick Cham temple towers on low hills, smoke rising over the walls, coastal plain and mountains beyond; figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of traditional Vietnamese ink and colour on silk, muted reds and greens, panoramic.
sea-portuguese-malacca: 1511, Malacca: Portuguese carracks and caravels with red crosses on their sails anchored in the strait, firing cannons in white puffs of smoke toward a wooden bridge and stockade on the river, while soldiers in steel helmets row ashore; the timber palace on the hill and stilt houses along the shore, all seen from a distance. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese engraving with watercolour tint, detailed ships, no bloodshed.
sea-mactan: 1521, the island of Mactan near Cebu: in shallow surf at low tide, many island warriors with spears, shields and kampilan swords in loincloths and headcloths advance along the reef, while a small group of European soldiers in steel helmets wade back toward rowing boats; three Spanish ships with square sails far off, palms on the shore, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century European engraving with watercolour tint, panoramic.
sea-toungoo-ayutthaya-1569: 1569, Ayutthaya: seen from a distance, a vast Burmese army with war elephants, cavalry and Portuguese-style cannons encircles the island city with its brick walls and gilded temple spires, river boats on the moat, smoke rising from the walls; all figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of Burmese temple mural painting, flat red, gold and green, stylised architecture.
sea-naresuan-elephant-duel: 1593, the plain at Nong Sarai: two great war elephants with gilded harnesses, each carrying a crowned rider holding a long-handled glaive, clash tusk to tusk amid swirling dust, armies of soldiers and other elephants watching from a distance, banners and parasols; figures small and stylised, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of Thai temple mural painting, flat red, gold and green with decorative dust clouds.
sea-batavia: 1619, the Ciliwung river mouth on Java: Dutch East India Company workers and soldiers in broad-brimmed hats and breeches build a stone fort with bastions and gabled warehouses beside a canal, tall-masted Dutch ships at anchor in the bay, Javanese labourers carrying timber, palm trees and smoke from the ruins of the old town. Painted in the style of a seventeenth-century Dutch topographical engraving with watercolour tint, detailed, clear light.
sea-first-anglo-burmese-war: 1824, Rangoon: British steam-and-sail warships on the wide river, red-coated soldiers and sepoys landing on the bank before the huge gilded Shwedagon Pagoda rising on its hill, wooden stockades and monastery roofs among palms; monsoon clouds, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted as an early nineteenth-century coloured aquatint, as in British military views of Burma, soft greens and golds. Fine line, wide river panorama.
sea-java-war: c. 1825-1830, the hills near Yogyakarta: a Javanese prince in a white turban and robe, seen small on a black horse, leads followers with spears and krises along a jungle ridge, while Dutch soldiers in shakos and blue coats march along a road below past rice terraces; Mount Merapi smoking behind. Painted as a nineteenth-century Javanese-Dutch painting in oil, romantic landscape, warm volcanic light, no bloodshed.
sea-chulalongkorn-reforms: c. 1880s, Bangkok: a new Western-style school building beside a gilded temple, with Thai pupils in uniforms of jackets and sarongs, a ministry building with columns, and a busy canal of boats and stilt houses; a king seen small and from behind riding in a carriage along a new road. Painted as a nineteenth-century Thai mural mixing traditional and Western perspective, gold, red and green, bright day.
sea-french-indochina: 1887, Saigon: a wide tree-lined boulevard with new French colonial buildings with shuttered windows, a red-brick cathedral under construction, horse carriages and rickshaws, French officials in white suits and pith helmets and Vietnamese townspeople in áo dài-style tunics and conical hats; the river with steamships and sampans behind. Painted as a nineteenth-century French illustrated newspaper engraving with light colour. Bright tropical daylight, many small figures.
sea-philippine-revolution: 1896, the hills near Manila: a gathering of Katipunan revolutionaries in white camisas and straw hats, carrying bolos and a red flag with a sun, raise their arms in a clearing among bamboo and palm trees; Spanish colonial churches and the walled city of Manila visible far away across the bay. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino oil history painting, warm tropical light, many small figures.
sea-sumpah-pemuda: 1928, Batavia (Jakarta): a hall in a colonial-style house with tall windows and ceiling fans, filled with young men and women in a mix of Western suits, batik and peci caps, seated on chairs listening to a speaker at a table, a violinist standing to one side; palm trees outside. Painted as a 1920s Indonesian watercolour illustration, soft warm tones, anonymous figures, hopeful afternoon light.
sea-malayan-campaign: 1941, Kota Bharu on the Kelantan coast: before dawn, Japanese landing craft approach a palm-fringed beach under rain and a dark sky, warships on the horizon, flashes of distant gunfire, soldiers wading ashore toward barbed wire and pillboxes, all seen from far out at sea. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, dark blues and greys, figures tiny, no bloodshed shown.
sea-indonesia-independence: 1945, Jakarta: in the small front garden of a house with a veranda, a modest gathering of people stands around a bamboo flagpole as a red-and-white flag is raised, a microphone on a stand, young men in white shirts and peci caps saluting; morning sun through trees. Painted as a 1940s Indonesian watercolour sketch, warm muted tones, figures small and anonymous, quiet solemn mood.
sea-dien-bien-phu: 1954, Điện Biên Phủ in the northwest highlands of Vietnam: a wide valley ringed by jungle mountains, with a French fortified airstrip, trenches and bunkers below, while on the steep slopes columns of porters push bicycles loaded with supplies and haul artillery up through the forest; monsoon clouds, smoke on the valley floor. Painted as a muted documentary woodcut print, dark greens and greys, figures small, no bloodshed shown.
sea-asean-founded: Bangkok, 8 August 1967: five foreign ministers in dark suits seated around a wooden table in a shaded Thai garden pavilion with tiered red-tiled roof, signing the ASEAN Declaration, seen from a moderate distance. In front stand exactly five small table flags on stands: Thailand (horizontal red-white-blue-white-red bands, no stars), Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Indonesia (red over white). No United States flag, no flag with stars-and-stripes canton. A gilded temple spire and tropical trees beside a canal behind. Muted documentary gouache painting, soft greens and golds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sea-fall-of-saigon: 1975, Saigon: seen from a distance down a wide tree-lined boulevard, a tank pushes through the iron gates of a modernist palace with a latticed façade, a helicopter rising from a rooftop far off, abandoned helmets and boots on the street, townspeople watching quietly; hazy April heat. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greys and greens, neutral and still, figures small.
sea-vietnam-reunified: 1976, Hanoi: the Ba Đình square with crowds of people in white shirts and conical hats gathered calmly around flower beds, red flags fluttering, a broad avenue lined with trees and yellow colonial buildings, bicycles parked in rows; soft summer morning light. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, warm yellows, reds and greens, figures small and anonymous, neutral tone.
sea-cambodian-vietnamese-war: 1979, Phnom Penh: a near-empty city boulevard with silent shophouses, overgrown gardens and a gilded temple roof, a few army trucks and soldiers in green far down the road, the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers shining beyond; dust and January light. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale ochres and greens, quiet and desolate mood, no people up close. Wide, empty composition.
sea-doi-moi: 1986-1990, Hanoi: a narrow street of tube houses in the Old Quarter coming to life with small private shops, vendors with baskets on shoulder poles, bicycles and a few motorbikes, new goods displayed on the pavement, lanterns and laundry overhead; morning light through trees. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, warm yellows and greens, everyday bustle, anonymous figures. Soft, gentle palette.
sea-people-power: 1986, EDSA highway in Quezon City: a huge peaceful crowd of people in yellow fills a wide avenue between military camps, nuns kneeling and praying, people offering flowers and food to soldiers on halted tanks, rosaries held up, an overpass and palm trees; all figures small and anonymous. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm yellows and greys, calm and hopeful tone.
sea-asian-financial-crisis: 1997, Bangkok: a skyline of unfinished concrete skyscrapers with idle cranes, empty office floors and construction stopped, a quiet elevated expressway, and in the foreground a street market of ordinary people selling goods; a hazy grey sky over the Chao Phraya river. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greys and dusty blues, still and sombre, figures anonymous. Wide panoramic skyline, quiet afternoon.
sea-fall-of-suharto: 1998, Jakarta: students in coloured university jackets sit and stand peacefully on the green roof and steps of the parliament building with its curved shell-shaped roof, a sea of figures seen from a distance, banners without lettering, the city skyline behind in the haze. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft blues and greens, calm, figures small and anonymous. Wide panoramic view.
sea-timor-leste-independence: 2002, Dili: a midnight independence ceremony on an open field by the sea, a large crowd under floodlights, traditional dancers in woven tais cloth, a new flag being raised on a tall pole, fireworks over the bay and the dark hills of Timor; all figures small and anonymous. Painted as a gentle documentary watercolour, deep blues with warm golden light, festive and peaceful.
sea-rcep: 2020, Hanoi: a modern conference hall with rows of empty seats and a long table holding small flags and leather-bound documents, large screens showing video conference windows of indistinct people, the city outside the windows with trees and a lake; calm, quiet, November light. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, cool greys and blues, neutral tone, no recognisable faces.
sea-myanmar-coup-2021: 2021, Naypyidaw, Myanmar: a vast, nearly empty multi-lane boulevard leading to an enormous parliament complex with tiered roofs, a few military vehicles parked at a distance under a pale February sky, gilded pagodas and dry plains on the horizon. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale greys and golds, quiet and tense stillness, no people up close, neutral. Wide, empty composition.
af-kerma-culture: c. 2500 BCE, Kerma above the Third Cataract of the Nile: a great mud-brick temple tower, the deffufa, rises over a town of round huts and rectangular houses within a defensive wall, cattle herders with long-horned cattle, potters making fine black-topped red pottery, the Nile and palms behind. Painted in the style of an ancient Egyptian tomb painting depicting Nubians, flat ochres and reds, profile figures.
af-thutmose-kerma: c. 1504 BCE, Kerma on the Nile: Egyptian soldiers with shields and spears and light chariots march along the riverbank while war boats with square sails sail upstream, the mud-brick temple and town of Kerma in the distance with smoke rising; palms, desert cliffs, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of an Egyptian New Kingdom temple relief with paint, flat profile figures, ochre and blue palette.
af-kush-napata: c. 785 BCE, Napata at Jebel Barkal: a flat-topped sandstone mountain with a pinnacle rises over a temple of Amun with columned halls and ram sphinxes, Kushite priests in leopard skins and courtiers in linen bringing offerings, the Nile with boats beyond. Painted in the style of an Egyptian-Nubian temple relief with paint, flat profile figures, ochre, blue and gold, bright desert light.
af-meroe: c. 300 BCE, Meroe on the Nile in Sudan: rows of small steep pyramids with temple porches stand on a desert ridge, while below in the town iron smelting furnaces send up smoke beside heaps of black slag, workers carry iron bars, camels and caravans loaded with ivory and goods; acacia trees. Painted in the style of Meroitic temple relief and painted pottery, flat ochres, black and red.
af-amanirenas-rome: c. 25 BCE, Qasr Ibrim above the Nile in Lower Nubia: a fortress on a cliff over the river, Kushite warriors with bows and spears facing Roman legionaries with rectangular shields camped on the riverbank below, a Kushite queen on horseback seen small and far off; desert hills, boats on the Nile, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a Meroitic temple relief blended with Roman fresco colour, ochre and red.
af-aksum-rises: c. 100 CE, Aksum in the Ethiopian highlands: tall carved granite stelae stand in a field beside stone palace buildings with recessed walls and timber beams, merchants with donkey caravans carrying ivory, incense and gold, Roman and Indian traders in different dress; green highlands and mountains beyond. Painted in the style of Ethiopian manuscript painting, bold flat colours, strong outlines, large eyes.
af-ezana-christianity: c. 330 CE, Aksum: before a stone palace and tall granite stelae, a king in a crown and robes, seen small and from behind, kneels with courtiers as a Syrian bishop in robes holds up a simple cross, highland farmers and soldiers looking on; mountains and blue sky. Painted in the style of Ethiopian Orthodox manuscript painting, bright red, yellow and green, bold outlines, flat composition.
af-aksum-meroe: c. 350 CE, Meroe on the Nile: an Aksumite army in white cloth with spears and round shields arrives along the river, passing the old, weathered pyramids and abandoned temples of Meroe, iron slag heaps and a half-deserted town; acacia trees and dry savannah, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of Ethiopian manuscript painting, bold flat colours, strong outlines.
af-hijra-abyssinia: c. 615 CE, the court of Aksum: a small group of travel-worn refugees in Arabian robes and head cloths, seen from behind, stand before a Christian king seated on a throne in a stone hall with crosses on the walls, courtiers and priests listening; through the doorway, highland hills and a church. No prophet is depicted. Painted in the style of Ethiopian manuscript painting, bright flat colours, strong outlines.
af-swahili-coast: c. 800 CE, the Lamu archipelago off Kenya: a coastal town of coral-stone houses and a small mosque among palms on a sandy shore, sewn-plank dhows with lateen sails anchored in the lagoon, Bantu-speaking traders and Arab and Persian merchants exchanging ivory, mangrove poles and beads for cloth and pottery. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, jewel-like flat colours, calm tropical light.
af-kilwa-sultanate: c. 957 CE, Kilwa Kisiwani off the coast of Tanzania: a small fleet of dhows arrives from the sea at a green island with a beach, a local chief and villagers meeting the newcomers in robes on the shore, gifts of cloth spread on mats, coral-stone foundations being laid, palms and mangroves. Painted in the style of a Persian manuscript miniature, bright flat colours, decorative waves and trees.
af-mapungubwe: c. 1075, Mapungubwe hill by the Limpopo river: a flat-topped sandstone hill with the ruler's houses on top, commoners' round thatched huts at its foot, herders with cattle, craftsmen working gold foil and ivory, traders carrying glass beads up the path, baobab trees and savannah. Painted in a style inspired by southern African rock art, ochre, white and black on warm stone ground, stylised figures.
af-almoravids-ghana: c. 1076, Koumbi Saleh on the edge of the Sahara: seen from a distance, a stone-built town with flat-roofed houses and a mosque, while veiled Berber camel riders in indigo robes with spears ride across the sandy plain toward it, dust rising; acacia trees, dry savannah, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting from the Maghreb, flat ochres and indigo.
af-great-zimbabwe: c. 1100-1300, Great Zimbabwe on the Zimbabwe plateau: Shona builders lay courses of dry-stone granite blocks to form high curving walls with chevron patterns, a conical stone tower inside the great enclosure, a hilltop complex among granite boulders, round thatched houses, cattle and people carrying gold and goods. Painted as a documentary watercolour in warm granite greys and greens, soft afternoon light.
af-kirina: c. 1235, the plain of Kirina in Mali: two armies of Mande horsemen and archers face each other across the savannah, horses with decorated bridles, warriors in cotton tunics with bows and spears, griots with drums and balafons on the side; baobabs and dust in the evening light, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in a style inspired by West African textile patterns and Mande ceramics, flat ochre, indigo and black.
af-kouroukan-fouga: c. 1236, Kangaba in Mali: under a great baobab tree, a vast assembly of Mande clan chiefs in cotton robes sits in a circle on the open plain, griots with koras and drums standing among them, horses tethered nearby, round mud houses with thatched roofs beyond. Painted in a style inspired by West African mud-cloth patterns and Mande art, flat ochre, black and cream, stylised figures.
af-mansa-musa-hajj: 1324, crossing the Sahara: a vast caravan of camels and thousands of people in white and indigo robes winds across golden dunes, with servants carrying golden staffs, camels laden with sacks of gold dust, a king seen small on horseback under a parasol; desert sky, a distant oasis. Painted in the style of the Catalan Atlas and a medieval Islamic manuscript painting, gold leaf and lapis blue, decorative.
af-djinguereber: c. 1327, Timbuktu: builders shape a great mosque of mud brick and plaster, with protruding wooden beams and a pyramidal minaret, workers on palm-wood scaffolding smoothing the walls with their hands, scholars in white robes and turbans passing by; sandy streets, flat-roofed houses, camels. Painted in the style of a West African Islamic manuscript painting, warm earth tones and ochres, bright desert light.
af-ibn-battuta-mali: 1352, the court of Mali at Niani: a traveller in Moroccan robes, seen from behind, stands at the edge of a royal audience, where the mansa sits under a silk canopy on a raised platform with gold-armed guards, griots with drums and balafons, courtiers in white robes and red-blue tunics; round houses and baobabs. Painted in the style of a medieval Islamic manuscript miniature, bright colours and gold.
af-zheng-he-africa: 1418, the coast of Malindi: huge Ming treasure ships with red sails anchored offshore beyond the reef, small boats ferrying Chinese sailors and goods to a Swahili coral-stone town with palms and a mosque, while a giraffe is led along the beach by a handler toward the ships; sandy beach, turquoise water. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting, ink and colour on silk, fine detail.
af-sonni-ali: c. 1464-1468, the Niger river near Timbuktu: Songhai cavalry on horses with decorated bridles and war canoes full of warriors approach the mud-brick city with its mosque minaret, while townspeople watch from flat roofs; dry savannah, the river shining, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in a style inspired by West African textile and Islamic manuscript art, warm ochres, indigo and black.
af-elmina: 1482, Elmina on the Gold Coast: Portuguese masons and sailors in doublets and caps build a white stone fortress with square towers on a rocky point by the sea, caravels at anchor, Akan traders in wrapped cloth bringing gold to the beach, canoes in the surf, palms and green hills. Painted in the style of a late fifteenth-century Portuguese illuminated chart and engraving, fine detail, bright colours.
af-askia: 1493, Gao on the Niger: a new ruler, seen small and from behind on horseback in white robes and turban, leads a procession of horsemen and scholars through the dusty streets toward a mud-brick mosque with a pyramidal tower, townspeople gathered, the river with boats beyond. Painted in a style inspired by West African Islamic manuscript art, warm ochres and indigo, flat composition.
af-da-gama-malindi: 1498, Malindi on the Kenyan coast: three Portuguese ships with square sails and red crosses anchored offshore, a small boat bringing a pilot in Arab robes and turban toward them, while on the shore the white coral-stone town with palms and a mosque and the sultan's people watch; turquoise water and reef. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese chart illustration, fine detail, bright colours.
af-kilwa-sacked: 1505, Mombasa: seen from the sea, Portuguese carracks and caravels with red crosses on their sails fire cannons in puffs of white smoke, smoke rising over a coral-stone town with palm trees and mosques, small boats of soldiers rowing ashore; the island harbour and green hills beyond, all figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese engraving with watercolour tint.
af-afonso-kongo: c. 1509, Mbanza Kongo on a hilltop in Angola: a stone church with a simple bell tower stands beside a royal enclosure of woven palm-fibre walls and thatched houses, Kongo nobles in raffia cloth and imported robes gathered outside, Portuguese priests in black and a king seen small and from behind under a parasol; green hills and palms. Painted as a sixteenth-century Portuguese chronicle illustration blended with Kongo raffia-textile patterns, earthy colours, calm daylight.
af-atlantic-slave-trade: c. 1526-1600, the bay of Luanda: Portuguese ships with square sails anchored offshore under a heavy grey sky, a whitewashed fort and church on the bluff, small boats on the water, and on the empty beach a long abandoned wooden pier and a few discarded shackles in the sand; the scene shown from afar, no people up close. Painted as a sombre sixteenth-century European engraving with muted watercolour tint, solemn mood.
af-tondibi: 1591, the plain of Tondibi near Gao on the Niger: Moroccan musketeers in red and white uniforms fire in lines, puffs of white smoke drifting, while Songhai cavalry and a herd of cattle driven ahead of their army scatter across dry savannah; acacias and the river in the distance, all figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a Moroccan Saadian manuscript miniature, flat ochre, red and indigo.
af-nzinga: 1624, Ndongo in the Angolan highlands: in a Portuguese colonial hall, a queen in a draped cloth and jewellery, seen from behind, sits on the back of a kneeling attendant to negotiate as an equal with a seated Portuguese governor, courtiers and soldiers watching; through the windows, palms and green hills. Painted in the style of a seventeenth-century European watercolour drawing of the Kongo and Angola region, warm earth tones.
af-cape-colony: 1652, Table Bay at the Cape of Good Hope: three Dutch ships at anchor, sailors and soldiers in broad-brimmed hats building a small earthen fort with wooden palisades and planting vegetable gardens, Khoikhoi herders with cattle watching from a distance; the flat-topped Table Mountain with its cloth of cloud above. Painted as a seventeenth-century Dutch topographical oil painting, clear light, detailed ships.
af-omani-fort-jesus: 1698, Mombasa: the Portuguese Fort Jesus, a massive coral-stone fortress with angular bastions on a rocky shore, besieged by Omani forces with dhows and small boats in the harbour, cannon smoke drifting over the walls, palms and the Swahili town around; all figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of a late seventeenth-century Portuguese engraving with watercolour tint, panoramic coastal view.
af-middle-passage: c. 1700s, the Niger Delta near Bonny: a dark sailing ship at anchor in a wide brown estuary among mangroves under a heavy grey sky, small canoes on the water, a trading post of wooden sheds on the bank, the scene distant and silent; no people shown up close, no suffering depicted directly. Painted as a sombre eighteenth-century engraving with muted wash, grey and brown tones, mournful atmosphere.
af-ashanti: 1701, Kumasi in the Ashanti forest: a great gathering of Akan chiefs in kente cloth under huge decorated umbrellas, drummers and horn blowers, a golden stool resting on its own cushion in the centre of a courtyard, palace buildings with raised clay walls decorated with patterns; tall forest trees behind. Painted in a style inspired by Akan goldweights and kente patterns, rich gold, green and red, festive.
af-dahomey-ouidah: 1727, Ouidah on the Slave Coast: Dahomey soldiers with muskets and cutlasses march into a coastal town of mud-walled compounds and European trading forts, the sea and sailing ships beyond the lagoon, smoke rising from the town, palm groves; all figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of Dahomey royal appliqué cloth, bright flat coloured shapes on a black ground.
af-xhosa-wars: 1779, the Fish River frontier in the Eastern Cape: across a winding river in hilly grassland, Xhosa herders with cattle and spears stand on one bank, while colonist horsemen in broad hats with muskets and ox wagons gather on the other; aloes and thorn trees, a dramatic sky, figures small, no bloodshed. Painted as an eighteenth-century documentary watercolour, soft ochres and greens.
af-freetown: 1792, the Sierra Leone river estuary: a fleet of sailing ships anchored in the bay below green forested mountains, Black settlers in European-style dress and bonnets coming ashore with tools and bundles, clearing land and building wooden houses under a great cotton tree; church service under its branches. Painted as an eighteenth-century British watercolour of a colonial settlement, soft greens and blues, hopeful light.
af-slave-trade-act: 1807-1810s, off Freetown in Sierra Leone: a British naval brig with full sails approaches a smaller sailing ship off the green coast, its crew in blue jackets lowering boats, the harbour town and mountains behind; calm sea, late afternoon light, figures small. Painted as an early nineteenth-century British marine watercolour, fine rigging detail, soft blues and greens. Wide calm seascape.
af-shaka: c. 1816-1820s, KwaBulawayo in Zululand: a great circular royal homestead of beehive-shaped grass huts surrounding a vast cattle enclosure, regiments of warriors with large cowhide shields of matching colours and short stabbing spears drilling in formation on the grassy hills; cattle herds, a ruler seen small and far off. Painted as a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour, warm grassland tones. Wide panoramic composition, clear morning.
af-great-trek: 1835-1838, the interior of South Africa: a long line of white-canvassed ox wagons drawn by teams of oxen rolls across the high veld grassland toward the Drakensberg mountains, Boer families in broad hats and bonnets walking alongside, horsemen with long guns, herds of sheep and cattle; a huge sky with towering clouds. Painted as a nineteenth-century South African documentary oil painting, warm golden light.
af-zanzibar-capital: 1840, Zanzibar Town: a waterfront of white coral-stone houses with carved wooden doors and balconies, the sultan's palace, Omani dhows and a few European ships in the harbour, porters carrying sacks of cloves and ivory tusks on the beach, clove plantations on green hills behind. Painted as a nineteenth-century watercolour by a travelling artist, bright turquoise sea, warm tropical light, many small figures.
af-kimberley-diamonds: c. 1870s, Kimberley: a vast open pit, the Big Hole, cut deep into the earth, its sides crowded with thousands of small mining claims, ropes and pulleys running up to wooden platforms on the rim, miners with picks and buckets, tents and tin shacks of a mining camp on the dry plain. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with light colour, intricate detail, harsh sunlight.
af-isandlwana: 1879, the slopes beneath the sphinx-like rock of Isandlwana in Zululand: seen from a great distance across grassy hills, a huge army of Zulu warriors with cowhide shields flows in horn-shaped formations around a British camp of white tents and wagons, puffs of rifle smoke; a partial eclipse darkens the sky, figures tiny, no bloodshed. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic panoramic composition.
af-berlin-conference: 1884, Berlin: in a grand wood-panelled hall with tall windows and chandeliers, a horseshoe-shaped table where diplomats in dark frock coats and uniforms with sashes sit around a large map of Africa spread on the table, seen from a distance; not a single African is present. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine cross-hatching, sombre formal light; the map has no legible words.
af-congo-free-state: c. 1890s, the lower Congo river near Boma: a sternwheel steamboat with a tall funnel pulls up to a wooden jetty and a colonial trading station with corrugated-iron roofs, heavy baskets of raw rubber stacked on the dock, guards in uniforms far off, the vast brown river and dense rainforest beyond. Painted as a sombre nineteenth-century engraving with muted watercolour wash, oppressive humid atmosphere, figures small.
af-fall-of-khartoum: 1885, Khartoum at the meeting of the Blue and White Niles: seen from across the river at dawn, a walled town with a palace and flat-roofed mud-brick houses under assault, tens of thousands of Mahdist fighters in patched white jibbas with spears and banners pouring through the walls, smoke rising; palms and the wide river. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, panoramic, figures tiny, no bloodshed.
af-witwatersrand: 1886, the Witwatersrand ridge: a new mining camp of tents and corrugated-iron shacks spreads across the high veld, prospectors in broad hats with picks and pans, ox wagons hauling machinery, the first stamp batteries and head-frames rising over the reef; dusty roads, a wide blue sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with light colour, bustling detail, harsh daylight.
af-adwa: 1896, the mountains around Adwa in Tigray: seen from a great height, a vast Ethiopian army of tens of thousands of warriors in white with round shields, rifles and banners, cavalry and an emperor's red parasol far off, flowing down rugged valleys toward an Italian column; jagged peaks, smoke, figures tiny, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of traditional Ethiopian church painting, bold flat colours, strong outlines, large eyes.
af-omdurman: 1898, the plain of Kerreri before Omdurman: seen from far off, long lines of Anglo-Egyptian infantry and gunboats on the Nile with puffs of smoke, while the Mahdist army in white jibbas with banners advances across the open desert plain; the domed tomb of the Mahdi on the horizon, figures tiny, no bloodshed. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, panoramic desert composition, harsh light.
af-second-boer-war: c. 1900, the high veld near Pretoria: a burned Boer farmhouse with a smouldering roof stands in an empty grassland under a grey sky, a column of British soldiers in khaki with horses moving away along a dusty road, and far off a camp of white bell tents behind barbed wire; no people up close. Painted as a sombre turn-of-the-century documentary watercolour, muted khaki and grey tones.
af-herero-nama: 1904, the Omaheke desert east of the Waterberg in Namibia: an endless, empty Kalahari sandveld of dry thorn bushes and red sand under a scorching white sky, a few abandoned cattle skulls and a dry water hole, the flat-topped Waterberg plateau far behind; a solemn memorial landscape, no people or bodies shown. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, pale reds and ochres, mournful stillness.
af-maji-maji: 1905, the Matumbi Hills in German East Africa: villagers gather around a sacred spring in a forest clearing, a spirit medium sprinkling water from a gourd onto the heads of men holding spears and millet stalks, cotton fields and a German boma fort with flag far below in the valley; green hills, heavy clouds. Painted as an early twentieth-century documentary watercolour, earthy greens and browns, figures small.
af-italo-ethiopian: 1935-1936, the highlands near Maychew in northern Ethiopia: Ethiopian warriors in white shammas with rifles and round shields stand on a rocky mountain ridge watching Italian aircraft fly overhead in a grey sky, smoke over a distant valley, a church on a hill with a cross; figures small, no bloodshed. Painted in the style of traditional Ethiopian church painting, bold flat colours, strong outlines.
af-apartheid: 1948, Pretoria: the long sandstone Union Buildings on their hill with terraced gardens, and in the foreground a quiet railway station with two separate entrances, benches and platforms, people in 1940s coats and hats walking to different doors; no legible signs, clear winter light. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft sandstone and grey tones, quiet and sombre, figures anonymous.
af-mau-mau: 1952, the forested slopes of Mount Kenya near Nyeri: dense bamboo forest and mist, a forest camp of shelters in the trees, and far below on the plains settler farms with neat fields and a British army truck on a red dirt road; snowy peak above the clouds. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, deep greens and reds, quiet, figures small and anonymous, no fighting shown.
af-ghana-independence: 1957, Accra: at midnight on the polo ground, a huge joyful crowd in kente cloth and white shirts celebrates under floodlights, a red, gold and green flag with a black star rising on a tall pole, drummers and dancers, palms against the night sky; a small distant figure on a platform. Painted as a 1950s West African watercolour illustration, bright festive colours, figures small and anonymous.
af-sharpeville: 1960, Sharpeville township: the empty dusty open ground outside a small police station with a wire fence, scattered hats, shoes and bicycles left lying on the earth under a pale March sky, rows of small brick houses beyond; a solemn memorial scene after the event, no people or bodies shown. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, grey and ochre washes, mournful stillness.
af-congo-crisis: 1960, Léopoldville (Kinshasa): a broad colonial boulevard by the vast Congo River, with jeeps of soldiers in blue UN helmets passing, white-painted aircraft at a distant airfield, townspeople watching from the roadside under palm trees, ferries on the river; a tense, overcast afternoon. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greys and greens, figures small and anonymous, no fighting shown. Wide river panorama.
af-oau: 1963, Addis Ababa: the modern Africa Hall with tall stained-glass windows of abstract colour and a large conference chamber, delegates in suits and national robes seated at long tables, seen from the back of the hall; outside, eucalyptus trees and the city on green highlands. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, warm golds and blues, calm and dignified, figures anonymous.
af-nigerian-civil-war: 1967-1970, the hills around Enugu in southeastern Nigeria: a quiet green landscape of palm groves and red earth roads, a deserted village of mud-walled houses with tin roofs, a relief aircraft flying low over the forest toward a makeshift airstrip, smoke on the far horizon; no people up close, no suffering shown. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, greens and red-browns, quiet mood.
af-soweto: 1976, Soweto: a long, wide dusty township road lined with rows of small identical brick houses, a crowd of schoolchildren in uniforms walking together in the distance carrying blank placards, smoke rising faintly over far-off rooftops, a winter sky; all figures small and anonymous, no violence shown. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, ochre and grey washes, solemn mood. Wide street perspective.
af-mandela-release: 1990, near Paarl in the Western Cape: a long road leading from a prison gate through green vineyards toward the granite domes of the Paarl mountains, a vast crowd waving flags lining the road in the distance, cars and photographers; a tiny figure walking with a raised fist far off, warm February sunlight. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greens and golds, hopeful, figures small and anonymous.
af-mandela-president: 1994, South Africa: long patient queues of voters of every race and age, many in hats and colourful clothes, snaking across a grassy field to a small school used as a polling station, with the sandstone Union Buildings of Pretoria on their hill far behind; bright autumn sunlight. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm golds and greens, hopeful and calm, figures small and anonymous.
xian-to-xu: 196 CE, Xu (Xuchang): a small, weary imperial procession of ox-drawn carriages with tattered canopies and banners arrives at the rammed-earth walls of a modest county town, met by ranks of armoured soldiers and officials in black robes and jin caps bowing at the gate towers; a young emperor's carriage is seen from behind, a broad North China plain under autumn light. Rendered as an Eastern Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing, carriages and horsemen in procession, grey ink on paper.
cao-tuntian: 196 CE, near Xu (Xuchang): wide flat fields on an abandoned plain are being ploughed again by soldier-farmers in short tunics and leggings with ox-drawn iron ploughs, refugees sowing millet behind them, weapons stacked by a reed hut, stacked granaries and a watchtower of a military colony in the distance, a supervising officer on horseback. Painted in the manner of an Eastern Han tomb mural of farming scenes, red and black outlines on a pale plaster ground, simple lively figures.
yuan-shu-emperor: 197 CE, Shouchun on the Huai River plain: inside a timber-pillared hall with a hipped tiled roof, a lone figure seen from behind ascends a dais beneath a canopy while a few officials in black robes and tall caps kneel uneasily on mats; a lacquered box holding a jade seal sits on a low table, rain clouds gathering over the city walls outside. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural, ink outlines with red and ochre washes on plaster.
battle-of-wancheng: 197 CE, Wan (Nanyang): night at a military camp outside a walled city, tents and palisades suddenly lit by torches as soldiers pour from the city gate in a surprise attack; small figures of guards fight a rearguard at the camp gate, horsemen without stirrups gallop away along a river, smoke and flames rising into the dark sky, seen from a distance. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of battle and pursuit, dense grey-black ink texture.
battle-of-xiapi: 198 CE, Xiapi (Pizhou): a rammed-earth walled city stands in a sheet of muddy floodwater after besiegers have breached river dykes and diverted the Si and Yi rivers; soldiers' tents line raised embankments, boats ferry troops, defenders peer from half-submerged gate towers, grey winter sky. Seen from high above, small figures only. Painted in the manner of an Eastern Han tomb mural, earthy ochre, black and faded red on plaster.
battle-of-yijing: 199 CE, Yijing in Hebei: a single continuous view across a flat winter plain of a fortress of many tall rammed-earth towers on mounds ringed by ditches; besiegers' soldiers gather at timber-framed tunnel mouths at the foot of the mounds while one great tower leans and collapses in a cloud of dust, smoke rising from the highest keep. Dry reeds, distant cavalry, small figures, no gore. One unbroken scene without borders or bands. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing, grey ink.
girdle-edict-plot: 200 CE, Xu (Xuchang): a dim inner chamber in a Han mansion lit by an oil lamp; several officials in dark robes and jin caps kneel close together on mats around a low lacquer table, one holding a silk sash with a hidden strip of silk slipped from its lining, a servant watching at a lattice door. Quiet, conspiratorial mood, faces turned away. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural, fluid black outlines with red and ochre on plaster.
battle-of-baima: 200 CE, Baima on the south bank of the Yellow River: a vast army camp with banners and chariots spread across a plain, and a single armoured horseman with a long blade charging through the ranks toward a commander's parasol, riding without stirrups, dust everywhere; the broad brown river and ferry boats behind. Small figures, seen from a distance. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of cavalry battle, bold silhouettes in grey ink.
death-of-sun-ce: 200 CE, hills near Dantu (Zhenjiang): a hunting party in a misty autumn forest beside the Yangtze, a young lord on a galloping horse ahead of his retinue, three hidden figures with bows emerging from the undergrowth, startled deer bounding away, the hunters far in the distance. No wounds shown. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural of a hunt, dynamic red and black brushlines on pale plaster.
death-of-yuan-shao: 202 CE, Ye (Hebei): a large walled northern city in late spring; inside a mourning hall draped in white hemp, two groups of officials and armoured retainers stand apart on opposite sides of an empty dais, eyeing each other, banners of two factions in the courtyard. Small figures, no faces in close-up. Painted in the manner of an Eastern Han tomb mural, ink line and mineral red, ochre and white on plaster.
capture-of-ye: 204 CE, Ye: a great square walled city surrounded by a long newly dug trench, the Zhang River diverted into it so that water laps the walls; besieging camps and earthworks encircle the city, and a gate finally opens as soldiers stream in under banners, the plain grey and flooded in late summer. High distant view. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing, ordered rows of soldiers and city walls, grey ink.
shanghan-lun: 205 CE, Nanyang: a physician in a plain hemp robe and cap sits at a low table in a modest tiled house, writing on bamboo slips with a brush, bundles of slips tied with cord beside him, dried herbs hanging, a pottery stove and decoction pot steaming, a patient waiting in the courtyard; a quiet village in a time of epidemic. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural of daily life, soft ochre and red lines on plaster.
white-wolf-mountain: 207 CE, White Wolf Mountain (Kazuo, Liaoning): a bare rocky ridge above a dry steppe valley as Han cavalry without stirrups charge downhill into a disordered horde of Wuhuan horsemen in felt coats and caps, wagons and yurts scattered below, banners streaming in a strong wind, clouds of dust. Distant panoramic view. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of horsemen in combat, rhythmic grey-black forms.
longzhong-plan: 207 CE, Longzhong near Xiangyang: winter snow lies on wooded hills around a thatched cottage beside a bamboo grove; three horses wait at a wicker gate while visitors in dark robes stand in the yard, and inside two figures seen from behind sit across a low table with a map drawn on silk. Quiet, cold morning. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
battle-of-changban: 208 CE, Changban (Dangyang, Hubei): a long column of refugees with carts, oxen and bundles flees across a green plain, pursued by distant cavalry; a lone armoured rider gallops through the chaos carrying a small child wrapped against his chest, and on a wooden bridge over a stream a single warrior with a spear stands firm before halted horsemen. Small figures. Rendered as an Eastern Han tomb mural, quick ink and earthy red.
zhou-yu-dies: 210 CE, Baqiu (Yueyang) on Dongting Lake: a fleet of Han river warships with towered decks and sails rides at anchor, pennants lowered, while on the shore soldiers in mourning white stand in ranks outside a camp; a funeral boat with a canopied coffin prepares to sail east under an overcast sky. Wide lake view. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine flowing line, ink and pale mineral colour on aged silk.
seek-talent-edict: 210 CE, Ye: in a pillared hall of a Han palace, a scribe in a black robe reads aloud from an unrolled bamboo-slip document while officials kneel in rows on mats, and outside the gate messengers on horseback ride off with sealed bundles of slips to distant commanderies. Formal, orderly scene, small figures. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of a court audience and mounted messengers, grey ink.
bronze-sparrow-terrace: 210 CE, Ye: a towering terrace of rammed earth faced with timber halls rises above the city's northwest wall, crowned by a pavilion with a great bronze bird on its ridge; on the high balcony a gathering of poets in wide-sleeved robes sit with wine cups, brushes and zithers, the Zhang River and plain far below at sunset. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural, ink, red and malachite on plaster.
battle-of-tong-pass: 211 CE, Tong Pass: the great bend of the Yellow River where it meets the Wei, loess cliffs and a fortified gate in the gorge; across the river two armies face each other, northwestern horsemen in fur-trimmed coats and Han infantry with crossbows, and between them two mounted commanders meet alone mid-field to talk while their armies watch. Distant view. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing, grey ink.
duke-of-wei: 213 CE, Ye: a grand investiture in a palace courtyard; envoys from the Han court present a canopied carriage, ceremonial axes, red-lacquered bows, musical bells and tall banners, the gifts arranged in rows, while a figure seen from behind receives them on the steps, officials bowing in black robes and tall caps. Rendered as an Eastern Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of a ceremonial procession, crisp grey-black ink forms.
battle-of-ruxu-213: 213 CE, Ruxu on the Yangtze: a fortified river mouth with earthen walls and docks, Wu warships with towered decks and oars rowing out in tight formation, while on a northern hill a commander's camp with banners looks down on the fleet; misty river light, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and light colour on aged silk.
liu-bei-takes-yi: 214 CE, Chengdu: the walls of a prosperous city in the Sichuan basin, green paddy fields around it and misty mountains behind; the gate opens and a lord in plain robes leads officials out on foot to surrender to an army camped before the walls, banners lowered, townspeople watching from the ramparts. Small figures. Rendered as an Eastern Han tomb mural from Sichuan, warm red and ochre lines on pale plaster.
xiaoyao-ford: 215 CE, Xiaoyao Ford near Hefei: a small band of armoured cavalry bursts across a damaged wooden bridge over a river, scattering a much larger army with banners and parasols; a lord on horseback leaps a broken span as guards close around him, reeds and willows along the banks, dust and spray. Small figures, wide view. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and soft colour on silk.
cao-cao-hanzhong: 215 CE, Yangping Pass (Mian County): a narrow mountain pass in the Qinling with timber forts on steep slopes; soldiers climb the ridges at dawn and banners rise over the captured stockade, while below in the Han River valley a procession of Daoist officials in plain robes walks out from the valley to submit. Distant panoramic view. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of mountains and soldiers, grey ink.
xiang-river-boundary: 215 CE, Yiyang on the Xiang River (Hunan): two armies camped on opposite banks of a wide river, and in the middle a meeting place where two commanders, each with a single sword at his side, sit facing each other across a mat while their guards stand a hundred paces back; green hills and boats on the river. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, gossamer line, ink and pale colour.
jianan-plague: 217 CE, Ye: a hushed city under a grey winter sky, shuttered timber houses and empty streets, white mourning banners hanging from gates, a few figures in white hemp mourning robes carrying a draped coffin toward the city gate, a lone poet in a dark robe watching from a terrace. No corpses or illness shown. Painted as an Eastern Han tomb mural, muted ochre, grey and white on plaster.
battle-of-dingjun: 219 CE, Mount Dingjun (Mian County): an old general with a white beard leads troops charging down a steep wooded slope with drums beating, toward an enemy camp in the valley below, banners and spears tilting, the Han River glinting beyond. Small figures, no gore, seen from a distance. Rendered as a Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of a downhill charge, strong diagonal composition, grey ink.
fancheng: 219 CE, Fancheng on the Han River: autumn floods have turned the valley into a lake; a walled city stands in the water, an enemy relief camp lies swamped, soldiers cling to hilltops, and war boats with towered decks row among them under heavy rain clouds. Seen from far above, small figures only. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and grey-blue washes on silk.
king-of-hanzhong: 219 CE, Mianyang (Mian County): an earthen altar on the bank of the Han River surrounded by banners and ranks of armoured soldiers; officials in black robes and tall caps bow in rows as a lord in ceremonial robes, seen from behind, ascends the altar steps, the Qinling mountains rising beyond. Rendered as an Eastern Han pictorial stone-relief rubbing of a ceremony, grey-black ink.
nine-rank-system: 220 CE, Luoyang: in a provincial office hall, a local assessor in a black gauze cap sits at a low table with a register of bamboo slips, ranks of candidates in scholars' robes waiting in a courtyard, clerks sorting slips into nine bundles on a rack. Quiet bureaucratic scene, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
death-of-cao-cao: 220 CE, Luoyang: early spring dawn over a palace complex of timber halls and tiled roofs; the courtyard is filled with officials and guards in white mourning, and a long funeral procession with a canopied hearse and banners sets out through the city gate toward the north, toward a modest tomb near Ye. Small figures, seen from above. Rendered as an Eastern Han tomb mural, ink and red ochre on plaster.
zhang-fei-assassinated: 221 CE, Langzhong: night at a riverside military camp in northern Sichuan; a tent lit from within, and two shadowy officers slip away from it to a small boat on the Jialing River, rowing downstream into the dark toward the east. Nothing violent shown, only their flight. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and dark blue washes on silk.
sun-quan-king-of-wu: 221 CE, Wuchang (Ezhou) on the Yangtze: a new riverside city with timber walls and halls on a hill above the river; envoys from the north in black robes present a seal and investiture scroll at a gate, while war boats crowd the harbour below and soldiers stand in ranks. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale mineral colour on silk.
battle-of-dongkou: 222 CE, Dongkou on the Yangtze: a storm whips the wide river, and Wu boats tied together in a line are torn loose and driven toward the northern shore where Wei camps stand; fleets clash in the waves, sails and banners tangle, rain slanting across the scene. Distant view, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, ink and grey washes on aged silk.
baidi-entrust: 223 CE, Baidicheng (Fengjie): a small walled fortress on a hill above the mouth of the Qutang Gorge, cliffs rising from the Yangtze; inside a dim hall a dying lord lies on a couch, seen from behind, while a minister in a robe kneels beside him and a young prince stands by. Quiet, sorrowful light. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and soft colour on aged silk.
deng-zhi-mission-wu: 223 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): an envoy in a black robe and cap stands before a raised hall, bowing, while a court of Wu officials in wide-sleeved robes listens; outside, the envoy's small boat waits at a riverside pier on the Yangtze, the green Zhongshan hills behind the city. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and light colour on aged silk.
southern-campaign: 225 CE, Nanzhong (Yunnan): a column of Shu soldiers with banners and pack horses crosses a rope bridge over a deep gorge in green subtropical mountains, while on a meadow below local chiefs in feathered headdresses and wrapped cloth sit at a feast with a robed minister, bronze drums beside them. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and mineral green on silk.
cao-pi-guangling: 225 CE, Guangling (Yangzhou): winter on the north bank of the Yangtze; a huge fleet of Wei towered warships moored in long lines, and on the bank a figure in imperial robes, seen from behind, stands under a parasol gazing across the vast grey river toward distant walls and beacons on the southern shore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
cao-rui-succeeds: 226 CE, Luoyang: a palace hall where a young emperor in a dark robe sits on a dais, small and seen from a distance, while four senior ministers and generals in court robes stand before him in a row and officials kneel behind, white mourning banners hung at the doors. Formal, subdued scene. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and mineral red on aged silk.
wu-takes-jiaozhou: 226 CE, Longbian (Hanoi) in the Red River delta: Wu troops with banners land from river boats beside a walled town among banana palms and rice paddies, while a local lord's retinue in white robes walks out to submit; elephants and water buffalo in the fields, humid hazy light. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and soft green and ochre on silk.
chu-shi-biao: 227 CE, Chengdu: in a quiet palace hall a chancellor in plain robes and a scholar's cap kneels before a young emperor's dais, presenting an unrolled bamboo-slip memorial; outside the windows armies gather in the courtyard with banners for a northern campaign. Figures small and seen from behind. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale mineral colour on silk.
battle-of-shiting: 228 CE, Shiting (Qianshan, Anhui): a narrow wooded valley between hills where a long Wei army column is ambushed from three sides; Wu troops pour from the forest, wagons and supplies abandoned on the road, a retreating column fleeing north. Wide view, small figures, no gore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine flowing line, ink and soft colour on aged silk.
jieting: 228 CE, Jieting (Qin'an, Gansu): a bare loess hill with a Shu camp on its summit, surrounded in the valley below by Wei soldiers who have cut off the stream at its foot; thirsty troops on the hilltop look down, smoke rising, dry summer heat. Distant panoramic view. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and ochre washes on aged silk.
sima-yi-meng-da: 228 CE, Xincheng (Fang County, Hubei): a fast-moving army column marches day and night through wooded mountains, then appears before a small walled city in a valley with a river on three sides; siege ladders go up at dawn as defenders open a gate. Distant view. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on silk.
siege-of-chencang: 228 CE, Chencang (Baoji): winter siege of a small fortress on the Wei River; besiegers bring up wheeled ladders and tall siege towers, and defenders on the walls hurl stones and fire arrows, setting a ladder alight, snow on the Qinling peaks behind. Distant view, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and touches of red on aged silk.
sun-quan-emperor: 229 CE, Wuchang: an altar on a hill outside the city where a ruler in imperial robes, seen from behind, makes an offering to Heaven as officials kneel in rows, banners of yellow and red around the altar, and the Yangtze below crowded with Wu warships. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, gossamer line, ink and mineral colour on aged silk.
wu-capital-jianye: 229 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): a fleet of river boats loaded with officials, chests and court furnishings arrives at a new capital on the south bank of the Yangtze; timber palace halls stand on the slopes, the Qinhuai river and Stone City cliff beside them, workers building walls. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and soft blue-green on silk.
shu-takes-wudu-yinping: 229 CE, Wudu (Longnan, Gansu): a Shu army with banners advances through steep mountain valleys and terraced slopes, crossing a timber plank road along a cliff, while an enemy column of Wei cavalry withdraws over a distant snowy ridge. Small figures, panoramic mountain landscape. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and mineral green on aged silk.
wei-wen-yizhou: 230 CE, the Taiwan Strait: a fleet of Wu seagoing junks with matting sails crosses a wide sea toward a green mountainous island, small boats landing soldiers on a beach where islanders in simple wrapped clothing watch from the forest edge. Wide seascape, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and blue-green washes on silk.
ziwu-campaign: 230 CE, Ziwu Valley in the Qinling: torrential rain over steep forested mountains; a Wei army column stalled on a washed-out mountain road, wooden plank walkways broken and swept away by a swollen torrent, soldiers sheltering under oilcloth, wagons stuck in mud. Small figures, grey misty scene. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and grey washes on aged silk.
battle-of-mount-qi: 231 CE, Mount Qi (Li County, Gansu): Shu armies encircle a hilltop fortress in rolling loess country; later a retreating column passes through a narrow wooded defile at Mumen, where archers hidden on both cliffs loose volleys of crossbow bolts down on pursuing Wei cavalry. Distant view, small figures, no gore. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick from the Hexi corridor, quick ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
wooden-ox: 231 CE, Qinling mountains near Hanzhong: a line of soldiers pushes wooden wheelbarrow-like carts loaded with sacks of grain along a cliffside plank road built on beams driven into the rock, a river roaring in the gorge far below, pine-clad peaks and mist around. Small figures, clear morning light. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale mineral green on aged silk.
cao-zhi-dies: 232 CE, Chen (Huaiyang, Henan): a lonely prince's residence beside a reed-fringed lake in late autumn; a poet in a wide-sleeved robe, seen from behind, sits on a veranda with a brush and unrolled silk, gazing at mist over the water where the faint figure of a river goddess drifts on the waves. Painted in the style of the Nymph of the Luo River handscroll attributed to Gu Kaizhi, fine line, soft mineral colour on silk.
gongsun-yuan-betrays-wu: 233 CE, Xiangping (Liaoyang): a walled northeastern city on a cold plain; a Wu delegation's ships have come up the Liao River with gifts of gold, silk and jewels laid out in a courtyard, while armed guards close the gates around them and a messenger rides out westward with sealed boxes. Nothing violent shown. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick, quick ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
battle-of-hefei-234: 234 CE, Hefei New City: a compact fortress on raised ground away from the river, besieged by Wu troops with ladders and banners in early summer; in the distance a great relief army with imperial parasols and banners approaches over the plain, and the besiegers begin to withdraw to their boats. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
emperor-xian-dies: 234 CE, Shanyang (Jiaozuo): a stately funeral procession with a canopied hearse drawn by horses, banners and officials in white mourning, winds through rural fields toward a burial mound at the foot of the Taihang mountains; villagers stand along the road with heads bowed. Small figures, soft grey spring light. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick, ink outlines with ochre and red washes on pale ground.
wei-yan-killed: 234 CE, Qinling mountains near Nanzheng: a Shu army retreating south through gorges after its chancellor's death, carrying a covered coffin; ahead of them a section of timber plank road along the cliff is on fire, smoke rising up the gorge, while a small party of horsemen gallops away down the valley. Distant view, no gore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and grey-blue washes.
ma-jun-chariot: 235 CE, Luoyang: in a palace courtyard an engineer in a scholar's robe demonstrates a two-wheeled wooden carriage topped by a small carved figure whose outstretched arm always points south, its gear train visible through an open panel; nearby a treadle silk loom and a square-pallet chain pump lifting water into a garden channel, officials watching. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and light colour on silk.
liaodong-campaign: 238 CE, Xiangping (Liaoyang): autumn rains have flooded the Liao River plain; a Wei army entrenched around a walled city builds earthen mounds and siege towers, catapults hurling stones at the walls, then the rains stop and the city gates are breached. Distant panoramic view, small figures. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick from the Hexi corridor, ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
himiko-envoy: 239 CE, Luoyang: envoys from Wa in simple wrapped garments and bound hair kneel in a Wei palace courtyard, presenting lengths of patterned cloth and local gifts, while officials in black robes lay out the emperor's return gifts on mats: bronze mirrors, lengths of brocade, swords and a gold seal on a purple cord. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and mineral colour on aged silk.
cao-fang-regency: 239 CE, Luoyang: a palace hall where a small boy emperor sits on a high dais under a canopy, and two senior figures in court robes stand on either side of the steps facing the assembly, officials kneeling in rows, white mourning hangings for the late emperor. Formal, symmetrical composition, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and mineral red and green on silk.
deng-ai-tuntian: 241 CE, the Huai River plain near Shouchun: soldiers with spades and baskets dig long irrigation canals across flat fields, others plant rice and sow wheat, granary buildings and a military colony with watchtowers in the distance, an officer on horseback inspecting. Broad sunny landscape. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick from Jiayuguan showing farming and ploughing, quick ink outlines with red and ochre on pale ground.
battle-of-quebei: 241 CE, Quebei reservoir (Shou County, Anhui): a large reservoir with earthen dykes on the Huai plain; Wu soldiers try to break the dykes while Wei troops counterattack along the embankment, banners and spears clashing, water spilling through a breach. Distant view, small figures, no gore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
two-palaces-dispute: 242 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): two separate palace compounds side by side within the city walls, each with its own gate, courtyard and cluster of officials in wide-sleeved robes gathering and whispering; an old ruler seen from behind watches from a high hall between them. Tense, divided composition, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and mineral colour on silk.
zhuya-expedition: 242 CE, Hainan Island: a Wu fleet of junks with matting sails anchors off a tropical coast lined with coconut palms; soldiers wade ashore with banners and supplies while local Li people watch from wooded hills, thatched stilt houses among the trees. Wide seascape, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and blue-green washes on aged silk.
wei-goguryeo: 244 CE, Hwando (Ji'an, on the Yalu River): a Goguryeo mountain fortress with stone walls following the ridges above a river valley; Wei soldiers climb the slopes and banners rise over the walls while smoke drifts from the town, and a small party of horsemen flees into forested mountains to the northeast. Distant view. Painted in the style of a Goguryeo tomb mural, red and black outlines, lively horsemen, ochre ground.
battle-of-xingshi: 244 CE, Xingshi passes (Yang County, Shaanxi): steep Qinling valleys with Shu forts holding the narrow passes; a large Wei army stuck in the gorges, its pack animals dying in the mountains, columns turning back in disorder while Shu banners fly on the ridges. Small figures, no gore. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick, ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
zhengshi-xuanxue: 245 CE, Luoyang: scholars in loose wide-sleeved robes and soft caps sit on mats in a garden pavilion, one holding a fly-whisk of deer tail as he speaks, bamboo-slip copies of the Laozi and the Book of Changes open on low tables, wine cups and incense burner nearby, willows outside. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
kang-tai-funan: 245 CE, Funan (Angkor Borei, Cambodia): two Chinese envoys in robes and caps, seen from behind, arrive by boat at a riverside city on stilts in the Mekong delta; long canoes, palm-thatched houses, local people with wrapped cloth and bare shoulders, a raised royal hall. Wide view, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and soft green and ochre on silk.
huang-hao-rises: 246 CE, Chengdu: an inner palace corridor where a eunuch in palace dress whispers to a ruler reclining on a couch, seen from a distance, while ministers in court robes wait outside a closed lattice door, uneasy. Quiet, shadowy interior, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and mineral colour on aged silk.
kang-senghui-jianye: 247 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): a Central Asian monk in a patched robe, seen from behind, kneels before a small reliquary on an altar in a newly built timber temple hall with a tiled roof; townspeople and officials in Wu robes gather at the gate in wonder, incense smoke rising. Painted in the style of an early Southern Dynasties moulded brick relief from Nanjing, shown as a soft ink rubbing.
lady-trieu-revolt: 248 CE, Jiuzhen (Thanh Hóa, Vietnam): a rebel army of local people with spears and shields gathers among limestone hills and rice paddies, war elephants in the column, and at its head a figure in yellow robes rides an elephant, seen from far away; a Wu fort with banners stands on the far side of a river. Small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and green and ochre on silk.
gaoping-tombs: 249 CE, Luoyang: early morning as troops with banners occupy the city gates and seize the arsenal, the palace in the background; far away on the hills south of the river a hunting and tomb-visiting procession of carriages halts at an imperial burial mound. Two scenes in one panorama, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and mineral colour on aged silk.
wang-ling-rebellion: 251 CE, the Huai River near Shouchun: a great fleet of Wei boats with banners sails swiftly down the Huai under a grey sky, and on the riverbank an old general in plain robes has come out alone, kneeling bare-headed in submission at the water's edge. Distant view, small figures. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick from the Hexi corridor, ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
sima-yi-dies: 251 CE, Luoyang: an aristocratic mansion with tiled halls and courtyards draped in white mourning cloth; mourners in white hemp robes kneel in the courtyard, and a son in court robes, seen from behind, stands at the hall steps receiving officials. Autumn leaves, subdued light, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
battle-of-dongxing: 252 CE, Dongxing (Chaohu): a snowstorm over the earthen dykes and twin forts at the outlet of Chao Lake; Wu soldiers stripped of heavy armour charge across the snow with short swords and shields, while a Wei army camped on the dyke scatters, and a pontoon bridge collapses into the icy water. Distant view, small figures, no gore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, ink and white washes on aged silk.
sun-quan-dies: 252 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): a palace hall in white mourning; a small boy emperor sits on the throne dais under a canopy while a tall regent in court robes stands at its foot, officials in rows, and outside a funeral procession prepares for the tomb on Zhongshan's slopes. Small figures. Painted in the style of a Southern Dynasties moulded brick relief from Nanjing, rendered as a soft ink rubbing.
zhuge-ke-killed: 253 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): a palace banquet hall with lacquer tables, wine vessels and musicians; armed guards suddenly step from behind a screen as guests rise in alarm, a toppled wine cup on the floor. Shown at a distance, no blood. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine gossamer line, ink and mineral red on aged silk.
fei-yi-assassinated: 253 CE, Hanshou (Guangyuan): a New Year banquet in a hall lit by lamps, officials in court robes seated at low tables with wine, musicians and dancers; a lone guest rises suddenly from his place toward the host as guards turn. Moment of alarm shown at a distance, no blood. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick showing a banquet, quick ink outlines with red and ochre on pale ground.
cao-fang-deposed: 254 CE, Luoyang: a deposed young emperor in plain robes, seen from behind, is escorted out of the palace gate in a simple carriage while officials weep along the road; inside the hall another youth is led toward the empty throne. Autumn, small figures. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and pale colour on aged silk.
guanqiu-jian-rebellion: 255 CE, Xiang County (Henan): two armies face each other on the Huai plain; rebel banners waver as soldiers desert at night, and a cavalry party gallops south toward the Huai River and the distant Wu frontier. Wide nocturnal view lit by camp fires, small figures. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick from the Hexi corridor, ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
battle-of-taoxi: 255 CE, west of the Tao River (Gansu): a broad river valley with loess terraces, where a Shu army sweeps a Wei force back against the riverbank, soldiers and horses scattering across the fords; beyond, the walled town of Didao is surrounded by besieging camps. Distant view, small figures, no gore. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and ochre washes on aged silk.
battle-of-duangu: 256 CE, Duangu (Tianshui): an ambush in a mountain valley; Wei troops waiting on the high ground rush down on a Shu army arriving late, banners falling, the Shu column streaming back along the valley road. Distant panoramic view of loess hills, small figures, no gore. Rendered like a Wei-Jin painted tomb brick, quick ink outlines with red and ochre washes on pale ground.
zhuge-dan-rebellion: 257 CE, Shouchun: one single moment of the siege, a walled city beside the Huai River ringed by double lines of earthwork ramparts and Wei army camps with tents and banners; smoke rises over the city roofs, defenders stand thinly on the walls, and besiegers wait in the trenches. Seen from high above as one continuous landscape, small figures, bare winter trees along the riverbank. A single unified picture, no panels, no borders, no repeated scenes. Painted in the manner of a Gu Kaizhi handscroll, fine line, ink and grey washes on aged silk.
sun-xiu-kills-sun-chen: 258 CE, Jianye (Nanjing): a winter court assembly in a palace hall with braziers burning; guards step forward and bind a powerful minister in court robes, leading him away down the steps, while officials in rows look on in shock and a young emperor watches from the dais. Small figures, no blood. Painted in the style of a Southern Dynasties moulded brick relief, rendered as a soft ink rubbing.
