eg-omar-mukhtar: September 1931, Suluq in Cyrenaica: a vast silent crowd of Libyan Bedouin men and women in white barracans, gathered under guard on a dry plain, Italian soldiers in colonial uniforms ringing the edges, low desert hills and an empty sky. Sombre, mourning mood, no execution shown. Painted as a 1930s woodcut print, stark black and white with a sand-coloured tint. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-arab-league: March 1945, Cairo: a stately hall in a neo-Islamic style palace with arched windows and chandeliers, delegates in dark suits and tarbushes, some in Arab headdresses, seated around a long table covered in green cloth, flags behind them without visible emblems; seen from the back of the room. Formal, quiet mood. Painted as a muted 1940s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-libya-independence: December 1951, Benghazi: crowds in white barracans and suits gathered along a seafront boulevard with Italian-era colonnaded buildings, palms and new flags of red, black and green with a white crescent fluttering from balconies; a modest royal palace with guards in the distance. Bright winter sunlight. Painted as a muted mid-century documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-morocco-tunisia-independence: March 1956, Rabat: festive crowds in djellabas and suits fill the square before the walls of the royal palace, red flags with a green star hung from buildings, a motorcade in the distance, the Hassan Tower and the Bou Regreg river beyond. Bright spring light. Painted as a muted mid-century documentary gouache illustration, warm colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-personal-status-code: 1956, Tunis: a whitewashed street in the medina opening onto a modern avenue, Tunisian women, some in white safsari wraps and some in 1950s dresses, walking together toward a public building, a courthouse doorway with steps, schoolgirls with satchels nearby. Calm daylight. Painted as a muted mid-century documentary watercolour, white and blue tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-aswan-high-dam: Around 1964, Aswan: a vast construction site across the Nile, an immense rock-fill embankment rising between granite hills, hundreds of trucks and Soviet-made excavators moving earth, workers in galabiyas and helmets; upstream, the giant seated stone figures of a temple façade being cut into blocks by cranes. Hot, dusty sunlight. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, sandy ochres and blue river. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-six-day-war: June 1967, the Sinai desert: seen from far away, a vast sandy plain with columns of dust from tanks moving on the horizon, an Egyptian airfield in the distance with smoke rising from burnt aircraft on the runway, rocky mountains beyond. No close-up violence or people. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale sand and grey smoke. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-gaddafi-coup: 1 September 1969, Benghazi: a quiet dawn over the seafront, a few army trucks and an armoured car parked outside a radio station building of Italian-era architecture, soldiers in olive uniforms standing at the gate, palms and empty streets around. Calm, tense mood. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, pale blue dawn light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-yom-kippur-war: October 1973, the Suez Canal near Ismailia: Egyptian soldiers in olive uniforms cross the canal in rubber boats under a hazy afternoon sky, a pontoon bridge being laid, high-pressure water jets cutting gaps in the tall sand embankment on the far bank, smoke drifting. Seen from a distance. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, sand and blue-grey tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-green-march: November 1975, near Tarfaya: a huge procession of Moroccan civilians on foot, men and women in djellabas, carrying red flags and green-covered books, streams across the open desert toward the horizon, buses and trucks parked behind, endless dunes and a pale sky. Seen from high above. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, sandy ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-egypt-israel-peace: March 1979, Washington: the North Lawn of the White House, a long outdoor table with documents set up before the white columned portico, rows of seated guests and press photographers, three men in dark suits seated at the table, small and seen from the back of the crowd. Bright, chilly spring day. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cool tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-sadat-assassinated: 6 October 1981, Nasr City in Cairo: a large reviewing stand of modern concrete with a canopy, seen from far across a parade avenue, lines of military trucks and soldiers in formation, jets streaking overhead in formation; a sudden confusion of small figures near the stand, chairs overturned, a haze of dust. No violence visible. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, pale desert tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-mahfouz-nobel: 1988, Cairo: a traditional coffeehouse in an old quarter with mirrors, wooden chairs and brass lamps, an elderly man in dark glasses and a suit, small and seen from behind, seated at a table with friends and a newspaper, people gathered at the doorway to congratulate him; the minarets of the old city outside. Warm evening light. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, golden tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-algerian-civil-war: 1990s, Algiers: the white city of Algiers rising in tiers from the bay seen from the sea at dusk, apartment buildings and the kasbah on the hillside, an army checkpoint with an armoured vehicle on a coastal road in the foreground, empty streets and lights coming on. Sombre, quiet mood. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, white and grey-blue tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-moudawana: 2004, Rabat: the exterior of the parliament building with its arched façade, Moroccan women in djellabas and modern clothes gathered on the steps and pavement, some holding folders, palm trees and the old city walls beyond. Ordinary people at a distance, no recognisable faces. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, warm sunlit tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-egyptian-revolution-2011: February 2011, Tahrir Square in Cairo: seen from high above, an enormous crowd fills the broad roundabout and avenues, tents in the central garden, Egyptian flags of red, white and black waving, the large museum building of pink stone at one side and the Nile bridges beyond. No individual faces. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm evening light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-libyan-civil-war-2011: 2011, the Benghazi seafront: a courthouse building with columns covered in flags of red, black and green, crowds gathered at a distance in front of it, pickup trucks parked along the corniche, the Mediterranean grey under clouds and two jet contrails high in the sky. No violence shown. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greys and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-sisi-takes-power: July 2013, Cairo: a night view across the Nile toward a crowded city square, fireworks and laser lights above the crowd, military helicopters in the distance trailing flags, apartment towers and bridges lit along the river. People only as distant crowds, no recognisable faces. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, dark blues and warm lights. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eg-grand-egyptian-museum: 2025, Giza: a vast modern museum building with an angled translucent stone façade on the desert plateau, the three Giza pyramids visible beyond, visitors in the forecourt; inside through the glass, a colossal ancient royal statue of granite dressed in kilt and crown standing in the great hall and a wide grand staircase lined with pharaonic sculpture. Bright clear daylight. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, sandy and gold tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-cycladic-culture: Around 3000 BCE, Naxos in the Cyclades: on a rocky shore below white marble outcrops, islanders in simple woollen tunics grind and polish small, flat, abstract marble idols and bowls with emery stones, while a long low longboat with many paddlers and a high prow is pulled onto the beach, loaded with obsidian and pottery; turquoise sea and other islands on the horizon. Bright Aegean sun. Painted in the manner of Aegean Bronze Age fresco, flat colours, blue sea and ochre rock. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-yamnaya: Around 3000 BCE, the Pontic steppe by the lower Don: a slow train of heavy four-wheeled wagons with solid wooden disc wheels made of joined planks, with no spokes, and arched covers of felt and reed matting, pulled by pairs of oxen, crosses a sea of feather grass. Herders in plain wool and leather tunics and felt caps, not fringed or Native American-style dress, walk alongside cattle and sheep, and a low earthen kurgan mound stands on the horizon. Vast sky, morning light. Earthen palette inspired by prehistoric steppe art, simple bold shapes. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-early-minoan: Around 3000 BCE, Myrtos on the south coast of Crete: a hilltop village of small stone and mud-brick rooms clustered together, villagers in woven tunics working at a small hearth hammering copper, women shaping painted mottled pots, olive trees and terraced hills, the Libyan Sea glittering below with a small boat arriving. Warm afternoon light. Painted in the style of Minoan fresco, flat red ochre, blue and white. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-corded-ware: Around 2900 BCE, Saxony-Anhalt: a small hamlet of timber longhouses on a gentle rise among forests and fields, villagers in wool and leather clothing; a potter presses twisted cord into the wet clay of a tall beaker, while a man polishes a stone battle-axe; a single burial mound nearby and cattle grazing. Soft overcast light. Painted in a muted prehistoric palette, simple flat forms like Neolithic rock art. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-unetice: Around 2300 BCE, near Prague: a Bronze Age smithy under a thatched roof in a village of timber houses, metalworkers in wool tunics pour molten bronze into clay moulds for axes and neck rings, finished bronze ingots stacked in bundles; traders with packs arriving on a forest track by the Vltava river. Glow of the furnace against grey daylight. Painted in an earthy palette inspired by Bronze Age rock carvings and metal ornament. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-linear-a: Around 1800 BCE, the palace of Phaistos on Crete: in a storeroom with tall painted storage jars and red columns that taper downward, a palace scribe in a patterned kilt sits incising signs into small clay tablets with a stylus, baskets of grain and jars of oil around him; through an opening, the Messara plain and Mount Ida. Warm afternoon light. Painted in the style of a Minoan fresco, red ochre, blue and cream. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-phaistos-disc: Around 1700 BCE, Phaistos on Crete: a craftsman in a Minoan kilt sits at a low table in a palace workshop, pressing small carved stamps one by one into a round disc of soft clay in a spiral pattern of tiny pictures, a row of stamps laid out beside him, a kiln glowing in the corner, red-painted columns and a view of olive-covered hills. Painted in the style of a Minoan fresco, flat colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-nordic-bronze-age: Around 1700 BCE, Zealand in Denmark: a coastal settlement of low thatched longhouses beside large grassy round burial mounds. On the beach lies a long, low, keel-less paddled plank canoe with an upturned double beak at both ends like the boats of Bronze Age rock carvings, with no mast, no sail and no carved dragon heads, and no sailing ships anywhere at sea. Traders exchange baskets of golden amber for bronze swords and spiral ornaments, people in woollen tunics and cord skirts. Green fields, grey sea. Painted in ochre tones inspired by Scandinavian rock carvings. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-nebra-sky-disc: Around 1600 BCE, the Mittelberg hill near Nebra: at dusk on a wooded hilltop, a small group of people in woollen cloaks kneel to bury a round bronze disc inlaid with a gold sun, crescent moon and stars, together with two bronze swords, in a stone-lined pit; the real crescent moon and stars rising over the forested valley. Painted in a palette inspired by Bronze Age gold and bronze metalwork, green-blue and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-linear-b: Around 1400 BCE, the palace of Pylos: in an archive room beside the palace entrance, Mycenaean scribes in tunics write on leaf-shaped clay tablets, wicker baskets of tablets stored on shelves, an official checking jars of olive oil and bundles of wool being counted; through the doorway a painted courtyard with a hearth. Warm lamplight. Painted in the style of a Mycenaean fresco, flat ochre, blue and white with bold outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-urnfield: Around 1300 BCE, Bavaria: at the edge of a forest, a large cremation cemetery of many small mounds, mourners in woollen cloaks place a dark burnished pottery urn into a pit while smoke from a funeral pyre rises in the background; a village of timber houses on the river terrace beyond. Overcast, solemn light. Painted in a muted palette inspired by Bronze Age pottery decoration and rock art. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-tollense: Around 1250 BCE, the Tollense valley in northern Germany: a marshy river valley with a narrow causeway crossing, seen from a distance as two large groups of warriors on foot with wooden clubs, bronze-tipped spears and flint arrows clash in the reeds and shallows, mist rising from the water, forests beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in a palette inspired by Bronze Age rock carvings, simple figures, earthy greens and browns. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-bronze-age-collapse: Around 1200 BCE, the hill of Pylos: seen from far below, the Mycenaean palace on its ridge is burning, smoke billowing from its roofs and columns, small figures fleeing down the hillside with bundles, olive groves and the bay of Navarino glittering in the distance. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Mycenaean fresco, flat red ochre, black and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-gadir: Around 1100 BCE, an island off the Atlantic coast of Andalusia: Phoenician ships with curved horse-head prows and square sails are beached on the sand, traders in long robes and conical caps unloading jars and purple cloth, and building a small stone temple and storehouses; Iberian locals bring silver ingots down from the hills. Bright Atlantic light. Painted in the style of a Phoenician-Assyrian relief, flat colours, bold outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-lefkandi: Around 950 BCE, Lefkandi on Euboea: a long apsidal building with thatched roof and wooden posts on a low hill by the sea, mourners in woollen robes gathered as a warrior's ashes are laid in a bronze urn beside a woman's burial adorned with gold, horses waiting; the Euripus strait and mountains beyond. Grey morning light. Painted in the style of Greek Geometric vase painting, black silhouettes on cream ground, bands of zigzag. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-geometric-art: Around 900 BCE, the Kerameikos potters' quarter of Athens: in a workshop courtyard, a potter turns a tall amphora on a wheel while another paints bands of meander patterns and zigzags in black slip on a dried vase; finished vases stand in rows by a kiln, the Acropolis hill rising beyond. Warm sunlight. Painted in the style of a Greek Geometric vase, black-brown figures and bands on pale clay. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-villanovan: Around 900 BCE, near Bologna: an Iron Age village of oval huts with thatched roofs on a plain, a funeral group in wool cloaks places a biconical urn topped with a bowl, holding ashes, into a pit in a cemetery among oak trees; a bronze razor and fibula laid beside it. Soft evening light. Painted in a palette inspired by early Italic pottery and bronze ornament, earthy browns and blacks. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-lycurgus: Around 820 BCE, Sparta in Laconia: on a dusty plain by the Eurotas river, below the Taygetus mountains, Spartan boys in short cloaks drill with wooden spears and shields while bearded citizens in red cloaks eat together at long tables in the open; small villages rather than city walls. Clear morning light. Painted in the style of a Laconian black-figure vase painting, black figures on orange ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-greek-alphabet: Around 800 BCE, a harbour in Euboea: on a quay beside a merchant ship, a Greek trader and a Phoenician merchant in a long robe sit together on a bench, the trader scratching letter-like marks into the shoulder of a clay jug with a bronze point, piles of trade goods, jars and bronze tripods around. Bright daylight. Painted in the style of a Greek Geometric vase, black figures and bands on pale clay. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-hallstatt: Around 800 BCE, Hallstatt in the Austrian Alps: a deep salt mine tunnel in the mountain lit by pine torches, miners in leather caps and wool clothes cut salt with bronze picks and carry it in leather backpacks; outside, a steep green valley above a dark lake with timber houses on the shore. Painted in a palette inspired by Celtic Hallstatt bronze ornament, geometric motifs, earthy colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-founding-of-rome: 21 April, 753 BCE by tradition, the Palatine Hill: a young man in a simple wool tunic guides a bronze plough pulled by a white ox and cow, cutting a furrow around the base of the hill to mark the city's boundary, shepherds with crooks and a few huts of wattle and thatch, the Tiber winding below among wooded hills. Spring morning. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-homer: Around 750 BCE, Chios in Ionia: in the courtyard of a nobleman's house, an old blind bard with a white beard and a lyre sits on a stool and sings to a gathered audience of men, women and children in himation and chiton, seated on benches and the ground; the Aegean sea beyond. Evening torchlight. Painted in the style of Greek black-figure vase painting, black figures on orange clay. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-first-messenian-war: Around 743 BCE, Mount Ithome in Messenia: a rocky mountain stronghold with rough stone walls on the summit, seen from a distance, ringed by the camps of Spartan hoplites with round shields and crested helmets in the valley below; Messenian farmers' fields and olive trees around. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Laconian black-figure vase painting, black figures on terracotta. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-etruscans: Around 700 BCE, Tarquinia in Etruria: inside a rock-cut tomb chamber, a painter by lamplight decorates the walls with scenes of banqueters on couches, musicians with double flutes, dolphins and birds, while assistants mix pigments; through the entrance a hill dotted with earthen tomb mounds and the sea beyond. Painted in the style of Etruscan tomb painting, flat red, ochre, blue and black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-byzantium-founded: Around 667 BCE, the Bosporus: Greek colonists from Megara step ashore from oared ships onto a hilly peninsula between a long horn-shaped harbour and the strait, marking out walls and a sanctuary, carrying jars, tools and sacrificial animals; across the water, the opposite shore of Asia. Bright morning. Painted in the style of Greek black-figure vase painting, black silhouettes on orange clay. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-draco: Around 621 BCE, Athens: in an open space near the Acropolis, citizens in himation cloaks gather around tall wooden boards and pillars carved with dense lines of incised characters too small to read, an archon reading aloud, bearded elders frowning; temples on the rock above. Clear morning light. Painted in the style of Attic black-figure vase painting, black figures on terracotta ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-massalia: Around 600 BCE, the coast of Provence: Phocaean Greek penteconter ships with eyes painted on the prows enter a sheltered rocky inlet, settlers in chitons unloading amphorae of wine and olive oil, Celtic tribesmen in checked cloaks and torcs coming down from the hills to trade, white limestone cliffs and pine trees around. Bright sun. Painted in the style of Greek black-figure vase painting, black silhouettes on orange. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-thales: 585 BCE, Miletus in Ionia: on a hillside above the harbour city, a crowd of Greeks in chitons and soldiers with shields stand still and look up as the sun is half covered by the moon in a darkening sky; an elderly philosopher in a himation, small and seen from behind, stands calmly among them. Eerie twilight. Painted in the style of an Ionian black-figure vase painting, black figures on orange ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-peisistratus: Around 550 BCE, Athens: workers in short tunics build a stone fountain house with columns in the Agora, water flowing into basins where women fill hydria jars, a festival procession with garlanded cattle and musicians passing toward the Acropolis above. Bright festival day. Painted in the style of Attic black-figure vase painting, black figures with incised details on orange clay. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-aegina-coinage: Around 550 BCE, Aegina: in a small mint near the harbour, a craftsman places a silver blank between two iron dies and strikes it with a hammer, stamping a sea turtle design, coins piled in a bowl; merchants with scales weighing coins at a table by the quay, ships with sails in the harbour. Bright daylight. Painted in the style of Greek black-figure vase painting, black figures on terracotta. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pythagoras: Around 530 BCE, Croton in southern Italy: in a quiet courtyard with Doric columns, a bearded teacher in a white robe, small and seen from behind, stands before a circle of disciples in white seated on benches; geometric figures of triangles and pebbles arranged in patterns lie on the sandy ground, and a lyre rests nearby; the sea beyond. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-roman-republic: 509 BCE, Rome: a crowd of Roman citizens in togas and tunics gathered in the Forum valley, an assembly raising hands, two men in purple-bordered togas standing on a speaker's platform accompanied by lictors carrying bundles of rods; the temple of Jupiter under construction on the Capitoline Hill above. Clear daylight. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earth reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-secession-plebs: 494 BCE, Mons Sacer near Rome: a large crowd of Roman plebeians in rough tunics, with families, tools and bundles, camped on a hill above the Anio river among simple tents; a patrician envoy in a white toga arriving to speak with them, the city of Rome visible far off. Soft evening light. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, faded reds, ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-plataea: 479 BCE, the plain below Mount Cithaeron near Plataea: seen from a hillside, long ranks of Greek hoplites in bronze helmets with round shields advance in phalanx toward a Persian army with wicker shields, bows and tall caps, a cloud of dust over the field, the river Asopus and mountains beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-delian-league: 478 BCE, the sacred island of Delos: delegates from many Greek cities in himations gather in the sanctuary of Apollo among marble temples and stone lions, oxen being led to the altar, a treasury building with chests of silver; triremes anchored in the small harbour. Bright sunlight on white stone. Painted in the style of Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pericles: Around 440 BCE, Athens: the Acropolis with the Parthenon under construction, marble columns rising inside wooden scaffolding, oxen hauling marble blocks up the ramp; on the Pnyx hill opposite, a large assembly of citizens in himations listens to a speaker, triremes in the distant harbour of Piraeus. Clear golden light. Painted in the style of Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-oresteia: 458 BCE, the Theatre of Dionysus on the slope of the Acropolis: a large audience seated on wooden benches on the hillside watches masked actors in long robes and a chorus of masked figures on a circular dancing floor before a simple wooden stage building; the sea and Attic plain beyond. Bright spring daylight. Painted in the style of an Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-twelve-tables: 451 BCE, the early Roman Forum: a modest open square of beaten earth and tufa paving, ringed by low mudbrick and tufa buildings with tiled roofs and a few Etruscan-style temples on high podiums with wide eaves, wooden columns and brightly painted terracotta roof decorations, with no white marble, no Corinthian columns and no honorific columns. Twelve bronze tablets covered in tiny unreadable marks hang on a wooden frame beside a speaker's platform, and a magistrate points to them before a crowd of citizens in plain wool togas and tunics. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-la-tene: Around 450 BCE, La Tène on Lake Neuchâtel: Celtic craftsmen in checked cloaks and gold torcs work at a lakeside workshop, engraving swirling S-shaped and leaf patterns onto a bronze scabbard and shield, wooden piers stretching into the lake, offerings of swords and brooches thrown into the water by a figure on a pier; forested hills and the Alps beyond. Painted in a palette inspired by Celtic La Tène metalwork, gold, bronze and deep green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-herodotus: Around 430 BCE, Athens: in the shade of a portico in the Agora, a bearded man in a himation, seen from behind, reads aloud from a papyrus scroll to a gathered audience of citizens seated on steps; market stalls and crowds and the Acropolis temples beyond. Warm afternoon light. Painted in the style of Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-plague-of-athens: 430 BCE, Athens: inside the Long Walls, a crowded makeshift camp of refugees from the countryside in tents and shacks under a hot sky, sick people lying under blankets in shade, mourners carrying a covered bier, smoke rising from distant funeral pyres, the Acropolis above. No bodies or gore shown. Painted in the style of an Attic white-ground lekythos funeral vase, muted lines on pale ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-hippocrates: Around 420 BCE, Kos: in the shaded portico of a sanctuary of healing, a physician in a himation examines a seated patient's wrist, students with wax tablets watching, bowls of herbs and bronze instruments on a table, a plane tree outside and the sea beyond. Calm, warm light. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-democritus: Around 420 BCE, Abdera in Thrace: a philosopher in a himation, small and seen from behind, sits on a sunny beach watching a beam of sunlight through a doorway filled with floating motes of dust, sand trickling from his hand, the white houses of Abdera behind him and the blue sea ahead. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black, delicate line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-sicilian-expedition: 413 BCE, the Great Harbour of Syracuse: seen from the heights, a great fleet of Athenian triremes is trapped inside the bay by Syracusan ships, rams and oars tangled, smoke rising from burning hulls, the walled city on its island and Sicilian hills beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of Attic red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-gallic-sack: 390 BCE, Rome: seen from the Capitoline Hill, smoke rises above the burning thatched and tiled roofs of the city below, bands of Celtic Gauls with long swords, oval shields and checked trousers moving through the streets, Roman defenders and sacred geese on the hilltop walls. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, reds, browns and smoky greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-plato-academy: Around 387 BCE, outside Athens: a sacred olive grove with a small gymnasium and stone benches, a bearded teacher in a himation, seen from behind, walking with a group of young students among the trees, others seated drawing geometric shapes on a sand board; the Acropolis far in the distance. Soft dappled light. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-leuctra: 371 BCE, the plain of Leuctra in Boeotia: seen from a hill, a Theban phalanx massed fifty ranks deep on its left wing crashes into the Spartan line of hoplites with red cloaks and round shields, a cloud of dust over the field, low hills around. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-licinian-laws: 367 BCE, Rome: in the Comitium beside the Senate house, a large assembly of plebeians in tunics and patricians in white togas listen as two tribunes on a platform address them, lictors with rod bundles at the side, a crowd raising hands in a vote; the Capitoline temple above. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-philip-ii: 359 BCE, near Pella in Macedonia: on a broad plain, a Macedonian phalanx drills in tight formation with very long sarissa pikes held upright like a forest, soldiers in linen corselets and small round shields, officers on horseback watching; the palace hill of Pella and mountains beyond. Morning light. Painted in the style of a Macedonian tomb fresco from Vergina, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-chaeronea: 338 BCE, the plain of Chaeronea in Boeotia: seen from a hillside, the Macedonian phalanx with long sarissas advances against the lines of Athenian and Theban hoplites, cavalry charging on the flank under a young commander, dust rising over the plain by the Cephissus river. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic mosaic like the Alexander Mosaic, earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-lyceum: Around 335 BCE, the Lyceum outside Athens: a covered colonnade walk among tall plane trees, a bearded teacher in a long woollen himation, small and seen from behind, strolls while talking with a group of fully robed students carrying scrolls; nearby, wooden tables with collected shells and pressed plants. Soft afternoon light. Painted in the style of Greek red-figure vase painting, orange figures on black ground, fine line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-diadochi: Around 320 BCE, Pella in Macedonia: in a palace courtyard with a pebble mosaic floor, Macedonian generals in cuirasses and purple cloaks stand apart in tense groups around an empty throne and a golden diadem on a cushion, guards with long sarissas at the colonnade; the plain and mountains beyond. Tense, cool light. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic pebble mosaic from Pella, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-appian-way: 312 BCE, south of Rome: Roman labourers in tunics lay a straight road across the Latin countryside, digging a trench, packing gravel and fitting large polygonal blocks of grey basalt, oxcarts bringing stone, a surveyor with a groma sighting the line; an open landscape of fields and the Alban hills behind. Bright summer day. Painted in the style of a Roman landscape fresco, soft greens and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-epicurus: Around 307 BCE, Athens: a quiet walled garden with vegetables, fig trees and a simple house, a bearded man in a plain himation, seen from behind, sitting on a bench in conversation with a small mixed group of friends, men and women, sharing bread, water and cheese; the Acropolis faint beyond the wall. Gentle afternoon light. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic wall painting, soft earth colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-stoicism: Around 300 BCE, the Painted Stoa in the Athenian Agora: a long colonnade whose back wall is covered with large painted battle murals, a lean bearded teacher in a plain cloak, small and seen from behind, pacing as he speaks to a crowd of listeners seated and standing between the columns, merchants passing in the Agora outside. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic fresco, warm earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-lex-hortensia: 287 BCE, Rome: on the Janiculum hill across the Tiber, a large assembly of plebeians in tunics gathers in the open with a dictator in a purple-bordered toga addressing them from a wooden platform, lictors beside him, voting baskets and wooden ballots handed out; the city of Rome and its hills seen across the river. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-colossus-rhodes: Around 280 BCE, the harbour of Rhodes, seen from across the water: a gigantic dark bronze statue of the sun god Helios, lightly draped in the Greek manner, a crown of sun rays on his head, one hand shading his eyes as he gazes out to sea, stands on a tall white marble pedestal on the harbour mole. Below pass Hellenistic Greek merchant ships and oared warships with painted bow eyes and square sails, no dragon prows and no shields hung on the sides. City walls and temples behind. Hellenistic wall painting style, bronze and Aegean blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pyrrhic-war: 280 BCE, the plain of Heraclea in Lucania: seen from a distance, war elephants with towers on their backs advance alongside a Greek phalanx against Roman legionaries with oval shields, Roman horses shying away in panic, dust rising by a river, hills behind. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic painted vase or Italic tomb fresco, earthy reds and blacks. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-aristarchus: Around 270 BCE, Samos: on a rooftop terrace at twilight overlooking the sea, an astronomer in a himation, seen from behind, measures the angle between the half-lit moon and the setting sun with a simple wooden sighting instrument, a wax tablet with circles beside him; the harbour and hills below. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic wall painting, deep blue sky and warm sunset tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-archimedes: Around 250 BCE, Syracuse: in a sunlit courtyard, an elderly scholar in a himation, small and seen from behind, kneels on the ground drawing circles and polygons in a tray of sand, a wooden screw pump lifting water nearby, a lever propped on a stone and a bronze crown and bowl of water on a bench; the harbour of Syracuse beyond. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic mosaic, fine tesserae, warm colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-siege-of-syracuse: 213 BCE, the sea walls of Syracuse: seen from offshore, Roman quinqueremes with towers and boarding ladders approach the high stone walls, while enormous wooden cranes on the walls swing out to drop heavy stones and lift a ship's prow from the water, catapults on the towers. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, ochres, blue sea and smoke greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-winged-victory: Around 190 BCE, the sanctuary on the island of Samothrace: on a hillside terrace above a small theatre, workers with ropes and wooden rollers set a large marble statue of a winged figure in heavy, fully draped, wind-swept robes onto a grey marble ship's prow beside a shallow pool; rugged mountains and the sea behind. Seen from a distance in bright sunlight. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic wall painting, white marble and blue sky. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-corinth-146: 146 BCE, Corinth: seen from the slopes of the Acrocorinth, columns of smoke rise over the city's temples and houses, Roman legionaries with oval shields lead captives and carts piled with bronze statues and treasure out of the gates, the Temple of Apollo still standing, the gulf beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, smoky greys and earthy reds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-gracchi: 133 BCE, Rome: on the Capitoline Hill, a large crowd of poor citizens in worn tunics gathers before a young tribune in a toga speaking from a platform, while a group of senators in purple-bordered togas approaches angrily from the temple steps; the Forum and city roofs below. Tense midday light. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-marian-reforms: Around 107 BCE, the Campus Martius outside Rome: long lines of poor young men in plain tunics enlist at a table before officers, others already drilling in chain mail with oval shields and javelins, each carrying a pole hung with tools and rations; a silver eagle standard raised above the ranks, the city walls beyond. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-antikythera: Around 70 BCE, the sea off Antikythera: a heavily laden Roman-era merchant ship with a square sail struggles in a storm near a rocky island, amphorae and bronze statues lashed on deck, waves breaking; on the deck a wooden box holding a bronze device of interlocking gear wheels glints in a flash of lightning. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, dark blues and bronze tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-social-war: 91 BCE, Corfinium in the Abruzzo: Italian allies in Roman-style armour with oval shields gather in a mountain town square, raising a new standard with a bull, delegates from many tribes in cloaks meeting before a small temple; snowy Apennine peaks around. Overcast light. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-sulla: 82 BCE, the Colline Gate of Rome: seen from a distance at dusk, two armies of legionaries clash before the city's stone walls and gate tower, standards and torches, smoke over the field, the hills of Rome beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, dark reds, ochres and smoky greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-spartacus: 73 BCE, the slopes of Mount Vesuvius near Capua: a band of escaped gladiators and slaves with improvised weapons climbs down a steep forested cliff on ropes of twisted vines, while others gather around a campfire on the hillside; the plain of Campania with villas and vineyards below. Twilight. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earth reds, ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-catiline: 63 BCE, the Senate meeting in the Temple of Jupiter Stator in Rome: a crowded hall of senators in white togas with purple stripes seated on benches, an orator standing in the centre gesturing, and one senator sitting isolated on an empty bench as the others edge away. Seen from the back of the hall. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, warm reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-first-triumvirate: 60 BCE, Rome: in the atrium of a wealthy house with a central pool and painted walls, three men in togas, seen from behind and small, clasp hands in private; a slave brings wine, and through the doorway the Forum and Senate house are seen in the distance. Lamplight, secretive mood. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, deep red and black walls. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-lucretius: Around 55 BCE, a Roman villa on the coast: a poet in a tunic, seen from behind, sits writing on a wax tablet on a terrace overlooking the sea, scrolls in a basket beside him, sunlight streaming through dust motes, a storm building over the sea and a flock of birds overhead. Painted in the style of a Pompeian wall painting, soft blues, ochres and reds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pharsalus: 48 BCE, the plain of Pharsalus in Thessaly: seen from a hill, two great Roman armies of legionaries in chain mail with oval shields and eagle standards face each other, cavalry clashing on one flank, dust over the wide summer plain and mountains beyond. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-julian-calendar: Around 45 BCE, Rome: in a courtyard of a public building, priests and astronomers in togas gather around a large stone calendar wall marked with columns of small symbols too fine to read, beside a bronze sundial and a celestial globe, citizens looking on. Clear morning light. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, warm reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-actium: 31 BCE, the mouth of the Ambracian Gulf off Actium: seen from the shore, two great fleets of Roman warships with rams and towers fight across the blue sea, smaller fast galleys surrounding heavy ships, smoke rising from burning hulls, and a squadron of Egyptian ships with purple sails breaking away. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, blues and earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-aeneid: 19 BCE, Rome: in a richly painted room of a palace on the Palatine, a group of Roman nobles in togas sit listening as a reader holds scrolls; on the walls, frescoes show a ship sailing from a burning city and a fleet reaching the Italian shore. Lamplight, quiet mood. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, red and black walls, warm light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-teutoburg: 9 CE, the Teutoburg Forest: seen from a wooded hill, a long Roman column of legionaries, mule carts and standards struggles along a muddy track between dense dark forest and marsh in pouring rain, Germanic warriors in cloaks with spears gathering among the trees above. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman relief or fresco, dark greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-conquest-of-britain: 43 CE, the Kent coast of Britain: Roman legionaries in segmented iron armour and red rectangular curved shields wade ashore from flat-bottomed Roman troop transports and galleys with banks of oars, straight bronze rams at the bow, square-rigged single masts, painted eyes on the hulls and a carved swan-neck stern post; low chalk cliffs and a British earthwork beyond. Not Viking ships: no dragon heads, no curled prows, no round shields along the sides. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-paul-in-europe: Around 49 CE, Philippi in Macedonia: beside a river outside the city gate, a small group of women and men in Roman-era tunics and cloaks sits on the grassy bank listening to a travelling preacher in a simple cloak, seen from behind; the walled city and its theatre on the hill beyond. Peaceful morning light. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-boudica: 60 CE, Camulodunum: seen from a distance, the Roman colony with its temple and tiled roofs is in flames, columns of smoke rising, while a great host of Britons with chariots, oval shields and long hair gathers on the fields outside. No close-up violence. Painted in the manner of a Celtic-Roman provincial wall painting, smoky greys, reds and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-great-fire-rome: 64 CE, Rome at night: seen from the Esquiline Hill, flames sweep through crowded tenement blocks and around the valley of the Circus Maximus, a red glow over the hills, crowds of citizens fleeing with bundles along streets, dark smoke over the temples. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, deep reds, oranges and blacks. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-colosseum: Around 75 CE, Rome: the Flavian Amphitheatre under construction in the valley, its tiers of travertine arches rising inside wooden scaffolding and treadwheel cranes, hundreds of workers hauling stone with oxen and ropes, the drained lake bed beside it and the Palatine Hill behind. Bright daylight. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, warm travertine tones and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pliny-natural-history: 77 CE, Rome: in a lamp-lit study lined with scroll shelves, an older Roman scholar in a tunic, seen from behind, reclines dictating while a secretary writes on wax tablets, a table covered with mineral samples, pressed plants, shells and a small stuffed bird. Warm, quiet light. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, red and ochre walls. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-vesuvius: 79 CE, the Bay of Naples: seen from far across the water, Mount Vesuvius erupts with a towering pine-shaped column of ash and smoke, ash falling over the small town of Pompeii with its temples and villas at the foot of the mountain, boats fleeing on the dark sea. No bodies shown. Painted in the style of a Roman landscape fresco, dark greys, ash browns and red glow. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-five-good-emperors: Around 120 CE, Rome: a peaceful, prosperous Forum of Trajan with its colonnades and great column of spiral reliefs, citizens in togas, merchants and children passing, grain carts arriving, an aged emperor in a toga, small and seen from behind, walking with officials. Golden morning light. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, warm colours and marble whites. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-dacian-wars: Around 106 CE, Sarmizegetusa Regia in the Carpathian mountains: seen from a ridge, Roman legionaries in segmented armour climb toward a Dacian stronghold of stone walls and wooden towers on a wooded mountain terrace, Dacian warriors with curved falx swords and dragon standards on the walls, smoke rising. No close-up violence. Painted in the style of the reliefs on Trajan's Column, carved stone with traces of paint. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-hadrians-wall: Around 125 CE, Northumberland: a long stone wall with a milecastle gate and turret snakes over rugged green hills and crags, Roman soldiers in cloaks and helmets building the next section with dressed stone and mortar, a supply cart on the military road, a grey northern sky. Painted in the style of a Roman provincial mosaic, greens, greys and earthy reds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-pantheon: Around 125 CE, Rome: inside the newly rebuilt Pantheon, a vast round hall under a coffered concrete dome with a round open oculus at the top letting a shaft of sunlight fall across the coloured marble floor, small groups of Romans in togas looking up in awe, wooden scaffolding still in one corner. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, warm marble tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-galen: Around 162 CE, Rome: in a public lecture hall near the Temple of Peace, a Greek physician in a himation, small and seen from behind, lectures to a crowd of physicians and citizens seated on tiered benches, a table with bronze surgical instruments, herb jars and anatomical drawings on scrolls before him. Warm lamplight. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, ochres and reds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-antonine-plague: Around 166 CE, Rome: a quiet street of tenement blocks, shuttered shops, a few people in tunics hurrying past, a funeral procession with mourners and musicians carrying a covered bier toward the city gate, smoke from distant pyres beyond the walls. Sombre grey light, no bodies shown. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-marcomannic-wars: Around 170 CE, the Danube frontier near Vindobona: a Roman legionary fort of stone walls and towers on the riverbank in winter, soldiers in cloaks patrolling, a pontoon bridge of boats across the half-frozen river, Germanic warriors gathering in the dark forest on the far bank. Snowy grey light. Painted in the style of the reliefs on the Column of Marcus Aurelius, carved stone with traces of colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-meditations: Around 170 CE, the camp at Carnuntum on the Danube: at night inside a leather command tent lit by an oil lamp, a bearded older man in a military cloak, small and seen from behind, writes alone on a wax tablet at a camp table, a helmet and scrolls beside him; through the tent opening, campfires of the legion and the dark river. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, warm lamplight and deep shadow. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-severus: 193 CE, Rome: a long column of legionaries with eagle standards marches through a city gate along a broad street, a general on horseback in a purple cloak riding at their head, small in the scene, citizens and senators in togas lining the way, temples and arches beyond. Bright, tense daylight. Painted in the style of a Severan-era Roman relief, carved stone with faded colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-constitutio-antoniniana: 212 CE, a provincial town square: a herald in a toga reads from a scroll on a speaker's platform before a mixed crowd of people from across the empire, Syrians, Gauls, Africans and Greeks in varied provincial dress, a bronze tablet being mounted on the wall of the town hall. Bright midday. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, warm colours and many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-gallic-empire: Around 260 CE, Trier on the Moselle: legionaries in cloaks and helmets cheer and raise shields before a general in a purple cloak, small and seen from behind, on a raised tribunal outside the walled city, a stone bridge across the Moselle and vineyards on the hills beyond. Overcast light. Painted in the style of a late Roman mosaic, earthy reds, ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-aurelian-walls: 271 CE, Rome: Roman labourers and soldiers in tunics build a tall brick-faced wall with square towers across the edge of the city, timber scaffolding and cranes worked by treadwheels, carts of bricks pulled by oxen, the wall cutting through suburban villas and tombs; beyond it the domes, temples and aqueduct arches of the crowded capital under a pale afternoon sky. Painted in the manner of a Roman fresco, earthy ochres and Pompeian red, soft brushwork, cracked plaster texture. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-price-edict: 301 CE, Nicomedia in Bithynia: in a colonnaded market forum, merchants in tunics and cloaks gather in front of a large blank stone slab mounted on a wall, stalls of grain, oil jars, shoes and cloth around them, a few uneasy traders arguing with a Roman official in a white toga with guards; the harbour and hills beyond in bright morning light. Rendered as a late Roman floor mosaic of small coloured tesserae, warm ochre, terracotta and blue-grey. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-great-persecution: 303 CE, Nicomedia: seen from a hillside at a distance, Roman soldiers with shields and helmets pull down the roof of a modest stone church on a rise across from the imperial palace, a cloud of dust rising, a small group of townspeople in cloaks watching quietly, scrolls being carried out in baskets; the city's colonnades and harbour below in grey dawn light. Painted in the style of a late antique Roman fresco, muted earth colours, worn plaster surface. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-edict-of-milan: 313 CE, Milan: in a columned imperial audience hall, two emperors in purple cloaks, seen small and from a distance, stand on a dais among court officials in white tunics and military commanders, a scribe holding an unrolled scroll; through open arches townspeople, including Christians with simple crosses, gather in a sunlit courtyard. Rendered as a late Roman mosaic in the manner of early Christian basilica mosaics, gold and deep blue tesserae, frontal stylised figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-edict-thessalonica: 380 CE, Thessalonica: a great domed rotunda and a new basilica rise over the harbour city; crowds of townspeople in tunics and cloaks, clergy in pale vestments and soldiers walk in procession toward the church carrying a jewelled cross, while on the edge of the scene an old pagan temple stands with its doors closed and its altar cold. Afternoon light on the Aegean. Rendered as a late Roman mosaic in gold, white and deep blue tesserae. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-vulgate: 382 CE, Rome: in a quiet lamplit study with plaster walls, an elderly scholar-monk in a coarse brown robe, seen from behind at a wooden desk, compares Greek and Hebrew scrolls with an open Latin codex, more scrolls stacked in pigeonhole shelves, a reed pen and inkpot, a lion dozing by the door; through a window the brick churches and roofs of late Roman Rome at dusk. Painted in the manner of an early medieval illuminated manuscript, gold leaf and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-rhine-crossing: 406 CE, the Rhine near Moguntiacum: on a frozen winter river, long columns of Germanic warriors and families in fur cloaks and trousers cross the ice on foot, leading horses and ox-drawn wagons loaded with goods, children bundled on carts; on the far bank a small Roman fort with a stone watchtower stands half-empty beneath a grey sky, bare forests and snow beyond. Painted as a nineteenth-century oil history painting, cold blues and whites, wide panoramic landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-end-roman-britain: 410 CE, Londinium: in the forum of a walled Roman town by the Thames, town councillors in tunics and cloaks stand around a messenger reading a sealed letter, while at the river wharf a few last Roman soldiers board a ship, the basilica's tiled roof and the stone city wall behind them; misty overcast morning, gulls over the water. Painted in the manner of a nineteenth-century English oil history painting, muted greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-augustine-city-of-god: 413 CE, Hippo Regius in Numidia: an elderly bishop in a simple dark robe, seen from behind, writes in a codex at a table in a whitewashed room of a North African church house, clerks copying beside him, oil lamps, a window opening onto the Mediterranean harbour, palm trees and the domed basilica of the town in warm evening light. Painted in the style of a Romanesque illuminated manuscript, flat gold background, red and blue pigments, bold outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-theodosian-code: 438 CE, Constantinople: in a high marble hall of the imperial palace, rows of jurists and scribes in long tunics and dalmatics sit at desks copying law texts into large bound codices, scrolls piled in baskets, a young emperor in a purple cloak watching from a distant dais among courtiers; through tall windows the domes and sea walls of the city. Rendered as an early Byzantine mosaic in gold and green tesserae, solemn frontal figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-anglo-saxons: 449 CE, Ebbsfleet on the coast of Kent: three long open wooden rowing ships with high curved prows are pulled up onto a shingle beach, warriors in wool tunics with round shields, spears and seaxes wading ashore with families, cattle and bundles; chalk cliffs, green marshland and a ruined Roman watchtower under a windy grey sky. Painted in the style of an early medieval manuscript illumination, Anglo-Saxon interlace border colours, flat earthy greens and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-romulus-augustulus: 475 CE, Ravenna: inside a brick palace hall decorated with gold mosaics, a small boy in an oversized purple imperial cloak stands on a raised dais while an armoured general and a crowd of soldiers and courtiers in tunics and cloaks acclaim him, raising shields and spears; marsh light through high windows. Rendered in the style of the Ravenna mosaics, gold ground, frontal figures in rows, green and white tesserae. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-529-corpus-juris-civilis: 529 CE, Constantinople: in a vaulted palace library, a commission of jurists in long Byzantine robes sits around a long table heaped with old law scrolls and new bound codices, scribes copying, a small figure of the emperor in a jewelled diadem and purple robe at the far end of the room; windows open onto domes and the Bosphorus. Rendered in the manner of a Byzantine mosaic in the style of San Vitale, gold background, rich purples and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-537-hagia-sophia: 537 CE, Constantinople: the vast new church of Hagia Sophia with its huge shallow dome resting on a ring of windows and half-domes stepping down, brick and stone walls not yet faced, wooden scaffolding being dismantled. In front lies a Roman-style atrium surrounded by colonnades with flat timber and tile roofs, no small domes over the porticoes, and only a simple open marble basin, no domed fountain kiosk and no minarets. Crowds of clergy with crosses and icons and townspeople in long Byzantine robes stream in for the dedication, the Bosphorus behind. Byzantine illuminated miniature style, gold ground, lapis and vermilion. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-541-plague-of-justinian: 541 CE, Constantinople: an eerily empty colonnaded street of the city, shuttered shops, a few figures in hooded cloaks hurrying past with cloths over their faces, a priest with a censer walking slowly, smoke from bonfires drifting between domed churches, idle grain ships moored in the harbour below under a heavy yellow-grey sky. Painted in the style of a Byzantine fresco, faded earth pigments and muted gold, sombre tone. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-726-byzantine-iconoclasm: 726 CE, Constantinople: in front of the bronze Chalke Gate of the imperial palace, workmen on a ladder take down a large painted icon of a saint while soldiers in Byzantine armour stand guard and a crowd of townspeople, monks and women in veils protest at a distance; whitewashed church walls marked only with a simple cross. Rendered in the manner of a Byzantine manuscript miniature such as the Chludov Psalter, gold and red pigment on parchment. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-751-pepin-crowned: 751 CE, Soissons: in a stone Frankish church lit by candles, a bishop in vestments and mitre anoints the head of a kneeling bearded warrior-king in a long tunic and cloak, Frankish nobles in mail and cloaks with swords standing around, a long-haired youth being led away tonsured at the side. Seen from the nave, figures small. Painted in the style of a Carolingian illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, purple and green, stylised figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-756-donation-of-pepin: 756 CE, Rome: on the steps of Old Saint Peter's basilica, Frankish envoys in tunics and cloaks hand a bundle of keys and a document case to a pope in pale vestments and pallium, surrounded by clergy; behind them the timber-roofed basilica and its atrium, and in the distance the hills of Rome with ruined ancient monuments. Painted in the style of a Carolingian illuminated manuscript, gold ground, red and blue figures with strong outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-800-carolingian-renaissance: 800 CE, Aachen: in the scriptorium of the palace school beside the octagonal palace chapel, monks and scholars in plain robes sit at sloping desks copying manuscripts in neat rounded script, pots of ink and gold leaf, open codices with decorated initials, a teacher lecturing to young students; the domed octagonal chapel visible through an arch. Painted as a Carolingian illuminated manuscript in the manner of the Godescalc Gospels, purple, gold and silver. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-863-cyril-and-methodius: 863 CE, Velehrad in Great Moravia: two Byzantine monks in dark robes stand in a wooden-palisaded hillfort among Slavic villagers in linen tunics and fur caps, one monk holding up a codex while the other teaches a group of young men copying letters on wax tablets; a small stone church, thatched houses and wooded hills behind in soft morning light. Painted in the style of an Orthodox icon or Byzantine fresco, gold ground, ochre and deep red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-910-cluny-abbey: 910 CE, Cluny in Burgundy: in a green valley, Benedictine monks in black habits lay out and build a new abbey church of pale stone with round Romanesque arches, masons on wooden scaffolds, a cloister taking shape, vineyards and wooded hills around, a few monks chanting in procession; gentle autumn light. Painted in the style of a Romanesque illuminated manuscript, flat gold and deep blue, bold ink outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-929-caliphate-of-cordoba: 929 CE, Cordoba: the great mosque with its forest of red-and-white striped horseshoe arches on stone columns, scholars and students in turbans and robes seated on mats reading and copying books, oil lamps hanging; through the arches a courtyard of orange trees and the city's flat roofs and the Roman bridge over the Guadalquivir. Painted as an Andalusian Islamic manuscript illustration, fine line, gold, lapis blue and terracotta. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-966-baptism-of-poland: 966 CE, Gniezno: a wooden Slavic stronghold on a hill above lakes and forests, a newly built small stone chapel, a bishop in vestments baptising a duke in a white garment at a stone font, warriors in mail and fur-trimmed cloaks and townspeople in linen gathered around holding candles; misty spring morning. Figures small. Painted in the style of a Romanesque illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, red and green, strong outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-987-hugh-capet: 987 CE, Noyon: in a plain Romanesque stone hall with round arches and a timber roof, Frankish nobles in long wool tunics and fur-trimmed cloaks and bishops in low early mitres raise their hands in acclaim around a standing bearded man in a simple gold circlet crown and blue mantle, torches on the walls, seen from across the hall so all figures are small. No heraldry of any kind: no coats of arms, no fleur-de-lis, no lions, no armorial banners or shields on the walls. Painted in the style of an Ottonian or Carolingian manuscript miniature, gold background, ultramarine and vermilion. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-988-baptism-of-rus: 988 CE, Kyiv: seen from a high bank at a distance, crowds of townspeople in long white linen shirts stand waist-deep in the broad Dnieper river, fully clothed, as Byzantine priests in gold vestments on the shore raise crosses and censers; wooden houses, palisades and the hill of Kyiv behind, a prince and his retinue on horseback watching. Painted in the style of a medieval Russian icon, gold ground, ochre, cinnabar and green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1000-kingdom-of-hungary: 1000 CE, Esztergom: on a castle hill above the Danube, inside a small Romanesque stone church, an archbishop in vestments places a gold crown on a kneeling king in a long embroidered mantle, Magyar nobles in fur caps and kaftans and clergy watching; through the doorway the wide river and plains. Figures small. Painted in the style of a medieval Hungarian illuminated chronicle miniature, gold ground, red and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1086-domesday-book: 1086 CE, an English village near Winchester: royal commissioners in Norman tunics and cloaks sit at a trestle table under an oak tree recording on parchment while a reeve, villagers in wool smocks and a priest stand before them, counting ploughs, oxen and pigs; thatched cottages, a stone church, fields and a mill under a cloudy sky. Rendered in the manner of the Bayeux Tapestry, wool embroidery on linen, ochre, green and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1096-first-crusade: 1096 CE, a road in France: a long column of knights in mail hauberks and conical helmets with cloth crosses sewn on their cloaks rides out under banners, followed by foot soldiers, priests, pilgrims and ox-carts of supplies, a Romanesque abbey and the walled town of Clermont behind them on the hills; early summer morning. Painted in the style of a medieval French illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, ultramarine and vermilion, stylised figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1122-concordat-of-worms: 1122 CE, Worms: on a meadow beside the Rhine outside the walled city and its Romanesque cathedral, a German emperor in crown and mantle and papal legates in red vestments stand before a large assembly of nobles and bishops, exchanging a sealed parchment while a crosier and a sceptre are displayed; banners and tents. Figures small. Painted in the style of a twelfth-century German illuminated manuscript, gold ground, red and green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1130-toledo-translators: 1130 CE, Toledo: in a vaulted room with horseshoe arches, a Jewish scholar, a Mozarab Christian and a Latin cleric sit together at a table among Arabic and Latin books, one reading aloud from an Arabic manuscript of astronomy, another writing, an astrolabe and geometric diagrams before them; through a window the hill city above the Tagus river. Painted in the style of a medieval Castilian manuscript miniature, gold, red and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1144-gothic-architecture: 1144 CE, Saint-Denis near Paris: the newly finished choir of the abbey church, pointed arches and slender ribbed vaults soaring above a ring of chapels, sunlight pouring through tall stained-glass windows in deep blues and reds onto a crowd of monks, bishops and nobles at the dedication; masons' tools still near the walls. Painted in the style of a French Gothic illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, ultramarine and ruby tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1202-liber-abaci: Pisa in 1202, an early Italian panel-painting style: Leonardo of Pisa in a merchant's room shows Pisan traders his book, which displays Hindu-Arabic numerals, beside a traditional lined counting board with loose counters, coins and a balance scale. There is no bead-frame abacus. Through an arch you see the Romanesque cathedral and its baptistery under construction. The bell tower is only a short unfinished stump of about three arcaded storeys, not a tall finished leaning tower. Galleys sit on the Arno. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1209-franciscans: 1209 CE, Assisi: on a dusty road below the hill town, a small group of barefoot friars in rough grey-brown tunics tied with knotted cords walk together and preach to peasants, a beggar receiving bread, olive groves, the town walls and a small chapel in the Umbrian hills behind; warm evening light. Figures small. Painted in the manner of a Giotto-style Italian fresco, soft blues and ochres, simple solid figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1212-las-navas-de-tolosa: 1212 CE, Las Navas de Tolosa: seen from a ridge at a great distance, armies of Christian knights in mail with heraldic banners advance across a rocky plain in the Sierra Morena toward a vast Almohad camp of tents and a red pavilion ringed by defenders, dust clouds rising; pine-dotted mountains under a hot summer sky. Painted in the style of a Castilian medieval illuminated manuscript such as the Cantigas, gold, vermilion and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1242-battle-on-the-ice: 1242 CE, Lake Peipus: on a snow-covered frozen lake under a pale winter sky, a wedge of Teutonic knights in white mantles with black crosses and great helms charges toward a line of Novgorodian warriors in conical helmets and mail with red shields and banners, seen from far off, forests on the shore. No blood. Painted in the style of a Russian medieval icon or chronicle miniature, gold ground, cinnabar and ochre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1265-summa-theologica: 1265 CE, Rome: in a cloister of the Dominican convent of Santa Sabina, a heavy-set friar in a white habit and black cloak, seen from behind, dictates at a writing desk while several younger friars write on parchment, books stacked, an old Roman basilica with tall windows beside the cloister garden; clear afternoon light. Painted in the style of an Italian Gothic fresco, soft ochre, rose and blue, solid figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1291-swiss-confederation: 1291 CE, Schwyz: in a high Alpine meadow at dusk, a group of mountain farmers and local leaders in wool tunics, hooded capes and caps stand together with raised hands swearing an oath, halberds and crossbows at hand, wooden chalets, a lake and snow-capped peaks behind; seen from a distance. Painted in the style of a late medieval Swiss illustrated chronicle, pen and watercolour, bright greens and blues. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1295-model-parliament: 1295 CE, Westminster: in the great timber-roofed hall of the palace, a king in crown and robes sits enthroned at the far end while rows of barons in heraldic surcoats, bishops in mitres and knights and townsmen in plain gowns sit on benches before him, clerks writing at a table in the centre. Viewed from the back of the hall, figures small. Painted in the style of an English Gothic illuminated manuscript, gold leaf and bright heraldic colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1302-estates-general: 1302 CE, Paris: in the nave of Notre-Dame cathedral, a French king in a blue mantle with gold fleurs-de-lis sits on a dais, with three groups before him: clergy in vestments, nobles in heraldic surcoats and townsmen in plain gowns and hoods; Gothic pillars and stained-glass windows overhead. Figures small, seen from the side. Painted in the style of a French Gothic illuminated manuscript, gold, ultramarine and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1309-avignon-papacy: 1309 CE, Avignon: a massive fortress-like palace of pale stone with crenellated towers rises on a rock above the Rhône, the half-ruined arched bridge crossing the river, cardinals in red robes and clerics arriving by boat and on mules, merchants on the quay; bright Provençal sunlight. Painted in the style of a French Gothic illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, blue sky pattern, fine detailed architecture. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1320-divine-comedy: 1320 CE, Ravenna: in a modest stone room near a Byzantine church, a thin poet in a long red gown and hood, seen from behind, writes at a desk by candlelight, finished manuscript pages piled beside him, a window open onto the brick bell tower and a pine forest by the sea at night with stars. Painted in the style of an Italian Trecento illuminated manuscript, gold leaf, deep blues and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1356-hanseatic-league: 1356 CE, Lübeck: a busy harbour on the Trave river with brick warehouses with stepped gables, tall brick church spires, several round-bellied cog ships with single square sails and castles at the stern loading barrels, bales of cloth and furs; merchants in fur-trimmed gowns and hoods meeting at the quay. Morning light. Painted in the style of a late medieval German illuminated manuscript or Flemish miniature, fine detail, warm brick reds and blues. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1356-golden-bull: 1356 CE, Nuremberg: in a Gothic imperial hall, an emperor in crown and fur-trimmed mantle sits enthroned with seven prince-electors in red ermine-trimmed robes seated in a row, some archbishops in mitres; a clerk holds up a document hung with a large golden seal on a cord. Seen from afar, figures small. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century German illuminated manuscript, gold ground, red and blue heraldic colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1380-battle-of-kulikovo: 1380 CE, Kulikovo Field: seen from a distant hill, two great armies meet on a misty open plain at the meeting of two rivers, Russian warriors in conical helmets and mail with red shields and banners bearing holy images on one side, Golden Horde horsemen with bows and banners on the other; morning mist lifting, forests behind. No blood. Painted in the style of a Russian icon or illuminated chronicle, gold ground, cinnabar and ochre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1381-peasants-revolt: 1381 CE, London: a crowd of peasants in hoods, tunics and leggings carrying scythes, pitchforks and bows and banners marches across a field at Smithfield toward a small group of royal horsemen, the city wall, gates and the spire of Old Saint Paul's cathedral behind; summer daylight. Seen from a distance. Painted in the style of a late fourteenth-century Froissart chronicle illumination, gold, blue and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1389-battle-of-kosovo: 1389 CE, Kosovo Field: seen from a far ridge, two medieval armies face each other across a wide summer plain, Serbian knights in plate and mail with banners on one side, Ottoman troops with tall white caps, crescent standards, archers and cavalry on the other, dust and smoke rising over the field, low hills behind. No blood. Painted in the style of an Ottoman miniature painting, flat bright colours, gold sky, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1410-battle-of-grunwald: 1410 CE, Grunwald: seen from a distance, vast armies clash on rolling fields between woods, Polish and Lithuanian knights with banners bearing a white eagle and a mounted knight charging into Teutonic Knights in white mantles with black crosses, dust and smoke rising, villages burning faintly on the horizon. No blood. Painted in the style of a fifteenth-century illuminated chronicle miniature, gold, red and white. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1419-hussite-wars: 1419 CE, Bohemia near Prague: on a hilltop, a Hussite war-wagon fort of wooden wagons chained in a circle, peasant soldiers in plain tunics with flails, pikes and early handguns behind them, a priest holding up a large chalice banner; below, the towers and spires of Prague and the Vltava river. Seen from afar. Painted in the style of a fifteenth-century Bohemian illuminated manuscript, gold, red and green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1436-florence-cathedral-dome: 1436 CE, Florence: the vast red-brick dome with white marble ribs rises over the terracotta roofs of the city, the lantern not yet built, a crane and wooden hoist on top, workmen in tunics on the ribs, crowds in the cathedral square below in festive dress for the consecration; the Arno and Tuscan hills behind in clear light. Painted as an early Renaissance Italian tempera painting, gold-touched, fine perspective. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1455-wars-of-the-roses: 1455 CE, St Albans: in the narrow streets of a market town with timber-framed houses and a great abbey church, soldiers in plate armour and livery jackets with banners bearing white and red roses push through barricades, archers on rooftops, townspeople fleeing into doorways; smoke and dust, seen from above at a distance. No blood. Painted in the style of a fifteenth-century Flemish chronicle illumination, gold, crimson and blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1469-catholic-monarchs: 1469, Valladolid: in a modest candlelit hall of a Castilian town palace with carved wooden ceilings and tapestries, a young prince and princess in rich brocade gowns and velvet stand hand in hand before an archbishop in a mitre, a small group of Castilian and Aragonese nobles and ladies in fifteenth-century dress around them. Seen from the back of the hall, figures small. Painted in the style of a Spanish-Flemish late Gothic altarpiece, oil on gilded wood, rich reds and golds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1480-great-stand-on-the-ugra: 1480, the Ugra River: in a flat autumn landscape of birch forests, a Muscovite army in quilted coats, pointed helmets and red caftans with banners and early cannon stands along one bank of a slow river, while across the water a camp of Tatar horsemen with bows and felt tents waits; neither side crosses, mist over the water, first snow in the air. Painted in the style of a Russian illuminated chronicle miniature, gold, cinnabar and green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1494-treaty-of-tordesillas: 1494, Tordesillas: in a whitewashed Castilian hall with a carved wooden ceiling, Spanish and Portuguese envoys in dark velvet gowns and caps lean over a large table covered with a hand-drawn sea chart showing coastlines and a single vertical line drawn down the ocean, compasses, a globe and sealed documents beside them; the Duero river through the window. Painted in the style of a late fifteenth-century Spanish oil painting, fine detail, deep reds and blacks. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1494-italian-wars: 1494, Naples: a long French army of armoured knights, Swiss pikemen and bronze cannon on wheeled carriages pulled by horses marches along a coastal road toward the walled city of Naples, the castle by the sea and Mount Vesuvius rising behind, townspeople watching from the walls; bright southern sunlight. Seen from a hillside at a distance. Painted in the style of an Italian Renaissance cassone painting, tempera and gold, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
eu-1498-last-supper: 1498, Milan: in the long whitewashed refectory of a Dominican convent, an artist in a long robe stands on a wooden scaffold before a large wall painting of a long table with thirteen seated figures, seen from behind and far off; friars in black and white habits sit at plain dining tables below watching, pots of paint and brushes on the scaffold, light from high windows.
