me-dammam-no-7: 1938, Dhahran in eastern Arabia: a tall wooden-and-steel drilling derrick stands on a barren limestone hill (the Dammam dome) above the desert, American drillers in khaki and Saudi workers in robes and headcloths gather around as dark oil gushes into a pit, tents, pipes, a few trucks and camels nearby under a hot white sky. Painted as a 1930s documentary watercolour, sandy ochres and blacks. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-un-partition-plan: 1947, Lake Success, New York: inside a converted factory hall serving as the temporary UN General Assembly, rows of delegates in dark suits sit at long desks with name cards (illegible) and headphones, a few raising their hands to vote, a raised presidium table under bright lights, press photographers in the gallery; small figures seen from the back. Painted as a 1940s documentary gouache illustration, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-first-arab-israeli-war: 1948, the hills around Jerusalem: seen from a distant ridge, the old stone walls and domes of Jerusalem rise under drifting smoke, armoured cars and trucks move along a winding road through terraced hills and pine woods, soldiers in khaki crouch behind stone barricades; no gore, figures small, a hazy summer afternoon. Painted as a 1940s documentary watercolour, muted khaki and stone colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-nakba: 1948, Jaffa: on the shore below the old stone town with its clock tower and minaret, crowds of Palestinian Arab families with bundles, suitcases and children crowd onto small wooden boats heading out to sea, others walking along a coastal road with carts and donkeys; orange groves behind, a grey spring sky, figures seen from behind and at a distance. Painted as a sombre 1940s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-iraq-14-july-revolution: 1958, Baghdad: early morning on a broad boulevard by the Tigris, army trucks and soldiers in khaki uniforms with rifles take up positions, crowds of men in shirts gather to listen to a radio loudspeaker on a pole, palm trees, domes and modern government buildings behind in hazy summer light; figures small, no violence shown. Painted as a 1950s documentary gouache illustration, warm muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-opec-founded: 1960, Baghdad: in a modest conference room with tall windows overlooking palms and the Tigris, delegates in dark suits sit around a polished table with papers, water carafes and ashtrays, seen from a distance with no recognisable faces; a map of the world on the wall and an oil derrick model on a side table. All writing illegible. Painted as a 1960s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-uae-founded: 2 December 1971, Dubai: on a sandy Gulf shore beside a low white fort and a few new concrete buildings, groups of Emirati men in white kanduras and headcloths watch the new flag of the United Arab Emirates rise on a tall pole: a red vertical band at the hoist and three horizontal stripes of green, white and black, not a plain red flag. Traditional dhows in the turquoise water, palm trees, pale winter sky; figures small, seen at a distance. Painted as a 1970s documentary watercolour, soft light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-oil-crisis-1973: 1973: on a coastal oil terminal near Kuwait City, idle oil tankers wait at anchor beyond long empty loading piers, storage tanks and flare stacks on the desert shore, a few workers in overalls walking along the pipes under a hazy orange evening sky. Painted as a 1970s documentary gouache illustration, muted industrial colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-lebanese-civil-war: c. 1976, Beirut: seen from a distance, a once-elegant seafront street of Ottoman and modern apartment buildings stands scarred and empty, sandbags and a barricade of burnt-out cars across the road, laundry on a balcony, palms, the Mediterranean and the snow-capped Lebanon mountains beyond; smoke rising far off, no people up close. Painted as a 1970s documentary watercolour, sombre muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-grand-mosque-seizure: 1979, Mecca: a distant view at dawn across the city's surrounding hills to the great courtyard and arcaded walls of the Grand Mosque with its minarets, wisps of smoke rising, security vehicles lined along an empty street in the foreground; no people shown close, no figures inside the mosque. Painted as a restrained 1970s documentary watercolour, muted greys and golds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-iran-iraq-war: c. 1982, the marshes and desert east of Basra: seen from far off, a long line of earthen trenches and sandbag walls zig-zags across a flat plain beside a reed-fringed waterway, tanks dug in, smoke drifting from distant palm groves along the Shatt al-Arab; no bodies, figures tiny. Painted as a sombre 1980s documentary watercolour, ochre and grey. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-first-intifada: 1987, Gaza: a narrow sandy street of a refugee camp with cinderblock houses, corrugated roofs and walls of painted patterns (no legible slogans), shops shuttered during a strike, a few young people in the distance near a smouldering tyre, a military jeep at the end of the street, washing lines and a dusty winter sky. Figures small and not identifiable. Painted as a 1980s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-oslo-accords: 1993, Washington, D.C.: a wide view of a sunny lawn before a white neoclassical mansion with a columned portico, rows of seated guests on folding chairs and journalists with cameras, a small table with documents on a platform at the far end, figures tiny and unrecognisable, an American flag and trees in September light. Painted as a 1990s documentary gouache illustration, soft colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-iraq-war: 2003, Baghdad: seen from across the Tigris at night, the city skyline of domes, minarets and concrete towers is lit by distant flashes and anti-aircraft tracers, plumes of smoke rising over government buildings, palm trees in silhouette on the near bank; no people shown. Painted as a sombre documentary gouache illustration, deep blues and orange glows. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-islamic-state-mosul: 2014, Mosul: a quiet distant view from the eastern bank across the Tigris to the old city with its stone houses, domes and the famous leaning brick minaret of al-Nuri, smoke rising from the outskirts, an abandoned checkpoint and empty road in the foreground; no people, no flags or symbols. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, grey and sandstone tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-yemeni-civil-war: 2014, Sanaa: the old city of tall mudbrick tower houses decorated with white gypsum friezes and stained-glass windows, seen from a hillside at dusk, with smoke rising from the outskirts and a few empty streets below; the bare mountains of Yemen behind, no people shown. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm brown and white with a sombre sky. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-gaza-war: 2023, Gaza: a wide, distant view of a coastal city of concrete apartment blocks under a heavy grey sky, many buildings damaged, dust and smoke drifting over the skyline toward the Mediterranean, an empty road in the foreground; no people, no weapons, no flags. Painted as a restrained documentary watercolour in muted greys and sand tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-turkey-syria-earthquake: 2023, southern Turkey near Kahramanmaraş: on a cold February morning, a distant view of a town of collapsed and tilted apartment blocks under light snow, rescue cranes and excavators among the rubble, small anonymous figures in helmets and hi-vis jackets working, tents set up in a field and grey mountains behind. Painted as a restrained documentary watercolour, muted greys and orange accents. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
me-fall-of-assad: 2024, Damascus: a December dawn view from Mount Qasioun over the sprawling city, minarets and domes of the old city and the Umayyad Mosque among modern blocks, light mist over the streets, abandoned military vehicles on a road in the foreground; no people, no flags or symbols. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft winter light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-stallings-island-pottery: c. 2500 BCE, Stallings Island on the Savannah River: on a wooded shoal island littered with mussel shells, Archaic hunter-gatherer women in deerskin skirts shape thick bowls of clay mixed with Spanish moss fibre and press dotted and punctate patterns into them, a fire pit with pots, dugout canoes on the river bank, oak and cypress trees in soft morning light. Painted as a naturalistic documentary watercolour in earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-arctic-small-tool: c. 2500 BCE, Cape Denbigh in Alaska: on a windswept tundra headland above the Bering Sea, a small group of Arctic hunters in fur parkas sit by skin tents flaking tiny stone microblades and arrowheads, harpoons and caribou hides around them, pack ice on the grey sea and low mountains under a pale summer sky. No horses. Painted as a documentary watercolour with muted Arctic tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-eastern-agricultural-complex: c. 1800 BCE, a river valley in Kentucky: Native women and men in deerskin clothing tend small garden plots on a terrace above the river, gathering squash, sunflowers, goosefoot and marsh elder into woven baskets, bark-covered huts and storage pits nearby, hardwood forest and a rock shelter behind in late summer light. No horses, no metal. Painted as a naturalistic documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-dorset-culture: c. 500 BCE, near Cape Dorset in the Canadian Arctic: on sea ice beside a cluster of domed snow houses, Dorset hunters in fur clothing wait at a seal breathing hole with harpoons, soapstone lamps glowing inside a shelter, a small carved ivory amulet hanging at a hunter's chest; no dogs, no sleds pulled by dogs, low winter sun over the white bay. Painted as a documentary watercolour in cool blues and whites. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-newark-earthworks: c. 100 CE, Newark, Ohio: a bird's-eye view at moonrise over vast geometric earthworks on a river terrace, a great circle enclosure joined by long parallel embankment walls to an octagon, Hopewell people in woven garments and copper ornaments walking along the walls in procession, forests of oak and hickory around; the full moon rising on the horizon. No horses. Painted as a naturalistic documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-crow-creek-massacre: c. 1325, Crow Creek on the Missouri River: seen from a distant bluff, a village of earth lodges inside a timber palisade and ditch on a terrace above the wide river, smoke rising from burning lodges, grassland and bluffs around under a grey sky; no figures or bodies shown up close, no horses. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, muted prairie colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-virginia-assembly: 1619, Jamestown, Virginia: inside a small timber-framed church with a thatched roof, about two dozen English colonists in doublets, ruffs and tall hats sit on wooden pews, with a governor's officials at a table at the front; light through small windows, the palisaded settlement, river and moored ships glimpsed through an open door on a hot summer day. Painted as a seventeenth-century style engraving, finely hatched. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-massachusetts-bay: 1630, the Shawmut peninsula, Boston: English Puritan families in dark clothes, white collars and tall hats come ashore from wooden ships anchored in the harbour, unloading barrels and cattle, a few timber cottages and a meetinghouse under construction on a hilly wooded shore, a cool June sky. Painted as a seventeenth-century Dutch-style oil painting of a colonial shore, soft greens and browns. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-hudsons-bay-company: c. 1670s, the shore of Hudson Bay: a small wooden trading post with a palisade and flagpole stands on flat marshy shore, Cree hunters in leather clothing and blankets paddle birchbark canoes loaded with beaver pelts to meet English traders in coats and hats, a three-masted ship anchored in the grey bay. Painted as an eighteenth-century documentary engraving with watercolour tints. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-salem-witch-trials: 1692, Salem, Massachusetts: inside a crowded timber meetinghouse, Puritan villagers in dark clothes and white caps fill wooden benches as magistrates in black robes sit behind a long table, an accused woman standing small before them seen from behind; gray winter light from small-paned windows. No violence. Painted as a nineteenth-century history engraving, fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-pontiacs-war: 1763, Fort Detroit: a wooden palisaded British fort with blockhouses beside the Detroit River, seen from a distant wooded bank where Odawa, Ojibwe and Potawatomi warriors in leggings, blankets and feathers gather around a council fire, birchbark canoes on the shore; smoke from the fort's chimneys, summer forest. Painted as a documentary eighteenth-century engraving with watercolour wash. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-first-continental-congress: 1774, Philadelphia: inside Carpenters' Hall, a Georgian brick hall with tall windows, colonial delegates in powdered wigs, waistcoats and tricorn hats sit in Windsor chairs around tables with quills and papers, one standing to speak; autumn daylight, small figures, no recognisable faces. All writing illegible. Painted as an eighteenth-century American oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-common-sense: 1776, Philadelphia: a busy printing shop with a wooden hand press, apprentices inking type and hanging freshly printed sheets to dry, stacks of small pamphlets on a counter, colonists in tricorn hats and waistcoats crowding at the door to buy them, a brick street and a church steeple outside in winter light. All writing illegible. Painted as an eighteenth-century engraving with hand-colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-loyalists-to-canada: 1783, the mouth of the Saint John River, New Brunswick: sailing transports at anchor in a rocky bay, Loyalist families in eighteenth-century coats, bonnets and shawls come ashore in rowboats with trunks and furniture, canvas tents and log huts going up among spruce forest on the hillside, a grey spring sky. Painted as an eighteenth-century topographical watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-bill-of-rights: 1791, Federal Hall, New York City: the columned facade of the Federal Hall on Wall Street with a balcony, carriages and people in tricorn hats, waistcoats and gowns on the cobbled street, a church spire beyond; inside a window, members of Congress at desks with quill pens. All writing illegible. Painted as an eighteenth-century engraving with soft hand-colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-cotton-gin: 1793, a plantation near Savannah, Georgia: in a wooden shed, a hand-cranked wooden cotton gin with wire teeth and a rotating drum separates seeds from white cotton bolls, enslaved workers in plain clothes carrying baskets of cotton from fields outside, live oaks with Spanish moss beyond; a hot humid afternoon. Painted as a late eighteenth-century documentary engraving with watercolour wash. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-war-of-1812: 1812, Queenston Heights on the Niagara River: seen from across the river gorge, British redcoats, Canadian militia and Haudenosaunee warriors advance up the steep wooded escarpment while American troops in blue coats hold the heights, musket smoke drifting, boats on the river below, autumn foliage. No gore. Painted as an early nineteenth-century oil history painting, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-missouri-compromise: 1820, Washington, D.C.: inside the semicircular chamber of the House of Representatives in the Capitol, lit by a great chandelier, congressmen in tailcoats and cravats sit at mahogany desks with papers while one stands to speak, a gallery of spectators above, red drapery and Corinthian columns. All writing illegible. Painted as an early nineteenth-century oil painting in the manner of Samuel Morse's House of Representatives. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-monroe-doctrine: 1823, Washington, D.C.: in a candlelit study of a white mansion, statesmen in dark tailcoats and high collars stand around a large globe and a map of the Americas spread on a table, one with a paper in hand, seen small from behind; tall windows onto a December lawn. All writing illegible. Painted as an early nineteenth-century American oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-rebellions-of-1837: 1837, Saint-Denis on the Richelieu River, Lower Canada: seen from a snowy field, French-Canadian Patriotes in tuques, woollen sashes and homespun coats with muskets defend a stone house, while British redcoats advance along the riverside road, musket smoke over the village church steeple; grey November sky, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated engraving. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-morse-telegraph: 1844, Washington, D.C.: inside a high-ceilinged room in the Capitol, a small brass telegraph key and register with a paper tape stands on a table, a few men in tailcoats and a woman in a bonnet gathered around watching, wires leading out a window to poles running across a field toward Baltimore. Writing illegible. Painted as a nineteenth-century engraving with hand-colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-seneca-falls: 1848, Seneca Falls, New York: inside the brick Wesleyan Chapel, about three hundred women in bonnets and long dresses and some men in tailcoats fill wooden pews, a woman speaking at the pulpit seen from behind, papers on a table, summer light through tall windows. All writing illegible. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-thirteenth-amendment: 1865, Washington, D.C.: the packed gallery of the House of Representatives, men in frock coats and women in bonnets, including Black spectators, rise and wave hats and handkerchiefs in celebration as the vote passes, congressmen on the floor below at desks, the domed Capitol architecture with flags. Painted as an 1860s illustrated weekly engraving, such as Harper's Weekly. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-canadian-confederation: 1867, Ottawa: on a sunny July day, crowds in Victorian dresses, top hats and soldiers in red coats gather on the hill before the new Gothic Revival Parliament Buildings with their tall central tower, a cannon salute smoke, flags (no legible emblems) and bunting, the Ottawa River below. Painted as a Victorian-era illustrated newspaper engraving with hand-colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-alaska-purchase: 1867, Sitka, Alaska: on a hill above the harbour stands a log governor's house, Russian soldiers in dark uniforms and American soldiers in blue coats face each other in formation as one flag is lowered and another raised, onion-domed Russian Orthodox church below, Tlingit people watching from canoes, forested mountains and a grey October sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-red-river-rebellion: 1869, Red River near Fort Garry: a stone fort with round bastions on the prairie by a river, Métis men in woven sashes, capotes and fur caps gather with rifles and Red River carts outside the gate, log houses and a church spire beyond, a cold November sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated engraving with watercolour tints. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-telephone: 1876, Boston: a cluttered attic workshop with gas lamps, wires, batteries in glass jars and a wooden table bearing an early telephone with a funnel-shaped mouthpiece, a man in a waistcoat seen from behind speaking into it, an assistant in another room visible through a doorway listening at a receiver. Painted as a nineteenth-century scientific engraving, fine hatching. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-edison-light-bulb: 1879, Menlo Park, New Jersey: the long upstairs room of a wooden laboratory at night, shelves of glass bottles and jars, an organ at one end, workers in shirtsleeves gather around a table where a single glass bulb glows warmly, vacuum pumps and wires nearby, snow outside the windows. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with warm tint. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-chinese-exclusion-act: 1882, the waterfront of San Francisco Bay: a Pacific steamship docks at a wooden wharf, Chinese labourers in loose jackets, queues and conical hats stand with bundles and baskets before customs officers in dark uniforms who bar the gangway; hilly town of wooden buildings behind, gulls and grey fog. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-north-west-rebellion: 1885, Batoche on the South Saskatchewan River: seen from a distant hill, Canadian militia in dark uniforms with a Gatling gun advance across prairie toward a Métis village of log houses and a white wooden church with a bell tower, Métis riflemen in rifle pits along the riverbank, smoke drifting; spring prairie, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-haymarket-affair: 1886, Chicago: at night in Haymarket Square, among brick warehouses lit by gas lamps, a large crowd of workers in caps and coats listens to a speaker on a wagon, a line of police in helmets advances at the far end of the street, a burst of smoke in the distance; no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dark ink. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-klondike-gold-rush: 1898, Dawson City, Yukon: a boomtown of log cabins, wooden false-front stores and canvas tents on the flat at the junction of the Klondike and Yukon rivers, prospectors in fur caps and mackinaws with packs, sled dogs and riverboats, a sternwheeler steamer at the bank; the mountainside of spruce behind in a cool summer light. Painted as a documentary watercolour with ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-spanish-american-war: 1898, Havana harbour: at night, the wreck of a white American battleship burns and settles in the harbour waters, smoke and orange flame rising, small boats rowing near, the stone Morro Castle fortress and lighthouse on the headland and the colonial city lights beyond. No figures in detail, no red cloth in water. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with colour tint. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-wright-brothers: 1903, Kill Devil Hills near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina: on a cold windy December morning, a fragile wooden-and-muslin biplane rises a few feet above the sand off a wooden launching rail, one man lying on the lower wing, another in a cap and coat running alongside, a wooden shed and dunes behind under a grey sky. Painted as an early twentieth-century documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-san-francisco-earthquake: 1906, San Francisco: seen from a hill, rows of Victorian houses and brick buildings lie collapsed and burning, columns of thick smoke rising over the city toward the bay, people in Edwardian clothes with bundles and carts walking up the street in the foreground, a cable car stopped on the tracks. No gore. Painted as an early twentieth-century documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-naacp-founded: 1909, New York City: a meeting room in a Manhattan building, Black and white men and women in Edwardian suits, high collars and wide hats sit around a long table with papers and inkwells, one man speaking, a window onto brick buildings and elevated railway; soft spring light, small figures. All writing illegible. Painted as an early twentieth-century watercolour with ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-ford-assembly-line: 1913, Highland Park, Michigan: inside a vast factory with skylights and steel columns, a long line of Model T chassis moves on a conveyor as workers in caps and overalls fit wheels and engines at stations, overhead belts and pulleys, finished black cars waiting at the end of the hall. Painted as an early twentieth-century industrial lithograph illustration, warm sepia tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-vimy-ridge: 1917, Vimy Ridge in northern France: on a snowy April dawn, Canadian infantry in khaki uniforms and brodie helmets advance up a churned, cratered slope behind a creeping barrage, smoke and sleet over the ridge, broken trees and barbed wire; no bodies, figures small at a distance. Painted as a First World War war artist's documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-nineteenth-amendment: 1920, Washington, D.C.: suffragists in long coats and wide-brimmed hats gather on the steps of a neoclassical building, holding plain purple, white and gold banners without lettering, celebrating with raised arms, a few carrying bouquets and small pennants, a horse-drawn cart and early motor cars at the kerb, a grand domed building and trees in summer light behind. Painted as a 1920s lithograph illustration with soft colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-prohibition: 1920, a city street in the United States: federal agents in suits and fedoras pour barrels of whisky down a storm drain in front of a closed brick saloon, a small crowd of men and women watching, Model T cars parked along the curb; a grey January day. Painted as a 1920s illustration in lithograph style, muted colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-harlem-renaissance: c. 1925, Harlem, New York City: at night on Lenox Avenue, brownstone buildings and a glowing nightclub entrance under bright electric lights, a small jazz band with trumpet, saxophone and piano visible through a window, elegantly dressed Black men in suits and fedoras and women in cloche hats and beaded dresses on the sidewalk, a few reading poetry pamphlets. Signs illegible. Painted in a 1920s Art Deco-influenced gouache illustration, in the spirit of Aaron Douglas. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-dust-bowl: c. 1935, the Oklahoma Panhandle: a vast black wall of dust rolls across the flat plain toward a lone wooden farmhouse, windmill and barn half-buried in drifting sand, a farm family in overalls and print dresses loading a battered Model T truck with mattresses and furniture, fence posts sunk in dunes. Painted as a 1930s American regionalist lithograph, sepia and grey tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-statute-of-westminster: 1931, Ottawa: the Gothic Revival Parliament Buildings with the tall Peace Tower on the hill above the frozen Ottawa River on a snowy December day, a few men in overcoats and fedoras climbing the steps, cars of the period parked along the street, a flag (no legible emblem) on the tower. Painted as a 1930s documentary watercolour in cool winter tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-japanese-internment: 1942, Manzanar in the Owens Valley, California: rows of tar-paper barracks in a dusty desert camp behind barbed-wire fences, a watchtower at the corner, Japanese American families in coats and hats carrying suitcases and bundles walk between the barracks, the snow-capped Sierra Nevada rising steeply behind under a bright, windy sky. Painted as a 1940s documentary watercolour, muted ochre and blue-grey. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-un-charter: 1945, San Francisco: inside the War Memorial Veterans Building, delegates in dark suits from many nations sit at long tables with flags (no legible emblems) behind them, one at a time stepping up to a round table to sign a thick document under bright lights, press photographers waiting; tall windows onto a sunny June day. All writing illegible. Painted as a 1940s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-truman-doctrine: 1947, Washington, D.C.: a wide view of the House chamber in the Capitol at a joint session, congressmen in dark suits filling semicircular rows, a man at the rostrum seen small from the back of the hall, radio microphones before him, a large flag behind and the press gallery above. Painted as a 1940s documentary gouache illustration, muted blues and browns. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-mccarthyism: c. 1950, Washington, D.C.: a crowded Senate hearing room with high ceilings and chandeliers, a long committee table with microphones and stacks of folders, a witness at a small table seen from behind, press photographers with flash bulbs and newsreel cameras on tripods, spectators in suits and hats. All writing illegible. Painted as a 1950s documentary charcoal and watercolour illustration, grey tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-brown-v-board: 1954, Topeka, Kansas: a red-brick elementary school with tall windows, Black and white children in 1950s dresses and trousers with satchels walk together up the front steps on a sunny morning, parents watching from the sidewalk, big elm trees and a few period cars parked along the street. Painted as a 1950s documentary watercolour, warm and calm. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-quiet-revolution: c. 1960, Quebec City: a modern new public school building rises beside the old stone walls and steep copper roofs of the city, schoolchildren in coats and caps walk in with a lay teacher while a nun watches from the steps of an old convent across the street, the St. Lawrence River and Château-style roofs behind in autumn light. Painted as a 1960s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-jfk-assassination: 1963, Dealey Plaza in Dallas, Texas: a distant elevated view of a sunny November noon, a motorcade of dark open-topped limousines and police motorcycles rolls along a curving street past a grassy knoll and a red-brick book depository building, crowds of onlookers along the curbs; figures tiny and unrecognisable, no violence shown. Painted as a 1960s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-civil-rights-act: 1964, Washington, D.C.: in the East Room of a white mansion, a crowd of men and women in 1960s suits and dresses, Black and white, stand behind a small desk with a row of pens and a document as it is signed, chandeliers and gold drapes above, television cameras and press at the side; figures seen from behind. All writing illegible. Painted as a 1960s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-arpanet: 1969, UCLA in Los Angeles: a small computer lab with linoleum floor and fluorescent lights, a refrigerator-sized grey interface cabinet beside a large mainframe computer with tape reels, a teletype terminal on a desk, two young men in short-sleeved shirts seen from behind typing late at night. All text illegible. Painted as a 1960s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-stonewall-riots: 1969, Greenwich Village, New York City: at night on a narrow street of brick row houses and a small bar with brick front and darkened windows, a crowd of young people in 1960s clothes gathers in the street under streetlights, police vans at the curb, people watching from fire escapes; figures small and unrecognisable, no violence close up. Signs illegible. Painted as a 1960s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-nixon-china: 1972, Beijing: a wide distant view of a winter airfield where a blue-and-white airliner has landed, a small official delegation in dark overcoats shaking hands at the foot of the boarding stairs, a line of Chinese honour guards in green uniforms and grey winter sky; all figures tiny and unrecognisable. Painted as a 1970s documentary gouache illustration, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-watergate: 1972, Washington, D.C.: at night the curved, balconied concrete office-and-apartment complex beside the Potomac River, one office window lit, a security guard with a flashlight in a basement stairwell finding a taped door latch, quiet street with 1970s cars parked under sodium streetlights and trees along the river. Painted as a 1970s documentary gouache illustration, deep blue night tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-apple-founded: 1976, Los Altos, California: a suburban garage with a ranch-style house, its door open on a sunny afternoon, a workbench with soldering irons, circuit boards, a wooden-cased computer and a small television monitor, cardboard boxes and tools, a palm and orange tree outside; no people shown. Painted as a 1970s documentary watercolour with warm tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-constitution-act-1982: 1982, Ottawa: on Parliament Hill under a rainy April sky, a large crowd with umbrellas gathers before an outdoor platform with a small table, the Gothic Revival Peace Tower and Centre Block rising behind, red-coated Mounties standing in a line; all figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a 1980s documentary watercolour in muted greys and reds. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-nafta: 1994, a busy border crossing: long lines of trucks and freight trailers on a highway queue at a customs plaza with canopy booths, a rail line of container cars alongside, factories and warehouses across flat land under a hazy sky; no people shown in detail. Painted as a 1990s documentary gouache illustration, clean and muted. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-quebec-referendum-1995: 1995, Montreal: in a quiet school gymnasium serving as a polling station, voters in autumn coats wait in line before cardboard voting booths and a ballot box, election workers at tables, tall windows looking out on maple trees in October colour; figures small and unrecognisable, no flags or slogans. Painted as a 1990s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-nunavut: 1999, Iqaluit on Frobisher Bay: on April 1 a small town of brightly painted houses on a snowy hillside above the frozen bay, people in parkas gather outside a community hall for celebrations, a qamutik sled and dog team nearby, an inuksuk of stones on the hill, low pale spring sun; figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a documentary watercolour, cool blues and bright accents. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-financial-crisis-2008: 2008, Wall Street in New York City: a narrow canyon street between stone and glass towers on a grey September evening, the columned facade of a stock exchange draped with a large flag, office workers in suits carrying cardboard boxes out of a glass tower, news vans parked along the curb; figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-obama-elected: 2008, Grant Park in Chicago: a distant night view of an immense crowd in a lakefront park, many holding small flags, facing a brightly lit stage far away, the city skyline of lit skyscrapers behind and a cool November breeze moving the trees; all figures tiny and unrecognisable. Painted as a documentary gouache illustration, deep blues and golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-affordable-care-act: 2010, a community health clinic in the United States: a waiting room with plastic chairs where families sit, a receptionist at a desk with a computer, a nurse in scrubs leading a patient down a hallway, posters on the wall without legible text; soft daylight through windows. Figures anonymous. Painted as a documentary watercolour in soft blues and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-truth-and-reconciliation: 2015, Ottawa: a large hall with rows of seated people, Indigenous elders in ribbon skirts and shirts and others in suits, listening, an eagle feather and a small drum on a table at the front, a closed residential school building shown only as a framed old photograph on an easel; figures seen from behind. Painted as a respectful documentary watercolour, warm earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-trump-elected: 2016, Washington, D.C.: a distant view of the white neoclassical mansion on Pennsylvania Avenue on a grey November morning, behind its iron fence and lawn, with a few news camera crews set up on the sidewalk and autumn trees losing leaves, a few anonymous passers-by in coats walking past along the wet pavement; no recognisable people. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-covid-us: 2020, Washington, D.C.: an empty avenue with closed shops and cafes in spring, cherry blossom trees in bloom, a lone masked pedestrian at a distance, a hospital entrance with a white field tent outside, the white dome of the Capitol far behind; quiet morning light, with an empty bus stop and pigeons on the pavement. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-george-floyd-protests: 2020, Minneapolis: a distant view of a city intersection covered in flowers, candles and handmade murals (no legible text), crowds of anonymous people in masks gathered quietly in the evening under streetlights, brick commercial buildings around, a bus shelter covered in paper notes and bouquets, the warm glow of candlelight spreading across the pavement; figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a calm, respectful documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
na-capitol-attack: 2021, Washington, D.C.: a distant view across the National Mall of the domed white Capitol building on a grey January afternoon, its terraces and steps crowded with a dense mass of tiny unrecognisable figures, police lines and scaffolding of an inauguration platform, bare trees in the foreground; no flags with legible text. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-valdivia: c. 3000 BCE, the coast of Ecuador near Valdivia: in a village of oval wattle-and-daub houses around a central plaza beside a sandy beach, women in simple woven cloth shape and polish small red clay bowls and tiny clothed female figurines with elaborate hairstyles, fishermen with nets and a balsa raft on the shore, dry scrub forest behind. No horses. Painted in the style of an Andean ceramic painting in earth reds and creams. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-el-paraiso: c. 1800 BCE, El Paraíso in the Chillón Valley near Lima: Andean labourers in cotton tunics carry stones in woven bags to build large flat-topped stone platforms arranged in a U-shape around a wide plaza, green river fields of cotton and squash below, bare coastal desert hills and the ocean on the horizon. No horses, no llamas carrying loads on the coast. Painted in a flat earth-toned style inspired by Andean textile designs. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-cupisnique: c. 1500 BCE, the Jequetepeque Valley on Peru's north coast: in a courtyard of an adobe temple with friezes of fanged feline faces painted in red, yellow and black, potters shape dark polished stirrup-spout bottles, priests in cotton mantles carry them up the stairs, irrigated fields and desert hills beyond in strong sunlight. No horses. Painted in the style of Moche-like fineline ceramic painting, red on cream. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-kuntur-wasi: c. 1100 BCE, Kuntur Wasi in the highlands of Cajamarca: on a hilltop stone-terraced temple with sunken square court and carved stone monoliths, priests in woven mantles and gold crowns and ear ornaments lay a richly adorned leader into a stone-lined tomb beneath the floor, mountains and cloud-filled valleys around. No horses, no gore. Painted in the style of Andean ceramic painting, earth reds and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-lanzon: c. 800 BCE, Chavín de Huántar in the Peruvian Andes: in a narrow dark stone gallery deep inside the temple, a tall knife-shaped granite stone carved with a fanged god with snake-hair stands lit by a single torch held by a priest in a woven cloak, seen from behind; rough stone walls and a ventilation shaft above. No horses. Painted in the style of Chavín relief carving as a dark ink rubbing with ochre highlights. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-san-agustin: c. 1 CE, San Agustín in the upper Magdalena valley of Colombia: in a misty green highland clearing, carvers with stone tools shape a large volcanic-rock statue of a fanged guardian figure with a stylised face beside a stone-slab tomb, other finished statues standing on a grassy mound, cloud forest and mountains around. No horses. Painted in a naturalistic documentary watercolour with earthy greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-puquios: c. 500 CE, Cantalloc near Nazca: in a dry desert valley, Nazca workers in cotton tunics descend a spiralling stone-lined funnel well to clean an underground water channel, green fields of maize, beans and cotton fed by the channel, bare desert hills and a pale sun overhead. No horses. Painted in the style of Nazca polychrome ceramic painting, bright reds, creams and black outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-pikillacta: c. 650 CE, Pikillacta near Cusco: on a mountainside above a valley lake, Wari labourers in tunics build a vast rectilinear grid of high fieldstone walls enclosing hundreds of rooms and courtyards, administrators in tapestry tunics with geometric designs supervising, llama caravans carrying loads, Andean peaks beyond. No horses. Painted in the style of Wari tapestry design, flat geometric earth colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-sican: c. 900 CE, Batán Grande in the Lambayeque valley: tall adobe pyramid mounds rise above a carob-tree forest, metalworkers blow through tubes into small clay furnaces to smelt arsenical bronze, goldsmiths hammer sheets into a large mask with winged eyes, porters carry ingots; a dry hazy coastal sky. No horses. Painted in the style of north coast Peruvian ceramic painting, red and cream with gold accents. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-ciudad-perdida: c. 800 CE, Ciudad Perdida in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta: on a steep jungle-covered mountain ridge, Tairona people in cotton cloth build circular stone terraces linked by stone stairways and paved paths, with conical thatched houses on top, morning mist rising from the deep green valleys. No horses. Painted in a naturalistic documentary watercolour with lush greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-kuelap: c. 1100 CE, Kuélap in the cloud forest of Amazonas, Peru: a massive limestone wall twenty metres high encircles a ridge top, inside it many round stone houses with conical thatched roofs and decorated zig-zag friezes, Chachapoya people in woven cloth climbing a narrow gateway passage, the deep Utcubamba valley and clouds below. No horses. Painted as a naturalistic documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-chancay: c. 1200 CE, the Chancay Valley on the central coast of Peru: in an adobe workshop courtyard, women weave fine cotton cloth on backstrap looms and paint geometric patterns on gauze, potters lay out rows of black-on-white jars and figurines to dry in the sun, irrigated fields and bare desert hills beyond. No horses. Painted in the style of Chancay ceramics, black lines on cream. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-muisca: c. 1300, Lake Guatavita in the Colombian highlands: at dawn a reed raft floats on a dark round lake surrounded by green hills, priests in woven mantles on the raft lift gold offerings, a new ruler glittering with gold dust seen small from behind, torches and smoke of incense, crowds of Muisca people watching from the shore. No horses. Painted in the style of Muisca goldwork, flat gold figures on a dark ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-quipu: c. 1450, Cusco: in a courtyard beside a fine-fitted Inca stone wall with trapezoidal doorways, a quipucamayoc official in a tapestry tunic holds up a quipu of many knotted coloured cords, recording goods as porters unload llamas carrying sacks of maize and bundles of cloth before storehouses; Andean mountains behind. No horses. Painted in the style of an Andean colonial-era chronicle drawing, like Guaman Poma's. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-columbus-paria: 1498, the Gulf of Paria in Venezuela: three caravels with square sails anchored off a lush green coast of mangroves and forested hills, a small rowboat of Spanish sailors in doublets and helmets landing on a beach where local people in feather ornaments and cotton cloth watch from the trees, the muddy fresh water of the Orinoco delta colouring the sea. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-magellan-strait: 1520, the Strait of Magellan: three weather-beaten carracks with patched sails pick their way through a narrow channel between steep snowy mountains and glaciers, fires of the local people burning on the dark shores (Tierra del Fuego), grey choppy water and wind-swept sky. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, with fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-lima: 1535, the valley of the Rímac near the Pacific coast: Spanish conquistadors in morion helmets and breastplates and a priest in black robes mark out a grid of streets with cords and stakes on a dry plain, an adobe chapel frame begun, Indigenous labourers carrying adobe bricks, horses tethered, bare hills behind under a hazy sky. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish colonial manuscript illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-bogota: 1538, the Bogotá savanna in the Colombian highlands: a small group of Spanish soldiers in breastplates and helmets with horses and a friar erect twelve thatched huts and a simple wooden cross on a green plain, Muisca people in cotton mantles watching from nearby, mountains with cloud and forest behind. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish colonial manuscript illustration with flat colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-santiago: 1541, the central valley of Chile beside Santa Lucía hill: Spanish settlers in helmets and doublets with horses and cattle lay out a town square with a wooden palisade, adobe buildings and a chapel, Indigenous labourers carrying timber, the snowy Andes rising steeply behind and the Mapocho river in the foreground. Painted as a seventeenth-century Spanish colonial oil painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-viceroyalty-peru: 1544, the main square of Lima on the dry Peruvian coast: the first viceroy's procession of Spanish officials in black doublets and ruffs on horseback beneath a canopy, soldiers with halberds and morion helmets, priests, and Indigenous nobles in fine tunics, moves toward a small low adobe church with a simple wooden bell gable, not a stone baroque cathedral, no domes, no twin towers; plain single-storey adobe houses with wooden balconies, low bare brown coastal hills behind, not high mountains, hazy grey sky. Painted as a Spanish colonial-era oil painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-orellana: 1542, the Amazon River: a small crude wooden brigantine with a patched sail and a few canoes carry Spanish soldiers in helmets and worn doublets down a vast brown river between walls of rainforest, Indigenous canoes far off near the shore, flocks of birds and a thunderous tropical sky. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-salvador: 1549, the Bay of All Saints in Brazil: Portuguese caravels anchored in a broad bay, settlers in doublets and Jesuits in black cassocks come ashore to build a walled town on the high bluff, labourers raising timber and mud walls, Tupinambá people with feather ornaments and bows watching from the forest edge; palms and blue sky. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-arauco: 1553, Tucapel in southern Chile: seen from a distance, Mapuche warriors with long pikes and clubs in great masses descend a forested hillside toward a small wooden Spanish fort in a green valley, Spanish horsemen in armour gathered outside, smoke drifting from the burning stockade; araucaria trees and volcanoes beyond. No gore. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish colonial manuscript illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-toledo: c. 1572, the Andes near Cusco: Indigenous families in woven tunics and mantles are moved into a newly laid-out Spanish-style reduction town with a grid of adobe houses and a church on a central plaza, Spanish officials in black doublets supervising, a road of men heading off toward distant silver-mining mountains. No violence. Painted in the style of a colonial Andean chronicle drawing, like Guaman Poma's. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-garcilaso: 1609, a printing house in Lisbon: a wooden hand press, a printer pulling a sheet, stacks of freshly printed leather-bound volumes on a table, a mestizo author in a black doublet and ruff seen from behind examining a page; a window opening onto tiled roofs and a river. All writing illegible. Painted as a seventeenth-century Iberian oil painting in a quiet Velázquez-like palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-rio-de-la-plata: c. 1776, Buenos Aires on the Río de la Plata: a low colonial town of whitewashed houses and church domes beside the wide brown river, Spanish sailing ships anchored offshore, ox-carts on the muddy beach unloading chests of silver from Potosí, officials in tricorn hats and gauchos on horseback looking on. Painted as an eighteenth-century Spanish colonial watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-tucuman: 1816, San Miguel de Tucumán: a whitewashed colonial house with a baroque doorway and a long inner patio, delegates in tailcoats, cravats and some priests in cassocks sit in a simple room with wooden chairs and a table of papers, sunlight through a barred window, citizens waiting in the street outside. All writing illegible. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-gran-colombia: 1819, Angostura on the Orinoco River: a small colonial river town of whitewashed houses with red tile roofs on a rocky bank, delegates in tailcoats and military officers in high-collared uniforms gather at a modest assembly hall, river boats moored on the wide brown Orinoco under a tropical sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-uruguay: 1828, Montevideo: a fortified colonial port town on a peninsula with whitewashed houses, a cathedral with twin towers and a citadel, British and local sailing ships at anchor in the bay, gauchos and soldiers on the waterfront, the Cerro hill with its fort across the bay in clear morning light. Painted as an early nineteenth-century topographical watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-gran-colombia-end: 1830, Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast of Colombia: a quiet country hacienda with a white house, red-tile roof and long veranda among tamarind trees and palms, a few servants and officers in uniform waiting quietly in the courtyard, the Sierra Nevada mountains and blue sea beyond in soft December evening light. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-darwin: 1835, the Galápagos Islands: on a black volcanic shore with cactus trees and dry scrub, a young naturalist in a frock coat and hat, seen small from behind, kneels to study a giant tortoise and small dark finches, a sailor with a sack of specimens nearby, a small three-masted survey ship anchored in a blue bay. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-guano: c. 1845, the Chincha Islands off Peru: steep cliffs of pale guano under clouds of seabirds, Chinese contract labourers in loose clothes and straw hats dig and carry baskets, and loading chutes pour guano onto many tall sailing ships anchored offshore in a grey sea, a Peruvian overseer watching. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with sepia wash. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-conquest-desert: 1879, the Río Negro valley in Patagonia: a long column of Argentine soldiers in kepis and dark uniforms with rifles, wagons and horses fords a wide river at Choele Choel island under a vast pale sky, willow trees on the banks, dry steppe plains stretching away; no violence, figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century Argentine oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-rubber-boom: c. 1890, Manaus on the Rio Negro: a domed opera house with a colourful tiled dome rises above a bustling river port town of neoclassical buildings, steamships at floating docks loading balls of smoked rubber, while in the rainforest edge a rubber tapper in worn clothes cuts a slanting groove in a tree trunk to collect white latex. Painted as a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-immigration-argentina: c. 1890, the port of Buenos Aires: a large steamship docked at a crowded wharf, European immigrant families in woollen coats, shawls and caps carry trunks and bundles down the gangway toward a large brick immigrants' hotel, horse-drawn carts and port workers around, cranes and grain warehouses along the river. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving with sepia tints. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-brazil-republic: 1889, Rio de Janeiro: in a broad square framed by colonial and neoclassical buildings, regiments of Brazilian soldiers in blue uniforms and kepis parade with cavalry, crowds of men in top hats and frock coats watching from the sidewalks, palm trees and green mountains with granite peaks behind on a sunny November morning. Painted as a nineteenth-century Brazilian oil history painting. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-bingham: 1911, Machu Picchu in the Peruvian Andes: on a misty mountain saddle among overgrown Inca stone terraces and fine granite walls, a small party of explorers in khaki and broad hats, a local Quechua farmer boy in a woven poncho guiding them, Huayna Picchu peak rising steeply behind and deep green gorges below; figures small and seen from behind. Painted as an early twentieth-century documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-modern-art-week: 1922, São Paulo: the grand foyer of the Municipal Theatre with marble stairs and chandeliers, walls hung with bold modernist paintings and sculptures with tropical colours and cubist forms, a crowd of men in suits and women in cloche hats debating and gesturing, some puzzled; afternoon light through tall windows. Painted in a 1920s Brazilian modernist style with bright flat colours and simplified forms, in the spirit of Tarsila do Amaral. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-chaco-war: 1932, Boquerón in the Gran Chaco: in a hot, dry thorn-scrub forest, Paraguayan soldiers in light khaki uniforms with rifles and canteens advance through dust and low quebracho trees toward Bolivian log-and-earth trenches, a supply truck stuck in sand, a hazy white sky; no gore, figures small. Painted as a 1930s documentary watercolour, ochre and pale green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-bogotazo: 1948, Bogotá: a distant view of the old city centre on an April evening, smoke rising from burning colonial and republican-era buildings with balconies, overturned trams in a street, crowds of tiny figures running, Andean mountains with mist behind and church towers among the smoke; no gore. Painted as a 1940s documentary watercolour, sombre greys and oranges. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-bolivian-revolution: 1952, La Paz: a steep city of colonial and adobe buildings in a high bowl-shaped valley beneath snow-capped Illimani, armed tin miners in helmets and Aymara workers in ponchos and bowler hats march through a cobbled plaza, flags (no legible emblems) flying; figures small. Painted as a 1950s Latin American social-realist woodcut-style print. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-brazil-coup: 1964, Brasília: a wide view of the modernist government esplanade with gleaming white curved buildings and twin towers, columns of army tanks and trucks rolling along a broad empty avenue under a vast blue sky, red-earth plains around, a still artificial lake and a few anonymous soldiers standing beside parked jeeps; no recognisable people. Painted as a 1960s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-hundred-years: 1967, a quiet scene evoking a novel: a small bookshop in Buenos Aires with stacks of a newly published novel on a table, readers browsing in 1960s coats, and a window onto a sunlit street; on the shop wall, a framed painting of a sleepy tropical village with almond trees, yellow butterflies and a river. All writing illegible. Painted as a 1960s documentary watercolour with dreamlike warm colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-che: 1967, La Higuera in the Bolivian highlands: a remote hamlet of a few adobe houses with red-tile roofs and a small whitewashed schoolhouse on a dry mountain slope, Bolivian soldiers in green fatigues standing outside, a helicopter landing in a field, deep ravines and scrub hills under a grey October sky; no violence shown. Painted as a 1960s documentary watercolour, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-allende: 1970, Santiago de Chile: a distant evening view of a city avenue filled with jubilant crowds carrying flags (no legible emblems), lit by streetlights, the snow-capped Andes glowing pink behind, a neoclassical government palace at the end of the avenue, copper-coloured street banners without text strung overhead; figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a 1970s documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-neruda: 1971, Isla Negra on the Chilean coast: a rambling stone and timber house on rocky shore, filled with ship figureheads, bottles and seashells, a writing desk by a window overlooking crashing Pacific waves, a small boat on the garden lawn; no people shown. Painted as a documentary watercolour in sea blues and stone greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-dirty-war: c. 1977, the Plaza de Mayo in Buenos Aires: a group of mothers wearing white headscarves walks slowly in a circle around a small white obelisk in the square, the pink government palace and colonial-era cabildo behind, jacaranda trees, police watching from a distance; figures seen from behind and small. Painted as a restrained 1970s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-shining-path: 1980, Chuschi in the Ayacucho highlands: a small Andean village of adobe houses with tiled roofs and a colonial church around a dirt plaza, the remains of a smouldering bonfire of ballot boxes in the square, a few villagers in ponchos and hats looking on at a distance, terraced mountains under a grey dawn sky. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-mercosur: 1991, Asunción: a grand colonial-style government palace with white arches beside the Paraguay River, flags of four nations (no legible emblems) flying above a lawn, official cars arriving and press cameras on tripods outside on a sunny March day, palm trees along the riverbank; figures small and unrecognisable. Painted as a 1990s documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-chavez: 1998, Caracas: a distant evening view of the city in a green mountain valley, with modern high-rise towers and hillside barrios of brick houses lit up, crowds of tiny unrecognisable figures in red gathered in a street, the forested Ávila mountain behind and a cable-car line climbing its slope; no portraits. Painted as a documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-argentina-2001: 2001, Buenos Aires: in the Plaza de Mayo outside a pink government palace, crowds of tiny unrecognisable people banging pots and pans in protest under streetlights, a line of police in the distance, closed bank fronts with metal shutters along the avenue, smoke drifting in the summer night. Painted as a documentary watercolour, muted with warm light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-lula: 2002, Brasília: a distant view of the modernist presidential palace with its slender white curving columns and reflecting pool, a huge crowd of tiny unrecognisable figures with red and green flags (no legible emblems) on the esplanade under a bright blue sky, the twin towers of the congress and the bowl-shaped chambers far behind; no portraits. Painted as a documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-commodity-boom: c. 2005, the Port of Santos in Brazil: a vast container and bulk port with towering cranes, conveyor belts pouring golden soybeans into the hold of a giant bulk carrier ship, stacks of containers and grain silos along the estuary, forested coastal hills behind under a humid sky. No people shown in detail. Painted as a documentary gouache illustration. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-evo-morales: 2005, La Paz: a distant view of a crowd of tiny unrecognisable people including Aymara women in bowler hats and colourful shawls with multi-coloured checkered wiphala flags in a plaza, colonial cathedral and modern buildings around, snow-capped Illimani behind under a clear blue sky. Painted as a documentary watercolour with bright Andean textile colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-vargas-llosa: 2010, Arequipa: a quiet view of the city's main plaza with white volcanic sillar stone arcades and a twin-towered cathedral, the snow-capped El Misti volcano behind, a bookshop window full of stacked novels in the foreground, a few anonymous passers-by; clear blue sky. All writing illegible. Painted as a documentary watercolour, white stone and blue tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-venezuela-crisis: c. 2018, the Venezuela-Colombia border: a long distant line of tiny unrecognisable people carrying suitcases, backpacks and children walks across a concrete bridge over a muddy river, green hills and a hazy sky beyond, a few tents and aid stations on the far bank where volunteers hand out water bottles. Painted as a restrained documentary watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sam-milei: 2023, Buenos Aires: a distant night view of the white obelisk on the broad Avenida 9 de Julio with crowds of tiny unrecognisable figures waving light blue and white flags, city lights and jacaranda trees along the avenue, traffic halted and car horns implied by the tiny cars lined up; no portraits. Painted as a documentary gouache illustration, deep blue night tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-indus-script: c. 2600 BCE, Harappa in the Punjab: in a mud-brick workshop courtyard a craftsman in a simple cotton wrap carves a small square steatite seal with a humped bull, while finished seals and stamped clay tags lie on a reed mat beside pottery jars; baked-brick walls, a well and a granary roof behind, soft morning light. The carved signs are tiny, abstract and unreadable. Painted in an earthy ancient palette of red ochre, buff and black, like Harappan painted pottery, flat and decorative. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-rakhigarhi: c. 2600 BCE, Rakhigarhi on the Ghaggar plain: a broad view of a large walled Harappan town of baked and mud brick on raised mounds, flat roofs, straight lanes, a bead workshop smoking, farmers with ox-carts with solid wooden wheels bringing grain from wheat fields, a dry riverbed curving past under a hazy sky. Many small figures in cotton wraps go about daily life. Rendered in a muted ochre and terracotta palette inspired by Harappan painted pottery, simple outlines on a buff ground. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-mohenjo-daro: c. 2500 BCE, Mohenjo-daro in Sindh: an elevated view across a grid of straight brick streets with covered drains along their edges, two-storey flat-roofed houses with inner courtyards and wells, and the citadel mound with its large stepped water tank and pillared hall rising behind; townspeople in draped cotton, carts with solid wheels, the Indus river and green fields beyond. Late afternoon light. Painted as a reconstructive archaeological watercolour in warm earth tones, with the flat ochre and black of Indus painted pottery. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-meluhha-trade: c. 2350 BCE, Lothal in Gujarat: a rectangular brick-lined dockyard basin where wooden plank boats with single square sails and steering oars are being loaded; porters carry bundles of timber, baskets of red carnelian beads and elephant ivory tusks down to the quay, a merchant presses a seal into a clay tag on a bale. Warehouses on a brick platform, the estuary and open sea beyond, bright midday sun. Painted in the flat, earthy style of Harappan painted pottery, black and red on buff. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-painted-grey-ware: c. 1200 BCE, Hastinapur on the western Ganges plain: a village of thatched wattle-and-daub huts at the edge of a dense forest; farmers swing iron axes to fell trees and burn clearings, oxen pull a wooden plough, and a potter outside his hut paints fine grey bowls with thin black lines and dots, a row of finished vessels drying in the sun. Smoke drifts over fields of rice and barley. Rendered as an earthy naturalistic watercolour in the manner of early Indian rock-shelter painting colours, ochre and grey. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-later-vedas: Around 1000 BCE, the Ganges plain: Vedic priests in white cotton dhotis sit cross-legged around a square brick fire altar under a thatched shelter, pouring ghee into the flames and chanting, students listening; beside the altar stands a single plain upright wooden post with no crossbar and no arms, just a straight pole with a ring near its top; cattle and a grove of trees by a river. Painted in a soft Indian miniature style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-sulba-sutras: c. 800 BCE on the Ganges plain: Vedic priests in white cloth stretch measuring cords between wooden pegs on flat ground, laying out a large fire altar in the shape of a falcon with wings, made of precisely sized fired bricks; assistants carry bricks in baskets, a square and a circle of pegged cords marked in the earth beside it, a river and village huts behind, bright morning light. Painted in muted ochres and greens in the manner of an ancient Indian mural, clear geometric forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-mahavira: c. 599 BCE, near Vaishali in Bihar: a lone ascetic teacher, seen small and from behind, stands in quiet meditation under a sal tree at the edge of a village, while a gathering of men and women in simple cotton garments and a few monks with whisk brooms sit at a respectful distance listening; a sweeper gently brushing the path so as to harm no insect. Calm golden evening light over rice fields. Painted in the style of a western Indian Jain manuscript painting, red ground, flat bright colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-bimbisara: c. 544 BCE, Rajgir in Bihar: a ring of rocky green hills enclosing the capital of Magadha, with long rough stone fortification walls snaking over the ridges; inside, timber and thatch palace halls, a royal procession of a king under a parasol on a decorated elephant with foot soldiers carrying bows and spears and courtiers entering the city gate. Small figures, no close faces. Painted in the style of an Ajanta cave mural, warm ochre, green and lapis tones, softly flaking. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-vijaya-lanka: c. 543 BCE, Tambapanni on the north-west coast of Sri Lanka: a few wooden sailing ships with square sails are beached on a sandy shore with copper-red earth, and a band of men in north Indian dress wade ashore carrying bows, bundles and water jars; palm groves and dense jungle behind, a calm turquoise sea, morning light. The prince is a small figure among them. Painted in the style of a Sri Lankan Kandyan temple mural, red ground, bold outlines and flat colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-first-sermon: c. 528 BCE, the Deer Park at Sarnath: in a grassy grove of trees, five ascetics in simple robes sit in a semicircle on the ground listening, deer grazing peacefully around them; at the centre an empty seat under a tree with a carved wheel symbol before it, in the aniconic manner of early Buddhist art, no figure of the teacher shown. Soft dawn light, the Ganges plain beyond. Rendered as a Sanchi-style sandstone relief carving, warm buff stone, dense foliage and animals. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-darius-indus: c. 518 BCE, Taxila in Gandhara: on a dusty plain below brown hills, a line of Indian tribute bearers in cotton wraps carry yokes hung with pots of gold dust towards a Persian officer seated under a canopy, Achaemenid guards with tall spears, wicker shields and fluted hats standing in rows; camels and a mud-brick town behind. Afternoon light. Rendered in the style of an Achaemenid relief from Persepolis, low carved limestone figures in procession, softly tinted. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-panini: c. 400 BCE, Taxila: in a shaded courtyard of a teaching house, an elderly scholar in white cloth sits on a mat beneath a tree, reciting while a ring of young students repeat after him, some tracing sound patterns in a tray of sand; mud-brick and timber buildings, distant hills, the quiet of late afternoon. The figures are small and seen in a group. Painted in the soft earth and mineral palette of an Ajanta-style mural, gentle flowing lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-nanda-dynasty: c. 345 BCE, Pataliputra on the Ganges: a broad view of a great city with a high timber palisade and wooden gate towers along the river, boats unloading grain and goods at the ghats, a treasury hall where officials count heaped silver punch-marked coins, and war elephants and chariots massed on the plain outside. Busy daylight, many small figures. Painted in the manner of an early Indian mural, warm ochre, terracotta and green, fine outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-arthashastra: c. 300 BCE, Pataliputra: inside a pillared timber hall of the Mauryan court, ministers in draped cotton and turbans sit on low seats around a counsellor reading from palm-leaf bundles, clerks weighing tax grain and coins at one side, a messenger in plain clothes kneeling at the door to report; carved wooden columns, river light through the openings. Figures small, seen in a group. Painted in the style of an Ajanta cave mural, rich ochre, lapis and green, gently worn. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-sanchi-stupa: c. 250 BCE, Sanchi in Madhya Pradesh: on a hilltop, workers in cotton wraps build a large hemispherical brick stupa, carrying bricks up wooden scaffolding, a polished stone pillar topped with lions standing nearby, monks in saffron robes walking around the base; the forested plain of central India stretching below under a clear sky. Rendered as a sandstone relief carving in the Sanchi gateway style, warm buff stone, crowded lively figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-third-buddhist-council: c. 250 BCE, Pataliputra: a large assembly of shaven-headed monks in saffron and ochre robes sit in long rows inside a timber pillared hall, an elder at the front reciting, palm-leaf bundles on low stands; outside on the river bank a small group of monks with alms bowls and walking staffs departs on boats towards distant lands. Morning light. Figures small, no close faces. Painted as an Ajanta cave mural, mineral greens and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-heliodorus-pillar: c. 113 BCE, Vidisha in Madhya Pradesh: on a riverside plain, workers raise a tall slender stone pillar topped with a carved Garuda bird capital using ropes and wooden levers, while a man in Greek dress with a short cloak and boots stands among Indian priests and townspeople watching; a small temple of timber and brick behind, palm trees, warm late-afternoon light. Painted in the style of an early Indian mural, ochre and green, with a Hellenistic touch in the drapery. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-satavahana: c. 100 BCE, the Deccan near Pratishthana: a cliff face on the Western Ghats where Buddhist cave monasteries are being carved, masons with chisels shaping a pillared prayer-hall entrance and a horseshoe window; below, merchants with ox-carts and a royal official handing donations of lead and copper coins to monks in robes. Rocky hills and monsoon-green valley, bright daylight. Rendered as a sandstone relief in the style of Satavahana-era carving at Karla and Sanchi, warm stone tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-manusmriti: c. 100 BCE on the Ganges plain: a village assembly under a great banyan tree, where a Brahmin teacher in white cloth reads from a palm-leaf manuscript to seated villagers of different occupations: farmers with ploughs, potters, merchants and householders, women in saris at the side; mud houses with thatched roofs, a river ghat and cattle beyond, mild morning light. Small figures in a group. Painted in a soft Ajanta-inspired mural palette, ochre, green and white. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-pali-canon-written: c. 29 BCE, Aluvihare in central Sri Lanka: inside a rock-shelter monastery under huge boulders, a row of monks in saffron robes sit cross-legged, incising letters onto dried palm leaves with iron styluses and rubbing them with soot, stacks of bound leaves between wooden covers beside them; oil lamps, jungle and mist outside. Text strokes tiny and illegible. Painted in the style of a Sri Lankan temple mural, red ground, bold black outlines, flat colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-roman-trade: c. 50 CE, Muziris on the Kerala coast: Roman merchant ships with square sails and curved sterns lie at anchor in a palm-fringed river estuary; Tamil porters in white wraps carry sacks of black pepper and bales of cotton cloth down to small boats, while Roman traders in tunics pour gold coins into a merchant's tray on the bank. Monsoon clouds over green hills, warm light. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, earthy reds and ochres, loose brushwork. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-sangam-literature: c. 100 CE, Madurai in Tamil country: in a pillared hall of a Pandya court, a gathering of poets in white cotton with uncut hair sit on mats, one reciting with a raised hand while a musician plays a curved harp and listeners nod; through the openings a view of hills, palm trees and a temple town. Small figures, no close faces. Painted in the style of a south Indian temple mural, warm reds, yellows and greens, bold outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-fourth-buddhist-council: c. 130 CE, Kashmir: in a valley ringed by snow-capped Himalayan peaks and pine forests, hundreds of monks in robes are seated in rows in a large timber monastery courtyard, scholars at the centre compiling commentaries on birch-bark and copper sheets; a royal canopy where the Kushan king sits small in a long coat and boots. Clear mountain light. Rendered in the style of a Gandharan grey schist relief, crowded figures with Hellenistic drapery. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-nagarjuna: c. 150 CE, Nagarjunakonda in the Krishna valley: a large Buddhist monastery of brick and limestone with a round stupa and pillared halls beside the river, monks in robes walking and debating in small groups in the courtyard; a teacher seen from behind addresses students under a tree. Green hills and paddy fields, clear morning sky. Rendered in the style of the Amaravati school limestone reliefs, pale stone, graceful slender figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-panchatantra: c. 300 CE, Kashmir: in a palace garden, a learned old teacher seated under a chinar tree tells stories to three young princes sitting on a carpet, while around them in the garden live the creatures of the fables: a crow on a branch, a tortoise by a pond, a jackal and a lion half-hidden among flowering bushes, a monkey in a tree. Snowy mountains beyond, gentle daylight. Painted in the style of a Pahari miniature painting, fine lines and clear jewel-like colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-kalidasa: c. 400 CE, Ujjain: a Gupta-era palace courtyard at dusk where a play is being staged on a raised wooden stage; actors in costume, a woman in a forest hermitage dress among painted tree props with a fawn, while the court audience sits on cushions under oil lamps and musicians play drums and flutes at the side. Monsoon clouds in the evening sky. Small figures. Painted in the style of an Ajanta cave mural, graceful figures, ochres, lapis blue and green. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-iron-pillar: c. 400 CE, central India: on a low hill, blacksmiths and labourers in cotton wraps haul a tall smooth dark iron pillar upright with ropes and timber frames, its top crowned with a bell-shaped capital, while priests and a small royal party watch; furnaces smoking at the foot of the hill and a temple of the Gupta period nearby. Bright clear day. Painted as an Ajanta-style mural, warm ochres and greens, softly faded. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
sa-skandagupta-huns: c. 455 CE, the Ganges plain near Bhitari: seen from a distance, a Gupta army with war elephants, archers and horsemen with spears advances across a dusty plain, while horsemen of the Huna in fur caps and long coats retreat towards distant hills; smoke and dust rise over the battlefield, no wounded shown.
