tour.chanyuan-treaty.0: Autumn 1004, the Hebei plain: a vast Liao army moves south across harvested fields, Khitan cavalry in fur-trimmed caps and boots riding in long columns around a fortified Song town whose walls bristle with banners, leaving it untouched behind them; in the centre, felt-covered imperial ox carts and a white-horse banner escort for the emperor and his mother. Dust haze, poplars yellowing, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Northern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.chanyuan-treaty.1: 1004, Kaifeng: in a vast palace hall with red columns, an emperor in yellow sits small on a distant dais while two groups of officials in purple and red robes with long-winged black caps argue before him; one minister steps forward alone in the centre, seen from behind, holding his court tablet, while others hold maps of the south. Lamp-lit, tense autumn evening, figures at middle distance, no legible text. Painted as a Northern Song court figure painting, fine line, ink and mineral colours on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.su-dongpo-exile.0: 1056, Meishan in Sichuan: at a riverside landing on the Min River below green hills and bamboo groves, a father in a plain scholar's robe and two young men with travel bundles and book boxes board a wooden river boat, seen from behind, while family members wave from the steps of a modest tiled house; far beyond, mist-hung mountain ranges lead toward the north. Early spring morning, small figures. Painted as a Northern Song court genre painting, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.su-dongpo-exile.2: 1076, Mizhou in Shandong: on the Mid-Autumn night, a scholar-official in a loose robe stands on a high earthen terrace above the town walls, seen from behind, raising a wine cup toward a huge full moon; a few friends and a servant with a wine jar sit nearby on mats, the dark roofs of the town and distant hills below. Silvery moonlight, cool autumn air, wistful mood, figures small. Painted as a Northern Song figure painting, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.su-dongpo-exile.5: 1089, Hangzhou: on West Lake, hundreds of labourers in short jackets dredge mud from the shallows with scoops and baskets, loading it into boats and piling it into a long new causeway across the water; workers plant willows along it and build small arched stone bridges, while an official in a robe watches from a boat. Wooded hills and temples around the lake, soft spring light, figures small. Painted as a Southern Song-style ink landscape on silk, light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.su-dongpo-exile.6: 1094, Huizhou in Guangdong: in a lush southern valley, an elderly scholar in a plain robe and broad hat, seen from behind, sits under laden lychee trees heavy with red fruit, a basket beside him; nearby, villagers lash boats together into a floating bridge across a river, and a small lake with an island pagoda lies beyond. Humid summer haze, green hills, figures small. Painted as a Southern Song-style ink landscape on silk, light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.su-dongpo-exile.7: 1097, Danzhou on Hainan island: a small thatched hut among coconut palms and banana trees, an elderly scholar in a worn robe seated on a mat in its open doorway, seen from behind, teaching a few local students, including Li islanders in wrapped cloth, who sit on the ground with brushes and paper; a sea glimpsed beyond the trees. Hot hazy light, simple and calm, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song-style ink landscape on silk, light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-anshi-reforms.0: 1047, Yin county near Ningbo: farmers repair earthen dykes and dig out irrigation ponds among rice paddies, while at a county granary with a tiled roof a young magistrate in a plain robe and black cap, seen from behind, oversees clerks measuring grain from large baskets into peasants' sacks for spring loans; green hills and the sea inlet beyond. Spring, wet fields, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Northern Song figure painting, fine line, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-anshi-reforms.5: 1074, outside Kaifeng in a year of drought: streams of starving refugees in rags, carrying children and bundles, trudge along a dusty road past cracked fields and withered trees toward a city gate, where a lone gatekeeper in a plain uniform stands seen from behind, watching; a dull red sun, dust in the air. Restrained and sombre, no bodies, figures small. Painted as a Northern Song figure painting, fine line, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-anshi-reforms.6: 1076, Jiangning (Nanjing): an elderly retired statesman in a plain robe rides a donkey along a quiet path between rice fields and a small garden residence toward the wooded slopes of Zhongshan, a single servant walking behind; a pond, bamboo, distant city walls. Late autumn, mild hazy light, reflective solitude, figures tiny. Painted as a Northern Song landscape, fine line, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.jingkang.6: Autumn 1126, Taiyuan: after a long siege, Jurchen soldiers with shaved heads and braids pour through a breach in the high earthen walls of a northern city, smoke rising from inside, while beyond, long columns of Jin cavalry and supply carts set off south across the Fen River plain under banners; yellow loess hills and bare trees. Distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Northern Song handscroll, ink and pale colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yue-fei.2: 1130, Jiankang (Nanjing): Song troops in lamellar armour storm down from the wooded slopes of Niushou hill toward the riverbank, as a retreating Jin army with braided Jurchen horsemen and loaded carts hurries onto boats on the Yangtze; the burned walls of the city stand behind, Song banners now raised over a gate tower. Early summer, smoke drifting, distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yue-fei.5: 1140, Zhuxian Town near Kaifeng: a large Song army camp of tents and banners spreads around a market town on the flat Henan plain, while from across the fields bands of northern farmers and militia with pikes, hoes and homemade banners stream in to join them; on the far horizon, faint walls of the old capital. Summer heat haze, wheat stubble, distant view, all figures tiny, no gore. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yue-fei.6: 1140, a Song army camp in Henan: one after another, imperial messengers gallop in along the road from the south, each holding high a gold-lacquered placard; at the camp gate a general in armour, seen from behind, stands still among his officers while soldiers watch silently and begin to strike tents. Late summer evening, long shadows, banners lowered, figures at middle distance, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhu-xi-academies.0: 1130s, the hills of northern Fujian near the Wuyi mountains: a modest refugee family's house of timber and grey tile stands beside a mountain stream at Wufu village, a widowed mother in plain dress at the door and a boy in a scholar's robe seen from behind reading at a low table on the veranda; terraced tea fields, bamboo, red rock peaks in mist. Spring, quiet. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting in ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhu-xi-academies.1: 1160, the mountain road to Yanping in Fujian: a young scholar in a plain robe and cloth cap walks alone on a stone path along a gorge, a book bundle on his back, toward a small riverside town where two rivers meet below green mountains; ahead, an elderly teacher in a simple robe waits at the gate of a thatched house. Winter sunlight, pines, figures tiny. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting in ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhu-xi-academies.2: 1167, Changsha: two scholars in plain robes and caps cross the broad Xiang River together in a small ferry boat, still talking, students crowding a second boat behind; on the far bank, the halls of the Yuelu Academy rise among maple trees at the foot of Yuelu mountain, more students arriving along the shore path. Autumn colour, clear water, figures small. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting in ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhu-xi-academies.5: 1183, the Wuyi mountains: a cluster of simple thatched lecture halls and study huts sits beside a winding clear stream below sheer red sandstone cliffs, students in plain robes reading on verandas and listening to a teacher seated in an open hall, seen from behind; bamboo rafts drift on the stream, mist on the peaks. Late spring, green and tranquil, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song landscape in ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.genghis-khan.1: 1209, Zhongxing (Yinchuan), the Western Xia capital: Mongol horsemen in fur hats and deels watch as labourers break a dyke on the Yellow River, floodwater spreading across the plain toward the rammed-earth walls and pagoda of the city; Tangut defenders on the walls, the dark Helan mountains behind. Autumn, wide sky, distant panoramic view, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll in the manner of Liu Guandao's steppe horsemen, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.genghis-khan.5: 1220, Samarkand in Transoxiana: before the mud-brick walls and carved-brick domes and minarets of the city (no Timurid blue-tiled domes), townspeople in turbans and robes file out of a gate in surrender, carrying bundles, while Mongol horse archers in fur hats wait on the plain in disciplined ranks under horsetail standards; orchards, the Zarafshan river and dry hills beyond. Distant panoramic view, no gore. Painted as a Persian miniature in the Ilkhanid Jami al-Tawarikh manner, flat colours, gold sky. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.0: 1240s, Luling in Jiangxi: inside a county school shrine, a boy in a plain scholar's robe stands seen from behind, gazing up at a row of hanging painted portraits of local worthies in official robes, their features soft and indistinct; incense smoke, red columns, a teacher in a black cap nearby, and through the doorway a courtyard with an old cypress and the Gan river beyond. Morning light, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.1: 1256, Lin'an (Hangzhou): in a palace courtyard, rows of examination candidates in white robes kneel at low desks writing essays, while officials in purple and red robes walk between them; at the top of the steps, the emperor sits small and distant under a canopy in a red-columned hall, and the green hills around West Lake show beyond the roofs. Spring morning, solemn order, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song court painting, fine line and mineral colours on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.2: 1275, Ganzhou in southern Jiangxi: on the riverbank below the city walls where two rivers meet, thousands of volunteers, farmers, hill people and townsmen, assemble with spears, shields and plain banners, while a governor in a red official robe, seen from behind on horseback, reviews them; carts loaded with silver and grain from his family stores roll out. Autumn, green hills, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.4: 1276, Zhenjiang on the Yangtze: on a dark night a small boat with a handful of men in plain clothes slips silently downriver past a Yuan army camp of campfires and moored warships on the bank; Mongol sentries with torches stand on the shore, Jinshan hill with its temple silhouetted against the clouds. Moonlight on black water, tension, figures tiny and distant. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.5: 1277, Kongkeng in the hills of southern Jiangxi: in a narrow valley among steep forested hills, a loyalist Song army in mixed armour and plain clothes breaks and scatters up the slopes as Yuan cavalry with banners sweeps in from the valley mouth; abandoned carts and a captured palanquin led away at the edge of the field. Misty autumn rain, figures tiny and distant, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wen-tianxiang.6: 1278, Wupoling near Haifeng on the Guangdong coast: on a low hill among scrub and boulders, soldiers of a small Song camp sit around cooking pots and fires when Yuan cavalry burst over the ridge; men scramble for weapons, horses rear, a commander in a red robe seen from behind amid the confusion. The sea and grey sky behind, figures tiny and distant, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.guo-shoujing.0: 1262, Kaiping (Shangdu) on the grassland: in a Mongol palace hall hung with felt and silk, a young Chinese scholar in a plain robe kneels before a raised dais where the Great Khan sits small and distant, unrolling a long scroll of river and canal plans before officials in Mongol robes and Chinese advisers; through the open door, horses and the steppe. Summer light, figures at middle distance, plans drawn as lines with no legible text. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court painting, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.guo-shoujing.1: 1264, the Ningxia plain by the Yellow River: crowds of labourers dig out old silted canals and rebuild sluice gates of timber, stone and brushwood bundles, water rushing again into long channels toward green fields; an engineer in a plain robe on a horse with surveyors points out the line, and the bare ridge of the Helan mountains rises to the west. Spring, wide sky, figures small. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty landscape, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.guo-shoujing.2: 1276, Dadu (Beijing): in a large workshop courtyard of the new astronomical bureau, bronze casters pour molten metal into clay moulds for instrument rings, craftsmen file graduated bronze circles and assemble a large open framework instrument, while a scholar in a robe checks a wooden model; a tall brick gnomon under construction rises behind scaffolding. Glowing furnace light and daylight, smoke, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court painting, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.guo-shoujing.3: 1279, a far northern observing station: on a vast open plain of grass and larch forest beside a cold lake, a small team of Yuan surveyors in fur-lined robes sets up a portable gnomon and a sighting tube on a stone base, one measuring a shadow with a rod, horses and a felt tent nearby, Mongol guides watching. Long low sunlight, early summer, figures small and distant, no legible text. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty landscape, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.guo-shoujing.6: 1292, the Western Hills outside Dadu: gangs of workers dig a long new channel and lay stone embankments, leading clear spring water from the hills at Baifu across the plain into a broad lake at the foot of Wengshan hill; officials with surveying rods and a robed engineer inspect from the bank, the walls of Dadu faint on the eastern horizon. Spring, willows, figures small. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty landscape, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.0: About 1274, Ganzhou (Zhangye) on the Hexi Corridor: a caravan of Bactrian camels arrives at the rammed-earth gate of an oasis town, three European travellers in dusty Venetian tunics and caps riding among Uighur and Tangut traders; inside, the great hall of a Buddhist temple and monks in red robes, poplars, irrigated fields, and the snowy Qilian mountains behind. Autumn, clear blue sky, figures small. Painted in Yuan-dynasty court painting style like Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.2: About 1276, Dadu (Khanbaliq): a high bird's-eye view of a vast square walled city laid out in straight streets like a chessboard, with gate towers on every side, a great palace complex with white marble terraces beside a lake in the centre, and a drum tower; Mongol riders, camel trains and carts fill the broad avenues. Winter morning, light snow on the roofs, tiny figures. Painted in Yuan-dynasty court painting style, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.3: About 1280, Karajang (Yunnan): at a lakeside market below green mountains, local people in wrapped turbans and woven capes trade salt, horses and cloth, paying with strings and heaps of white cowrie shells counted on mats; a small party of Yuan envoys with a European in travelling clothes rides through, seen from behind. Bright highland light, a blue lake, figures small. Painted in Yuan-dynasty style, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.4: About 1282, Yangzhou on the Grand Canal: busy salt barges and grain boats crowd the canal before a walled city, a Yuan government office with tiled roofs and a courtyard by the water where Mongol and Chinese officials in robes handle ledgers, a foreigner in a Yuan official's robe ambiguous among them, seen from behind; bridges, willows, porters. Spring haze, figures small, no legible text. Painted in Yuan-dynasty style, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.5: About 1285, Hangzhou (Quinsai): a panoramic view of West Lake with painted pleasure boats, pavilions and arched stone bridges, the city wall and dense tiled roofs, canals and markets on one side and wooded hills with pagodas on the other; crowds stroll along the causeways under willows. Bright spring day, hundreds of tiny figures. Painted in Yuan-dynasty style, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.marco-polo.6: About 1291, Zaiton (Quanzhou): a great harbour crowded with large ocean-going junks with batten sails; a fleet sets out under banners, a richly dressed Mongol princess and her ladies boarding a ship by gangway from a quay, seen from a distance, Persian envoys and a few European travellers with them; the two stone pagodas of Kaiyuan Temple and the roofs of the port city behind. Morning breeze, figures small. Painted in Yuan-dynasty style, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.hongwu-founding.2: 1369, Linhao (Fengyang): tens of thousands of conscript labourers and soldiers build the walls and huge stone terraces of a new imperial city on a gently rising plain, hauling stone blocks on rollers, carrying bricks on shoulder poles, scaffolding around a half-built palace hall; overseers in red robes watch from a platform, low hills behind. Hazy summer light, panoramic, figures small, no legible text. Painted as an early Ming court painting in ink and subdued colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.hongwu-founding.6: 1387, Jinshan in Liaodong: on a wide autumn plain beneath low hills, Mongol horsemen in fur hats and quilted coats dismount in long lines and lay down their bows and banners before a vast Ming army camp; a Mongol commander and his escort walk forward toward Ming generals in armour standing under red banners. Clear cold air, birch trees, figures small and distant, no fighting. Painted in the style of a Ming frontier campaign handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.jingnan-campaign.1: Spring 1400, the Baigou River south of Beiping: across a wide river plain, Yan cavalry charge through a sudden whirlwind of dust into the flank of a vast imperial army, whose great commander's banner pole snaps and topples; imperial columns break and stream south along the riverbank, abandoning carts and tents. Grey-yellow sky, new green willows, figures tiny and distant, no gore. Painted as an early Ming battle handscroll, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.jingnan-campaign.2: 1400, Jinan: the brick-faced walls of a Shandong city surrounded by springs and the lotus-filled Daming Lake, defenders in red Ming uniforms and helmets manning crenellations with banners and small cannon; outside, a besieging army's camps and earthworks on the plain, and in the distance its columns beginning to withdraw north. Late summer, low hills to the south, distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as an early Ming court painting, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.jingnan-campaign.4: Summer 1402, Guazhou on the Yangtze: hundreds of boats and junks carry an army across the broad river from the northern bank, horses and soldiers packed on decks under banners, while on the southern shore the walled city of Zhenjiang opens its gates and officials come out to surrender; Jinshan with its temple and pagoda rises from the river. Bright summer haze, figures small and distant. Painted as an early Ming court painting, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zheng-he.1: 1405, the coast of Champa (central Vietnam): giant Ming treasure ships with many masts and red-brown batten sails anchor in a bay below green mountains, while boats ferry envoys and gifts to the shore; on the beach, Cham courtiers in wrapped cloth with parasols and an elephant await them, and red-brick Cham temple towers rise on a hill behind. Monsoon clouds, warm light, figures small. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style, waves drawn in fine repeating lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zheng-he.2: 1407, Malacca on the strait: on the riverbank below a forested hill, Ming soldiers and workers build a timber stockade with gate towers enclosing rows of warehouses, porters carrying bales and crates, while dozens of large Ming junks with lowered batten sails ride at anchor in the strait, waiting for the wind; Malay boats and stilt houses along the river mouth. Humid afternoon, palms, figures small. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zheng-he.3: 1411, Galle in southern Ceylon: on a palm-shaded headland above a bay, Ming sailors and officials in robes haul upright a tall carved stone tablet on a base, its surface carved with faint unreadable script, while local Sinhalese monks in saffron robes and Tamil and Persian merchants watch; Ming treasure ships wait offshore and green hills rise inland. Bright tropical morning, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zheng-he.4: 1413, Calicut on the Malabar coast: a crowded waterfront market where Kerala traders in white cloth weigh heaps of black pepper, ginger and cloth in great balances, Ming officials in robes and Arab merchants bargaining; porters carry sacks down to small boats, and the Ming fleet lies anchored far out at sea. Midday sun, coconut palms, tiled roofs of the town, figures small. Painted as a Ming woodblock-print illustration with hand colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zheng-he.5: 1414, Hormuz at the mouth of the Persian Gulf: on the bare island port with its mud-brick walls and wind-towers below reddish salt hills, Persian merchants in turbans lead horses and carry carpets to Ming boats; at the waterline Ming sailors lead a tall giraffe up a ramp toward a treasure ship with batten sails, onlookers gathered. Hot bright light, turquoise sea, figures small. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.tumu-crisis.0: 1449, the frontier north of Datong: beyond a line of rammed-earth Great Wall and square beacon towers sending up columns of smoke, masses of Oirat Mongol cavalry in fur hats and quilted coats gather on the rolling brown steppe with horsetail standards, herds of spare horses and felt tents behind them, while small Ming garrisons watch from the walls. Autumn wind, wide pale sky, figures small and distant, no bloodshed shown. Painted as a Ming ink-and-colour handscroll in the tradition of frontier battle scrolls, muted ochres and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.tumu-crisis.1: 1449, Juyong Pass north of Beijing: a vast, disorderly Ming army winds up a narrow gorge between steep brown mountains, through a stone gate tower and along the line of the Great Wall; infantry in red jackets and helmets, supply carts and horses jam the road, a yellow imperial canopy surrounded by eunuchs and officials in the midst. Late summer, low clouds and drizzle, figures small and distant. Painted as a Ming ink-and-colour handscroll in the tradition of frontier battle scrolls, muted ochres and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.tumu-crisis.2: 1449, Datong on the northern frontier: outside the massive walls of the garrison city, a huge Ming army turns back in confusion in heavy rain, wagons stuck in mud, soldiers sheltering under oiled cloths, horses straggling, banners drooping; scouts gallop in from the north where dark hills hide the steppe. Grey, wet late-summer light, figures small and distant, no gore. Painted as a Ming ink-and-colour handscroll in the tradition of frontier battle scrolls, muted ochres and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.0: 1470s, Yuyao in Zhejiang: a prosperous official family's compound of white walls and grey tiles beside a river, a boy in a small scholar's robe seen from behind in an open study hall, standing with hands clasped before an elderly tutor while classics lie on the desk; a courtyard with plum trees, a stone bridge and green hills beyond. Early spring, quiet. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.1: About 1492, Beijing: in the quiet courtyard of an official residence with grey walls and a moon gate, a young scholar in a plain robe sits motionless on a stone bench, seen from behind, staring at a clump of bamboo; an untouched tea cup beside him, a servant watching anxiously from a doorway. Pale winter sun, bare branches, stillness. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.3: 1510, Luling in Jiangxi: in the courtyard of a small county yamen beside the Gan river, a magistrate in a red official robe and black gauze cap, seen from behind at a table, hears villagers who bring bundles of old lawsuit papers; clerks clear stacks of files, farmers leave contented through the gate, rice fields and hills beyond the town walls. Spring morning, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.4: 1517, the mountains around Ganzhou: Ming troops with banners and matchlocks climb narrow paths through forested ridges toward fortified bandit stockades of timber and stone perched on peaks, smoke rising from one already taken; below, in a valley village, elders gather in a clearing to swear a village covenant. Misty autumn morning, layered mountains, figures small and distant, no gore. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.6: 1519, Poyang Lake: the morning after the battle, grey smoke still drifting over the wide water, charred rebel war junks aground among reeds, while a disciplined government flotilla gathers around a captured flagship; on the deck of a command boat, a scholar-general in a plain robe stands seen from behind, small boats bringing a captive prince across the water under guard. Calm grey light, Lushan mountains faint behind, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Ming ink landscape handscroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.7: From 1522, Shaoxing: on a moonlit autumn night, crowds of students in scholar's robes sit on mats around a lakeside pavilion at a garden by a stone bridge, some playing flutes and others chanting, while their elderly teacher in a plain robe sits in the pavilion, seen from behind, speaking; boats moored on the canal, willows, distant hills. Lantern glow and moonlight, joyful calm, figures small. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wang-yangming.8: Early 1529, Nan'an in southern Jiangxi: a single official boat with a covered cabin is moored at a quiet river landing in winter, the Dayu mountains grey beyond; a few attendants in plain robes stand bowed on the deck and on the bank, one holding a lantern, and inside the shadowed cabin only a blanket and an untouched cup can be glimpsed. Cold mist, still water, bare trees, deeply quiet, no figures in close-up. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qi-jiguang-wokou.2: 1559, Yiwu in Zhejiang: on a drill ground below rocky hills, recruits in plain jackets, farmers and miners, practise in twelve-man squads, the front men with long multi-branched bamboo spears and rattan shields, others with halberds and long spears, while drums beat and officers wave signal flags from a raised platform; a commander in armour seen from behind. Bright spring day, paddies around, figures small. Painted as a Ming woodblock-print military manual illustration, crisp black line with light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qi-jiguang-wokou.4: 1562, Hengyu island near Ningde in Fujian: at low tide, Ming soldiers in squads carry bundles of straw and lay them over the grey mudflats to make a path, advancing across the shallows under banners toward a pirate stockade of wooden palisades and huts on a low island; the sea retreating, boats stranded, hills on the mainland behind. Overcast morning, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Ming woodblock-print military manual illustration, crisp black line with light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qi-jiguang-wokou.5: 1563, Pinghai garrison near Putian in Fujian: three Ming armies under separate banners converge from different directions on a small stone-walled coastal fort on a headland, soldiers scaling walls with ladders, pirates fleeing toward boats on the shore; the sea, islands and fishing villages around. Bright winter day, distant panorama, small figures, no gore. Painted as a Ming woodblock-print military manual illustration, crisp black line with light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhang-juzheng-reforms.0: 1572, the Forbidden City in Beijing: in the vast stone courtyard before a palace gate, rows of officials in crimson robes and black gauze caps kneel while a eunuch in dark robes reads out an edict from the steps; at the edge of the crowd, one dismissed senior minister walks away alone through a side gate, seen from behind, toward a waiting mule cart. Summer morning, red walls and yellow roofs, figures small, no legible text. Painted in Ming court-painting style, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhang-juzheng-reforms.2: About 1574, a border horse market below the Great Wall in the north: Mongol herders in fur hats and robes drive herds of horses and sheep to a walled market ground outside a brick-faced section of the wall with new watchtowers, trading with Chinese merchants who unload bolts of silk, tea bricks and iron pots; Ming soldiers in helmets keep order from the towers. Clear autumn day, brown hills, figures small, peaceful. Painted in Ming court-painting style, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.zhang-juzheng-reforms.7: 1584, Jiangling in Hubei: seen from high on the city wall in autumn rain, a great family estate of many courtyards stands sealed and silent, weeds in its paths, soldiers posted at the gate; officials' boats on the nearby Yangtze carry away chests and bundles, and a few grieving relatives in white walk out along a muddy lane. Grey drizzle, deserted streets, figures tiny and distant, no bodies. Painted as a Ming court-style painting in ink and subdued colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wanli-three-campaigns.1: 1592, Busan on the Korean coast: a great Japanese fleet of wooden ships with square sails crowds the harbour, Japanese troops in lacquered armour with tall back-banners and matchlock guns pour ashore and swarm toward a small stone-walled Joseon fort on a hill, smoke rising; Korean defenders in black brimmed hats on the ramparts, steep green hills around. Spring morning, distant view, no gore. Painted as a late-Ming hand-coloured woodblock illustration crossed with Korean folding-screen battle painting, ink with blue, red and ochre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wanli-three-campaigns.3: 1593, Byeokjegwan north of Seoul: on a muddy road through a narrow valley between wooded hills, a column of Ming light cavalry in iron helmets is surprised by masses of Japanese troops with spears and matchlocks pouring down from the ridges under tall back-banners; horses mired in thawing paddy fields, Ming riders wheeling back north. Late winter, wet grey sky, distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as a late-Ming hand-coloured woodblock illustration crossed with Korean folding-screen battle painting, ink with blue, red and ochre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wanli-three-campaigns.4: Winter 1597, Ulsan in southern Korea: a newly built Japanese castle with steep sloping stone walls and timber towers on a hill above a river mouth, ringed by Ming and Joseon besiegers' camps, trenches and cannon on the frozen plain; scaling parties fall back from the walls through snow, smoke over the hill. Grey icy sky, distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as a late-Ming hand-coloured woodblock illustration crossed with Korean folding-screen battle painting, ink with blue, red and ochre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.wanli-three-campaigns.7: 1600, Hailongtun near Zunyi in Guizhou: at dusk after the fortress has fallen, Ming banners fly over the stone gates on the flat summit of a sheer mountain, thin smoke rising from burnt halls; long lines of soldiers descend a steep stone stairway, and in the valleys below, eight army camps glow with fires among terraced fields and deep gorges. Quiet, solemn mood, figures tiny, no gore. Painted as a Ming blue-green landscape handscroll, ink and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.0: 1607, Lake Tai near Jiangyin: from the stone steps of a modest gentry house by a canal, a grey-haired mother in plain Ming dress watches as her son, a young man in a scholar's robe and cloth cap with a bundle and walking staff, steps into a small boat, seen from behind; the boat heads out toward the wide silver lake with eroded Taihu rocks and distant islands. Spring morning mist, willows, figures small. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf in the Wu school manner, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.1: 1613, Mount Tiantai in Zhejiang: a traveller in a plain Ming robe and straw sandals with a servant carrying a bamboo pack stands small on a rock ledge, seen from behind, looking at the narrow natural stone bridge that spans a gorge above a roaring double waterfall; pines, mossy rocks, a temple roof in the trees. Late spring, fresh green, mist. No railings or modern paths. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf in the Wu school manner, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.2: 1616, Huangshan: two tiny figures in Ming padded robes, a traveller and his porter, climb steps cut into a steep granite ridge covered in snow and ice, using staffs, among twisted pines and soaring pale peaks rising out of a sea of cloud; a small temple far below. Cold clear winter light. No cable cars, railings or modern steps. Painted as a late Ming landscape album leaf in the Anhui school manner, dry ink line and pale colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.3: 1618, Mount Lu in Jiangxi: a traveller in a plain Ming robe with a staff sits on a rock, seen from behind, before a long white waterfall dropping from a high cliff, a servant beside him; jagged peaks to one side, a small Buddhist temple among pines below, and beyond, the wide Yangtze and Poyang Lake lost in haze. Autumn, cool mist. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf in the Wu school manner, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.4: 1623, Mount Hua: a lone traveller in a Ming robe, with a pack and staff, edges along a knife-edged granite ridge and grips iron chains on a near-vertical stairway cut in the rock, a porter following; sheer cliffs drop into cloud, a small Daoist temple clings to a peak. Strong clear light, dizzying height, figures tiny. No modern railings or cable cars. Painted as a late Ming landscape hanging scroll, bold ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.5: 1637, the Xiang River in Hunan: on a dark night, torch-bearing robbers clamber from a small boat onto a moored passenger boat on a broad river, travellers scattering, one man leaping into the shallows near the reeds, a monk crouched holding his arm; bundles tossed onto the bank, a sleeping village and hills beyond. Firelight and moon, figures small and distant, restrained, no gore. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf in the Wu school manner, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.6: 1637, near Guilin in Guangxi: inside a vast limestone cave lit by pine torches, a traveller in a Ming robe and his servant measure the chamber with a knotted rope, small among huge stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone curtains; through the cave mouth, green karst peaks and the Li River in sunlight. Dramatic torchlight and shadow, figures tiny. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.7: 1638, the Baishui River in Guizhou: a broad, roaring waterfall plunges over a wide curtain of rock into a deep green pool, spray rising like scattered pearls; a weary traveller in a Ming robe and his porter stand tiny on a muddy mountain path on the opposite slope, among wild banana plants, bamboo and steep forested hills. Humid, misty light. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xu-xiake.8: 1639, Jizu mountain in Yunnan: on a forested ridge among Buddhist temples and a white stupa, a thin traveller in a worn Ming robe, seen from behind, kneels beside a small new stone grave with monks in robes chanting; below, layered mountains and cloud, and at the temple gate a waiting sedan chair with bearers. Autumn evening light, solemn calm. Painted as a late Ming travel album leaf, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.fall-of-ming.6: Early 1644, the Yellow River gorge between Shaanxi and Shanxi: in midwinter, a vast rebel army crosses the frozen river in long dark columns of cavalry, infantry and carts, under new banners, while beyond, the road climbs the loess cliffs and terraced hills into Shanxi toward the east; a small walled town on the far bank stands open. Grey sky, snow, dust, distant panorama, small figures, no gore. Painted as a late Ming landscape handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.fall-of-ming.7: Spring 1644, Beijing: rebel cavalry and infantry in plain armour stream through a great city gate into the capital, smoke rising from distant palace halls, townspeople watching from doorways; on the horizon behind the Forbidden City's yellow roofs, Coal Hill with its pavilions and a single old tree stands silent under a pale sky, no figure shown there. Dawn haze, figures small and distant, sombre mood, no gore. Painted as a late Ming landscape handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.kangxi-consolidation.1: 1678, Hengzhou in Hunan: a hurried enthronement in a makeshift palace courtyard beside the Xiang River, officials in Ming-style robes kneeling in rain before a hall with hastily painted yellow roof tiles, an aged ruler seen small and distant under a canopy; the Hengshan mountains in mist beyond, soldiers huddled at the gates. Grey, dreary weather, figures small. Painted as a Kangxi-era Qing court landscape with figures, blue-green palette on silk, panoramic composition. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yongzheng-reforms.4: 1731, Khoton Nuur in the Altai mountains: in a wide valley of lakes and pale grass ringed by rocky snow peaks, a long Qing army column with banners and supply carts is caught as Dzungar horsemen in fur hats sweep down from the ridges on all sides; Qing units scatter toward the lakeshore, dust and smoke rising. Distant panorama, figures tiny, no gore. Painted as a Qing court campaign painting, fine line and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yongzheng-reforms.5: 1732, Erdene Zuu in the Orkhon valley: beside the monastery's long white wall lined with stupas and its temple roofs, Khalkha Mongol horsemen in deels charge across the river meadows and drive Dzungar cavalry into flight toward the hills; lamas watch from the monastery gate. Late summer, green steppe and blue sky, distant view, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Qing court campaign painting, fine line and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.yongzheng-reforms.6: 1735, Guzhou in Guizhou: among steep terraced mountains, Miao villages of wooden stilt houses cling to the slopes, Miao men in dark indigo jackets and turbans gathering with spears on a ridge, while long columns of Qing troops with banners and queues advance up the misty valley along the river. Damp spring mist, layered hills, figures small and distant, no gore. Painted as a Qing court painting, fine line and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.0: January 1751, Beijing: a long imperial procession leaves the city through a great brick gate tower in light snow, mounted bannermen in fur-trimmed hats and queues riding ahead, yellow parasols and banners, a curtained sedan chair for the empress dowager carried by many bearers, the emperor on horseback seen far off among guards; townspeople kneel along the cleared road. Cold clear morning, figures small. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.1: 1751, Shandong near Jinan: the imperial cortege winds along a broad yellow-earth road through winter wheat fields and villages, with Mount Thousand Buddha and the walls of Jinan behind; farmers and elders in padded jackets kneel by the roadside with incense tables, and local officials in court robes hand out blank proclamation sheets of tax remission. Early spring sun, willows budding, many small figures, no legible text. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.2: 1751, Qingkou where the Yellow River, the Huai and the Grand Canal meet: from a long stone-faced dike, the emperor, seen from behind under a yellow parasol, inspects the works with river officials in court robes, while gangs of labourers reinforce the embankment with stone and sorghum bundles; imperial dragon barges moor in the canal, and the muddy Yellow River and clear Huai water swirl together. Windy spring day, figures small. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.3: 1751, Yangzhou: along a narrow, winding lake framed by willows, newly built garden pavilions, painted galleries, rockeries and a white stupa-like dagoba line the banks; richly dressed salt merchants and their servants wait at landing stages decorated with lanterns and silk as a line of imperial barges glides by. Spring blossom, soft light, many small figures. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.4: 1751, Suzhou: a teeming street scene inside and outside a city gate along the Grand Canal, rows of shops selling silk, porcelain and books, crowded canal boats and arched stone bridges, merchants and townspeople in Qing dress with queues; an imperial barge with yellow banners arrives along the canal, crowds kneeling on the banks. Bright spring day, hundreds of tiny figures, shop signs shown blank or illegible. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.5: 1751, Hangzhou: on West Lake an imperial dragon barge with yellow canopies glides past the willow-lined Su Causeway and its arched bridges, smaller boats of officials following; on the shore a stone stele pavilion stands with masons carving a blank tablet, and pagodas crown the wooded hills around the lake. Misty spring morning, peach blossoms, figures small, no legible text. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.6: 1751, Jiangning (Nanjing): at the foot of Purple Mountain, the emperor, seen from far behind, walks with officials along the Sacred Way of the Ming founder's tomb between rows of great stone elephants, camels and horses; beyond, on a parade ground, ranks of banner troops in coloured armour present arms under banners, and local scholars in robes watch from the side. Clear spring day, figures small. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-southern-tour.7: Summer 1751, Tongzhou near Beijing: a long fleet of imperial barges with yellow canopies and banners comes up the Grand Canal toward the canal's northern terminus, where a tall pagoda rises over the town walls; officials in summer court hats with red tassels kneel on the landing, carts and horses waiting to carry the court home. Hot hazy summer light, green willows, figures small. Painted in the style of Xu Yang's Southern Inspection Tour handscrolls, Qing court painting, fine line and mineral colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-ten-campaigns.0: 1755, the Gedeng mountains near Ili: on a moonlit night a small detachment of Qing bannermen and Mongol allies with queues, lances and matchlocks storms down a steep snowy slope into a Dzungar camp of felt yurts in a high valley, horses breaking loose, the defenders fleeing in confusion into the darkness; jagged peaks and pine forest around. Figures small, observed from above, no gore. Painted in the style of Giuseppe Castiglione's Qianlong conquest engravings, rendered as a fine monochrome copperplate-style image with delicate hatching. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.qianlong-ten-campaigns.6: Early 1789, Thang Long (Hanoi) at the lunar new year: Tay Son troops with war elephants and banners storm the earthwork forts of a Qing camp on the plain south of the city at dawn, smoke and fire rising; Qing soldiers in queues and conical hats retreat across a crowded pontoon bridge over the broad Red River, which gives way under them, boats in the water. Distant panorama, no gore. Painted in the style of the Qianlong campaign copperplate engravings, fine line with light colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.opium-war.1: 1840, Dinghai on Zhoushan island: a British squadron of sailing warships and a paddle steamer anchors in the harbour, boats ferrying red-coated troops to the quay, while above the small walled town on its hillside the Union flag flies over a captured gate; Qing war junks lie abandoned, fishing boats flee among the islands. Summer, calm sea, distant panorama, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century British naval engraving, fine hatched line, lightly coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.opium-war.4: 1842, Wusong at the mouth of the Huangpu: British warships and paddle steamers bombard long earthen gun batteries along a flat muddy shore, Qing defenders in conical hats firing cannon from embrasures under banners, white smoke billowing across the water; reed beds and the low plain stretch toward a distant Shanghai. June, hazy summer sky, distant panorama, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century British naval engraving, fine hatched line, lightly coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.opium-war.7: 1843, Victoria harbour, Hong Kong: from the water, a new colonial settlement climbs the steep green slopes of the island, with half-built stone warehouses, verandaed houses and godowns along the shore, Chinese labourers carrying stone and timber, merchant ships and junks crowding the anchorage, a British flag over a hillside building. Bright, breezy day, small figures, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine hatched line, lightly coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.taiping-rebellion.1: 1851, Yongan in Guangxi: inside a small walled county town among green karst peaks, a crowd of Taiping men and women with long unbraided hair bound in red headcloths fills a courtyard before a former yamen hall, where several leaders in yellow and red robes stand on the steps receiving titles from a figure seen small from behind; banners and spears, guards on the walls. Overcast autumn day, no legible text. Rendered in the Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph style, crisp black line with crowded figures and detailed landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.taiping-rebellion.2: 1852, Changsha: Taiping forces besiege the high brick walls of a Hunanese provincial city by the Xiang River, digging mine tunnels toward the walls from earthwork trenches, a cloud of smoke and dust bursting at one corner; Qing defenders with queues and cannon on the battlements, Yuelu mountain across the river. Autumn, distant panorama, crowded small figures, no gore. Rendered in the Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph style, crisp black line with crowded figures and detailed landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.taiping-rebellion.3: January 1853, Wuchang on the Yangtze: thousands of Taiping boats and captured junks packed with soldiers, banners, families and goods cast off from the riverbank below the walled city and the tall Yellow Crane Tower on Snake Hill, filling the wide river as they head downstream; Hanyang and Turtle Hill across the water. Cold winter light, crowded tiny figures, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese woodblock print with bright colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.taiping-rebellion.7: 1861, Anqing on the Yangtze: lines of Hunan Army trenches and earth walls encircle a walled river city, soldiers with queues in plain jackets manning the siegeworks and cannon, a fleet of Xiang Army gunboats blocking the river, while the tall multi-storey Zhenfeng pagoda rises above the riverbank; smoke over the walls. Summer haze, distant panorama, small figures, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese woodblock print, bright colour and bold line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.self-strengthening.2: 1866, Mawei on the Min River near Fuzhou: a new navy yard of brick workshops, slipways and a tall chimney spreads along the riverbank, workers with queues building a wooden-hulled steam warship on the stocks, European foremen in jackets among them; nearby, students in long gowns gather outside a school building, and the stone Luoxing pagoda stands on a hill above the river. Bright day, junks on the water, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.self-strengthening.3: 1867, Tianjin: a walled machine works compound beside the Hai River, brick workshops with iron roofs and smokestacks, gunpowder mills with water wheels and storage mounds behind earth walls, workers with queues carrying crates of cartridges to carts and riverboats; an official in a Qing robe and red-tasselled hat inspects with foreign engineers. Flat northern plain, wintry light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.self-strengthening.5: 1881, the Kaiping mines at Tangshan: a winding tower and steam engine house stand over a coal shaft, heaps of coal around, and a small steam locomotive pulls a line of loaded coal wagons along a new railway across the flat North China plain, workers with queues and onlookers in long gowns watching from beside the track; low hills behind. Clear autumn day, smoke and steam, figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.self-strengthening.7: 1890s, Hanyang at the meeting of the Han and Yangtze rivers: a vast ironworks under construction, tall blast furnaces with iron chimneys, brick rolling mills and scaffolding along the riverbank below Turtle Hill; Chinese workers with queues haul iron girders, foreign engineers direct cranes, steamers and junks unload ore; Wuchang's walls across the river. Smoky, hazy sky, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.0: 1865, Kashgar in southern Xinjiang: horsemen in turbans and quilted robes with Kokand-style weapons and banners ride through a mud-brick city gate into a busy oasis town of flat roofs, a domed mosque with a tiled gateway and minarets, bazaar crowds of Uighur townspeople stepping aside; poplar trees, dusty air and the distant Pamir snow peaks. Late afternoon light, distant view, small figures, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting with a wide desert landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.1: 1871, the Ili valley in northern Xinjiang: a column of Russian troops in white summer tunics and peaked caps, with Cossack cavalry and artillery, rides into a walled town of Chinese gate towers and mud-brick houses, a Russian flag raised over the gate; local Taranchi farmers, Kazakh herders with yurts and a few Qing officials watch from a distance. Green river meadows and snowy Tianshan peaks behind, figures small, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting with a wide landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.2: 1875, Lanzhou on the Yellow River: inside the walled city a busy arsenal yard where Qing workers in short jackets and queues forge rifle barrels and stack cannon beside a smoking brick workshop chimney; outside the gate long lines of camels and mule carts are loaded with grain sacks and powder chests, an official in Qing court robes and hat seen from behind on the steps directing them. Dry loess hills, the brown river with a waterwheel. Small figures, no legible text on sacks or banners. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting on paper, earthy ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.3: 1876, Jiayu Pass at the western end of the Great Wall: the massive earthen fortress with its three-storey gate towers stands against the barren Gobi, while a long Qing army column marches out of the western gate, infantry with rifles over their shoulders, Krupp field guns pulled by mules, camel trains carrying grain and water. The snowy Qilian mountains rise to the south; a mounted commander small at the head. Wind-blown dust, clear morning light. No legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting, wide frontier landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.5: Spring 1877, Dabancheng pass in the Tianshan: Qing infantry with rifles and Krupp cannon on wheeled carriages advance up a narrow rocky gorge toward a small mud-brick fort guarding the pass, powder smoke drifting from distant gun positions, defenders withdrawing over the ridge. Snow lingers on the high slopes, a cold green river below, the Turpan basin hazy beyond. Distant panorama, small figures, no gore, no bodies. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting, steep mountain landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.6: Early 1878, Kashgar: Qing troops in turbans and padded jackets with rifles enter the old mud-brick city through a great gate, Uyghur townspeople in long coats, doppa caps and headscarves lining the street, a domed mosque with a tiled portal and minaret towers beside poplar trees, a bazaar with melons and carpets. Winter sun, the snowy Pamirs faint on the horizon. Calm, orderly scene, small figures, no fighting. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting on paper, soft desert ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinjiang-reconquest.7: 1880, Hami oasis: on a dusty road outside the walled town, a long Qing column with banners and supply camels arrives, and among the carts a plain dark wooden coffin is carried on a cart behind an elderly commander's sedan chair, soldiers marching alongside. Melon fields, poplars and mud-brick houses, the barren Tianshan foothills behind under a pale winter sky. Small figures, solemn and resolute mood, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Chinese ink and colour painting, wide desert landscape. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.0: December 1883, Son Tay on the Red River in northern Vietnam: French marines in white helmets and blue uniforms with gunboats on the river attack the brick and bamboo-hedged citadel walls, while Black Flag fighters in black turbans and loose jackets defend the gate; smoke from artillery drifts over banana groves, rice paddies and thatched villages. Distant panorama, small figures, no gore, no bodies. No legible text on flags. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.1: March 1884, Bac Ninh in northern Vietnam: under grey drizzle, Qing soldiers in turbans and padded jackets abandon a hilltop brick fort and stream away along a muddy road through rice paddies, dropping baggage and banners, while far off French columns in white helmets advance with field guns over the ridge. Bamboo villages and limestone hills. Distant panorama, small figures, no gore, no bodies. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.3: October 1884, Tamsui in northern Taiwan: French sailors and marines land from boats onto a sandy beach and push into dense scrub and hedges, where Qing troops and local Hakka militia in turbans fire from cover; French ironclads offshore in the river mouth, the red Fort Santo Domingo on a green hill, Guanyin mountain beyond. Distant panorama, small figures, smoke, no gore, no bodies. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.4: March 1885, Zhenhai at the mouth of the Yong river, Zhejiang: Qing shore batteries on Zhaobao hill fire from stone emplacements with heavy Krupp guns at French warships offshore, white smoke billowing; sunken hulks block the channel, junks sheltering upriver, the walled town and seawall below. Distant panorama, small figures, no gore. No legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.6: March 1885, Lang Son in northern Vietnam: Qing troops in black turbans and padded jackets with rifles and banners pour along a valley road into the walled town, while French soldiers in kepis and white helmets withdraw south with mule-drawn guns through rugged limestone hills and forest. Smoke rising, overcast spring sky. Distant panorama, small figures, no gore, no bodies, no legible text on banners. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.sino-french-war.7: June 1885, Tianjin: a Qing government hall with grey tiled roofs and red columns, its doors open on a long table where Chinese officials in court robes and hats with long queues face French diplomats in dark frock coats, seen from a distance; aides wait in the courtyard, sedan chairs and a European carriage at the gate, the Hai river with junks and steamers beyond. Summer haze. No legible text on documents. Painted as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, dramatic smoke and fine hatched line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinhai-1911.0: 1895, Guangzhou: at night in a narrow Cantonese street of grey-brick houses with carved gables, Qing yamen runners in conical hats with lanterns raid a shophouse, carrying out crates of hidden rifles and bundles of flags; a few conspirators in dark changshan with long queues slip away over rooftops and down an alley toward the Pearl River, where sampans wait in the dark. Figures small, from behind, no legible text. Painted as a Meiji-era Japanese woodblock print illustration, soft colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinhai-1911.5: 22 October 1911, Changsha in Hunan: New Army soldiers in khaki uniforms and peaked caps with white armbands march through the stone gate of the city wall, crowds of townspeople, some cutting off queues, cheering along the street; a Qing yamen with its gate thrown open, a new plain white flag raised over the wall. The Xiang river with junks and Yuelu mountain beyond, autumn daylight. Figures small, no legible text. Rendered as a late-Qing illustrated newspaper lithograph, black line with sparse red and ochre tints. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.xinhai-1911.6: November 1911, Shanghai: revolutionary volunteers in mixed Western caps and armbands storm the Jiangnan Arsenal by the Huangpu river, a brick factory compound with tall chimneys, while crowds watch from the old Chinese city; steamers and sampans on the river, smoke from a burning gatehouse. Figures small, from behind, no gore, no bodies, no legible text. Painted as a Republican-era woodcut print, bold black and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.na-civil-war.5: Late 1864, rural Georgia: Union soldiers in dark blue uniforms and forage caps heat railway rails over bonfires of crossties and twist them around pine trees, while a long column of infantry, supply wagons and cattle moves along a red-clay road; a plantation's cotton gin smokes in the distance and Black families walk alongside the column. Bare autumn woods, hazy smoke, wide landscape. Figures small, no faces in detail, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century American oil history painting, soft autumn light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.mx-conquest-of-mexico.1: 1519, Tlaxcala, central Mexico: on a high plain of maize fields and pine-covered hills below the volcano Matlalcueye, Tlaxcalan lords in white cotton cloaks with red-and-white feather devices meet Spanish captains in steel morion helmets and breastplates; warriors with obsidian-edged macuahuitl clubs and quilted cotton armour stand in rows behind, horses and a small bronze cannon nearby, gifts of cloth, turkeys and maize offered. Figures small and stylised, no legible text. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.

An official in robes and black cap, seen from behind on a dyke, watches the water run off. Rainy summer, soft grey light. Painted as a Northern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-fan-zhongyan.4: 1036, Raozhou in Jiangxi: a small official boat with a mat awning sails down a river toward a quiet walled prefectural town at the edge of Poyang Lake; a demoted official in a plain robe, seen from behind, sits under the awning with a few book boxes and one servant, kilns of the porcelain country smoking faintly in the hills, reeds and herons along the bank. Grey overcast autumn, melancholy, vast water, figures tiny. Painted as a Northern Song handscroll, ink and ochre colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-fan-zhongyan.8: 1052, Xuzhou: a slow procession of an official's carriage drawn by oxen, a few attendants on foot and on ponies, halts at a roadside post station outside the walls of Xuzhou; servants hurry inside carrying medicine, the curtains of the carriage drawn, an old physician arriving. Early summer evening, long shadows, the Bian canal and Yunlong hill beyond, figures small, quiet and solemn mood, no bodies shown. Painted as a Northern Song landscape handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-yue-fei.0: 1103, Tangyin in Henan: a poor farming village of rammed-earth houses with thatched roofs on the flat North China plain, threshing floor and jujube trees, a wide river bank beyond; in a courtyard a farmer and his wife, seen from behind, stand with neighbours at the door of the house where a baby has just been born, a large bird circling overhead. Clear spring morning, wheat sprouting in the fields. No tiled mansions, no Ming or Qing dress, no queues. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-yue-fei.1: 1122, Zhending in Hebei: outside the walled city of Zhending with its tall Buddhist pagoda, a crowd of young volunteers in rough tunics and head cloths line up before a recruiting table under an awning where officers in lamellar armour enrol them; a tall young farmer, seen from behind, receives a spear, while others try drawing heavy bows. Dusty late winter plain, banners without legible writing. No Ming armour, no queues. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-yue-fei.2: 1128, Kaifeng: the battered walls of the old Song capital after the Jin sack, burnt gate towers and broken roofs, Song soldiers repairing ramparts and setting up crossbows and catapults; a grey-bearded old commander in armour and a younger officer, both seen from behind on the wall, look north over the frozen Yellow River plain where Jin cavalry campfires glow in the distance. Cold winter dusk, smoke, figures small, no gore. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-yue-fei.3: 1130, Niutou Mountain south of Jiankang: from wooded hills, Song infantry in lamellar armour with banners pour down at night onto a Jin army camp on the plain, the Jurchen horsemen scattering toward the Yangtze where their boats wait; in the distance the walls of Jiankang and the broad river under a pale moon. Torches, mist, all figures tiny and distant, no gore. Jurchen with shaved crowns and side braids, Song soldiers in Song helmets, not Ming. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-yue-fei.5: 1135, Lake Dongting: a vast lake with reed marshes and islands, Song government troops on rafts and small boats push cut grass and logs to choke the paddle wheels of the rebels' great treadle-driven paddle-wheel warships, which lie stuck among the weeds; rebel sailors surrender on the decks, banners lowered. Summer haze, distant hills and Junshan island, panoramic view, figures tiny, no gore. Painted as a Southern Song handscroll, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.0: 1084, Zhangqiu near Jinan: a scholar's family garden with a clear spring-fed pond, willows and lotus, a bamboo pavilion; a small girl in a pale jacket and skirt with two hair knots, seen from behind, sits on the pavilion steps beside her father in a plain robe and cap as he reads to her from a book roll. Summer afternoon, dappled light, blue hills of Shandong beyond. No legible text. Painted as a Northern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.1: 1101, Kaifeng: a wedding procession in the Song capital, a red-curtained bridal sedan chair carried along a lantern-lit street of shops and tea houses, musicians with drums and flutes, servants bearing boxes of gifts and bronze vessels; on the gate of a scholar's house a young man in a green robe and soft cap, seen from behind, waits to receive the bride. Evening, warm lantern glow, crowds of tiny onlookers, no legible text, no Qing costume. Painted as a Northern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.2: About 1110, Qingzhou in Shandong: in a quiet study of a country house called the Guilai Hall, a husband and wife in plain robes, seen from behind and small, bend over a table spread with ink rubbings of stone inscriptions and ancient bronze vessels, cups of tea beside them, shelves of book boxes and scrolls all around; through the open lattice, a garden with chrysanthemums and distant hills. Autumn afternoon, intimate and happy mood, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.3: 1128, Jiankang (Nanjing): on the bank of the Yangtze, a long line of ox carts and boats loaded with chests of books, scrolls and bronzes arrives at the walled city in winter; refugees in padded robes crowd the road, a woman scholar in a hooded cloak, seen from behind, walks beside the carts watching porters carry boxes up toward the prefect's residence. Grey sky, sleet, bare trees, sombre mood, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.4: 1130, the Zhejiang coast near Wenzhou: a small hired sailing junk tosses on grey waves among rocky islands, following far behind a line of court ships with banners; on deck a lone woman in a dark robe, seen from behind, clutches a few remaining scroll boxes while sailors handle the mat sail; in the water behind, a few crates drift away. Windswept winter seas, mountains along the coast, sense of flight and loss, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.5: 1132, Hangzhou: the courtyard of a prefectural court building with a broad timber hall and stone steps; a woman in a plain robe, seen from behind, stands alone before the raised judge's dais while clerks and constables in black caps look on, a man in an official robe kneels some distance away; outside the gate, curious townspeople gather under willows near West Lake. Bright, cold spring light, tense mood, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-li-qingzhao.7: About 1155, Lin'an (Hangzhou): a small, quiet house on a hillside above West Lake, an old woman with grey hair in a plain dark robe, seen from behind, sits on a veranda with a cup of wine and a single book roll beside her, looking out over the misty lake, the Su causeway and a pagoda; fallen leaves, a few faded chrysanthemums in pots. Late autumn evening, pale golden light, deep stillness, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.0: 1125, the Huai River: a large passenger boat with a covered cabin and mat sail moored by a reedy bank in a winter storm; through the lit cabin window a maid holds a swaddled newborn while a scholar in robes, seen from behind, stands at the door; along the far bank, a line of refugees with carts streams south, smoke rising over the northern horizon. Dark rain clouds, rough water, figures small. Painted as a Southern Song landscape, Xia Gui-style ink and pale wash on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.1: 1154, Lin'an (Hangzhou): the examination compound of the Southern Song capital, long rows of tiny cubicles with candidates in plain robes bent over papers; outside the gate, a crowd reads a posted list of results, and a young scholar in a plain robe, seen from behind, walks away alone through the crowd toward the misty hills around West Lake. Overcast spring, no legible text on the list or papers. Painted as a Southern Song landscape, Xia Gui-style ink and pale wash on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.2: 1158, Ningde in Fujian: a small county town of timber houses in a narrow valley between steep green mountains and the sea inlet, terraced rice fields and tea bushes on the slopes; a minor official in a green robe and black cap, seen from behind, crosses a covered wooden bridge with a servant carrying his book box toward the modest county office. Humid misty morning, clouds clinging to the peaks. Painted as a Southern Song landscape, Xia Gui-style ink and pale wash on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.4: 1172, near Nanzheng in the Han River valley: Song frontier cavalry in lamellar armour ride out through snow along the foothills of the Qinling, banners flapping, a scholar-official in a fur-lined cloak and hat, seen from behind on horseback among them, watches officers hunt and scout the northern passes toward the Jin border at Dasan Pass. Winter dusk, braziers at a hilltop watch post, vast white mountains, figures tiny. Painted as a Southern Song landscape, Xia Gui-style ink and pale wash on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.5: About 1175, Chengdu: a garden pavilion on the Brocade River with blossoming crab-apple and plum trees, a small group of scholars in loose robes and soft caps, seen from behind, drink wine and compose poems at a low table, one leaning back carelessly with his cap askew; brocade weavers' houses, a stone bridge and the city wall beyond. Warm spring afternoon, petals drifting. No legible text. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.6: 1186, Yanzhou in western Zhejiang: inside a timber workshop near the prefectural office, craftsmen carve wooden printing blocks and others ink them and press sheets of paper, drying sheets hanging from cords; an elderly official in a plain robe and cap, seen from behind, inspects a freshly printed sheet held up to the window, where the Fuchun River winds between green hills. Soft daylight, no legible text on blocks or pages. Painted as a Southern Song figure painting, fine line, ink and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lu-you.7: 1210, Shanyin (Shaoxing): a simple country house of thatch and timber among rice fields and water channels near Mirror Lake, winter; in a dim room an old man with white hair lies propped on a bed, seen from a distance, as a grown son in a plain robe kneels beside him with paper and brush; through the open door, bare trees, snow on the hills and geese flying north. Quiet, solemn, no legible text. Painted as a Southern Song landscape, Xia Gui-style ink and pale wash on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.0: 1236, Luling (Ji'an) in Jiangxi: a scholar family's country estate in a green river valley by the Gan River, whitewashed walls, grey tiled roofs and a family ancestral hall, camphor trees and rice paddies; in the courtyard servants and relatives gather at the door of the inner rooms where a baby has been born, a father in a plain robe and cap seen from behind. Clear early summer morning, mist on the river, figures small, no queues or Qing dress. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.1: 1256, Lin'an (Hangzhou): the Southern Song palace below Phoenix Hill, a great timber hall with sweeping eaves; in the courtyard rows of examination graduates in plain robes and black caps kneel on stone paving before the hall, while one young scholar, seen from behind, is led forward by officials as the first-ranked candidate; banners, parasols, court guards, West Lake hills beyond in morning haze.
