No legible text, figures small. Painted as a Southern Song court painting, fine line and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.2: 1275, Ganzhou in southern Jiangxi: on a riverside parade ground outside the walls where the Zhang and Gong rivers meet, thousands of volunteer militia, farmers and hill tribesmen with spears, bows and simple shields assemble under banners, while servants carry chests of silver and grain from a scholar's household; a commander in robes and armour, seen from behind on a horse, reviews them. Autumn, green hills, dust, figures tiny. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.3: 1276, Zhenjiang on the Yangtze: at night, a small rowing boat slips out from a creek under willows past moored Mongol warships, a handful of men in plain robes crouching low in it; on the shore Yuan camp fires and sentries with bows, the Jinshan temple pagoda dark against the moon, the wide river leading downstream. Moonlit night, tension, figures tiny and distant. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.4: 1276, Fuzhou: the walled city among mountains near the Min River, a makeshift loyalist court in a prefectural hall hung with banners, a crowd of officials in robes and black caps kneeling before a small boy emperor seen far off on a dais; at the gate a commander in robes and armour, seen from behind, mounts his horse with a small escort to ride out. Banyan trees, humid summer light, figures tiny. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wen-tianxiang.5: 1278, Wupoling near Haifeng in Guangdong: a small loyalist camp in a wooded hollow among low hills, soldiers eating at cooking fires, when Mongol cavalry in fur-trimmed coats and helmets burst from the trees on every side; the camp scatters, banners falling, a commander in robes standing still among his guards as horsemen close in. Hot afternoon, dust, figures tiny and distant, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty ink landscape handscroll, ink washes and light colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kublai-khan.0: 1251, Karakorum on the Orkhon valley steppe: a vast encampment of white felt gers around a walled town with a few timber halls, horse herds and ox carts; at the doorway of a great ceremonial tent hung with banners, a crowd of Mongol nobles in long robes and fur-trimmed hats kneels as a Mongol prince, seen from behind, receives a golden tablet of authority and gestures south across the steppe toward the Gobi. Clear summer sky, grassland, figures small. No Chinese pagodas. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.0: 1371, Kunyang in Yunnan: a Hui Muslim village on the shore of Lake Dian, courtyard houses of rammed earth and grey tile, a small mosque in Chinese timber style with upturned eaves and no minaret dome; in a courtyard, men in white caps and robes, seen from behind, gather around a father holding a newborn wrapped in cloth, red-earth hills and the blue lake beyond with fishing boats. Clear morning. No legible text. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.1: 1382, Beiping (Beijing): a column of Ming soldiers in red tunics and helmets escorts a line of captive boys from Yunnan through the gate of the Prince of Yan's palace, formerly the Yuan palace, with red walls and yellow-green glazed roofs; one small boy, seen from behind, looks up at the great gate. Cold dry northern winter, bare trees, dust in the air, figures small, sombre restrained mood, no violence shown. Painted as a Ming-dynasty ink and colour hanging scroll on silk, blue-green landscape style. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.3: 1407, the Musi River at Palembang, Sumatra: Ming treasure ships with red batten sails and smaller war junks close in on a cluster of pirate ships at the river mouth, smoke from fire arrows, pirate vessels breaking up and fleeing among the mangroves; stilt houses on the riverbanks, palm trees, local boatmen watching from canoes. Bright tropical afternoon, distant view, figures tiny, no gore. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting with a woodblock-print influence, ink and colour on silk, detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.5: 1411, Sri Lanka near Kotte: Ming soldiers in red tunics and helmets with spears and crossbows march at dawn through palm groves and paddy fields toward a Sinhalese royal fortress with timber gates and earthen walls, defenders on the ramparts in white cloth with spears; elephants in the distance, misty green hills, the coast with treasure ships far behind. Figures small, distant view, no gore. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting with a woodblock-print influence, ink and colour on silk, detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.6: 1414, Hormuz: on the island port at the mouth of the Persian Gulf, Ming treasure ships with red sails lie at anchor beyond barren red and white salt hills, small boats ferrying bales of silk and porcelain to a busy harbour of flat-roofed whitewashed houses with wind towers and a domed mosque; Persian and Arab merchants in turbans and robes trade pearls, horses and carpets on the quay with Chinese sailors. Hot hazy light, turquoise water. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting, ink and colour on silk, fine detail. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.8: About 1425, Nanjing: outside the Ming capital's great brick walls, the Bao'en Temple's Porcelain Tower rises half-built, a nine-storey octagonal pagoda clad in white glazed tiles, wrapped in bamboo scaffolding with labourers hauling tiles up ropes; officials and a stout commander in robes, seen from behind, inspect the work from the temple courtyard, kilns smoking nearby, the Qinhuai River and Zhonghua Gate beyond. Bright autumn day, many tiny figures. Painted in the style of a Ming court painting, ink and colour on silk, fine detail. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-zheng-he.9: 1431, Changle in Fujian: at the mouth of the Min River, the treasure fleet waits at anchor with sails furled; on the shore beside a Taoist temple to the sea goddess Tianfei with curved eaves, stonemasons raise a tall stone stele on a tortoise base while officials in Ming robes and a group of sailors watch; the stele face is blank, no legible text. Overcast winter sky, green hills, fishing villages. Painted as a Ming woodblock-print illustration with hand colouring. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.0: 1472, Yuyao in Zhejiang: a scholar-official family's courtyard house beside the Yao River, whitewashed walls and dark tiles, a wooden bridge and boats; at night the household gathers in the courtyard looking up as auspicious clouds glow over the roof, a grandmother holding a swaddled baby, figures small and seen from behind, Longquan hill above the town. Misty night, soft lantern light. No Qing queues or costume. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.1: 1499, Beijing: the vast examination compound near the city's east wall, rows of tiny cubicles under a pale sky, candidates in Ming scholar robes and black caps filing in through a gate past guards; beyond rise the crenellated grey walls of Beijing and the golden roofs of the Forbidden City in the distance. A young candidate, seen from behind, pauses in the courtyard. Clear spring morning, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.3: 1510, Luling (Ji'an) in Jiangxi: a small county town on the Gan River, a modest yamen with a timber gate; a magistrate in a plain Ming robe and black gauze cap, seen from behind on the steps, hears villagers who come with petitions while clerks sit at a table beneath an old camphor tree; rice fields and blue hills beyond, boats on the river. Mild spring light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.4: 1517, the mountains along the Jiangxi–Fujian–Guangdong border: Ming government troops in red coats and helmets with spears, crossbows and early matchlock hand-cannons climb steep forested ridges in a dawn mist toward a bandit stockade of logs perched on a crag; smoke rises from the stronghold as defenders scatter into the forest. Panoramic, deep green mountains, figures tiny, no gore. No Qing uniforms. Painted as a Ming battle handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.6: 1521, Shaoxing: in a large hall of a hillside academy among bamboo near the city, hundreds of students in Ming scholar robes and caps sit in rows on mats listening, seen from behind, to an older teacher at the far end of the hall; more students crowd the open doors and the courtyard, the canals and arched stone bridges of Shaoxing beyond. Gentle autumn sunlight, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.7: 1528, Duanteng Gorge in Guangxi: a narrow river gorge between steep karst cliffs wrapped in jungle, Ming troops with banners advance by boat and along cliff paths against rebel stockades on the heights, smoke rising from the hill forts; local Zhuang and Yao auxiliaries in indigo cloth climb the slopes. Humid haze, rain clouds clinging to peaks, figures tiny, no gore. Painted as a Ming battle handscroll, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-wang-yangming.8: 1529, Nan'an in southern Jiangxi: a small covered river boat moored by a quiet bank of the Zhang River on a winter evening, a lamp glowing in the cabin; through the open side, a frail old man in a plain robe lies propped up, seen from a distance, with a student kneeling beside him; bare trees, distant mountains of the Meiling pass, a still river reflecting the last light. Serene, no bodies, figures tiny. Painted as a Ming ink landscape hanging scroll in a spare literati style, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.0: 1587, Jiangyin in Jiangsu: a well-to-do family estate of white walls and grey tiles among canals and mulberry groves near the Yangtze; in the garden a boy in a light robe, seen from behind, sits in a pavilion poring over a book of maps and travel accounts while examination classics lie stacked aside, a mother watching from a doorway; the broad river and distant sails beyond. Spring, soft light, no legible text. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.1: 1613, Mount Tiantai in Zhejiang: a lone traveller in a plain robe and straw hat with a walking stick, followed by a servant carrying a bamboo pack, crosses a narrow stone bridge over a roaring waterfall gorge; the Guoqing Temple's pagoda in the misty valley below, pines, rhododendron in bloom, layered green peaks. Late spring, clear air, figures tiny. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.2: 1616, Huangshan: in deep snow, a traveller in a padded robe and hat with a stick, seen from behind with a monk guide, cuts steps up a steep icy stairway between granite pinnacles; twisted pines laden with snow, a sea of clouds below the peaks, a small temple roof half-buried. Bright cold winter morning, figures tiny against the vast mountains. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.3: 1623, Mount Hua: a traveller in a plain robe and straw hat, seen from behind with his porter, clings to iron chains on a vertical granite cliff path cut into sheer rock, near the summit of the West Peak; Taoist temple roofs perched on ridges, pines, deep chasms filling with cloud, the plain of the Wei River far below. Clear autumn day, dizzying height, figures tiny. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.4: 1633, Wutai Shan in Shanxi: on high grassy terraced plateaus, a traveller with a stick and a servant leading a mule, seen from behind, walk toward a great Buddhist monastery with a white Tibetan-style stupa and many halls in a valley, pilgrims and monks in robes on the path, snow remaining on the bare northern peaks. Cool summer wind, wide sky, figures tiny. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.5: 1637, the Xiang River near Hengyang: at night a small passenger boat moored among reeds is boarded by robbers with torches and cudgels; passengers leap into the shallow water, a traveller in a thin undergarment, seen from behind, wades ashore clutching a small bundle as the boat burns behind him; the walled town of Hengyang and dark hills far off. Moonlit, figures tiny and distant, no gore. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.6: 1637, Guilin: a traveller in a plain robe with a torch, followed by a local guide, enters a vast limestone cave with hanging stalactites and still pools; outside the cave mouth, the Li River winds among steep green karst towers with fishermen on bamboo rafts with cormorants. Soft light from the entrance, misty spring, figures tiny, the traveller seen from behind. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.7: 1638, Huangguoshu in Guizhou: a broad, thundering waterfall plunges in many white streams over a cliff of moss and ferns into a deep green pool, spray rising in rainbows; on a rocky ledge opposite, a small traveller in a plain robe and hat, seen from behind, sits with a notebook open, writing, a Buyi villager in indigo cloth standing beside him; jungle and karst hills. Bright spring sun, no legible text. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.8: 1639, Lijiang: the old town of the Naxi below snow-capped Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, stone canals and timber houses with grey roofs; in the courtyard of the Mu chieftain's grand residence, the chieftain in rich Ming-style robes receives a travelling scholar in a plain robe, both seen from a distance, attendants in Naxi dress bringing tea, manuscripts on a table. Crisp spring light, blue sky, no legible text. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.9: 1639, Tengchong near the Burmese border: a lone traveller with a stick and a tired servant, seen from behind, crests a ridge of volcanic hills covered in forest and looks out over a green basin with hot springs steaming, terraced rice fields and the small walled frontier town; far to the west, layer upon layer of blue mountains toward Burma. Humid golden evening, figures tiny. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-xu-xiake.10: 1641, Jiangyin: a small covered boat arrives home along a willow-lined canal to the family estate, servants carefully carrying an old man on a bamboo litter up the stone steps toward the gate, bundles of notebooks and rock specimens carried behind; whitewashed walls, grey roofs, winter plum in bloom, the Yangtze misty beyond. Quiet, solemn mood, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a late-Ming literati landscape hanging scroll, ink and light colour on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.0: 1785, Fuzhou: a poor scholar's narrow house of timber and grey tile in an old lane of the walled city, banyan trees and the White Pagoda rising nearby; in the small courtyard, a father in a faded long gown and queue, seen from behind, teaches a few village boys at a low table while his wife holds a newborn at the doorway. Humid summer light, Qing-period dress with shaved foreheads and queues, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.1: 1811, Beijing: the courtyard of the Hanlin Academy near the Forbidden City walls, ancient pines and stone steps, a group of new scholars in Qing official robes with mandarin square badges, hats with red finials and long queues, seen from behind, walk in a line toward a timber hall where senior academicians wait; the golden roofs of the palace beyond. Crisp spring morning, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.2: 1832, the lower Yangtze near Suzhou: after floods, labourers in short jackets and conical hats repair breached dykes and dredge canals with baskets and wooden water-wheels, while relief stations hand out rice from porridge kettles to lines of villagers; Qing officials in robes and hats with a sedan chair, seen from behind, inspect from an embankment, arched stone bridges and the pagoda of Suzhou beyond. Overcast, many small figures. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.3: 1837, Wuchang on the Yangtze: in front of the governor's yamen beneath the Yellow Crane Tower, Qing soldiers in tunics with round hats pile confiscated opium pipes and lamps on a bonfire in the square, crowds of townspeople with queues watching; officials in court robes, seen from behind, preside from a covered dais; junks on the wide river and the city of Hankou across the water. Clear winter day, many small figures, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.5: 1841, Kaifeng: on the vast flat floodplain of the Yellow River, thousands of labourers with carrying poles and baskets build up a huge dyke of earth and sorghum-stalk bundles to close a breach, muddy brown water rushing through the gap; Qing officials in robes and hats watch from tents on the embankment, one older man in plain travelling clothes among them seen from behind; the walls of Kaifeng half-flooded in the distance. Hazy autumn, many tiny figures. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.6: 1842, Ili in Xinjiang: in a wide green valley beneath the snow-capped Tianshan, Qing soldiers and Kazakh and Uyghur farmers dig long irrigation canals across the steppe toward new wheat fields, a walled Qing garrison town with a drum tower beyond; an old official in a fur-trimmed robe and hat, seen from behind on horseback, rides along the canal bank with a few attendants. Clear late summer, poplars, distant yurts and horses, figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.7: 1845, Turpan: in the hot desert oasis below the red Flaming Mountains, a line of karez shafts runs like mounds across the gravel plain toward green vineyards and mud-brick drying houses for grapes; Uyghur farmers in long coats and caps lower buckets down a shaft, while a Qing official in robes and a summer hat, seen from behind with a small escort, inspects. Blazing summer light, figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.8: 1847, Kunming: the governor-general's yamen in a walled city on the shore of Lake Dian, an ornate gate with stone lions and flagpoles, Qing officials in robes and hats with peacock feathers arriving by sedan chair, soldiers saluting; blue lake with sailing boats, the Western Hills beyond, camphor and pine trees, no eucalyptus. Bright spring light, many small figures, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-lin-zexu.9: 1850, Puning in eastern Guangdong: a procession of an elderly official's covered sedan chair with bearers and a small military escort halts at a roadside inn in a rural market town of grey brick and tile, banana trees and paddy fields around; servants rush inside, a physician arrives, townspeople with queues watch quietly. Late autumn evening, solemn mood, figures small, no bodies shown. Painted as a nineteenth-century Canton export painting, gouache on paper. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.0: 1858, Nanhai near Guangzhou: a scholar-official family's ancestral village in the Pearl River delta, grey brick houses with curved gables, a lotus pond and banyan tree, fish ponds and mulberry dykes; in the ancestral hall courtyard, relatives in long gowns and queues gather around a grandfather holding a newborn, seen from behind. Bright humid morning, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph, fine ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.1: 1879, Hong Kong: from a sampan in Victoria Harbour, a young Chinese scholar in a long gown and queue, seen from behind, gazes at the waterfront of Victoria with its colonnaded stone colonial buildings, paved streets, gas lamps and British police, Western sailing ships and steamers at anchor, the Peak rising behind. Clear day, figures small, no legible signs. Painted as a nineteenth-century Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph, fine ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.2: 1891, Guangzhou: in a simple lecture hall of an old ancestral temple used as a school, rows of young students in long gowns and queues sit at desks listening to a teacher at the front, seen from behind, piles of books and a globe on a side table; through the doorway, a courtyard with a banyan and the busy lanes of Guangzhou. Warm afternoon light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph, fine ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.4: 1895, Shanghai: a reading room in a two-storey brick building on a busy street of the foreign settlement, gentlemen in long gowns, queues and skullcaps read newspapers and pamphlets at long tables, others crowd in at the door; outside, rickshaws, gas lamps and Western-style shopfronts along the Bund, steamers on the Huangpu beyond. Grey autumn light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph, fine ink line. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.6: 1898, Yokohama harbour on the way to Tokyo: a Japanese steamer with a tall funnel docks at a stone quay, a Chinese exile in a long gown and queue with a few companions, seen from behind, walks down the gangplank under the watch of Japanese policemen in Western-style uniforms; Meiji-era brick warehouses, rickshaws and Mount Fuji faintly on the horizon. Autumn morning, figures small. Rendered in the Dianshizhai Pictorial lithograph style, detailed black line with light hand colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.7: 1899, Victoria in British Columbia: a meeting in a wooden hall in Chinatown, crowds of Chinese labourers and merchants in long gowns, padded jackets and queues fill the room facing a small platform, seen from behind; outside, a muddy street of clapboard shops with lanterns and balconies, horse-drawn carts, the harbour with sailing ships and fir-covered hills. Rainy summer evening, lamplight, no legible text. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.8: 1913, Shanghai: a funeral procession of a mourning family in white hemp cloth moves along a street of the International Settlement, white banners without legible text, a hearse carriage, musicians, then turns in at the gate of a large garden villa; tramcars, rickshaws and men in both long gowns and Western suits watch, plane trees along the road. Overcast autumn day, figures small. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kang-youwei.10: 1927, Qingdao: a red-tiled German-era villa on a hillside overlooking the sea, pine trees in the garden; on the veranda an old man in a long gown sits in a wicker chair seen from behind and far away, looking across Huiquan Bay with its sandy beach, the Zhanqiao pier and a lighthouse, a few steamers on the water. Hazy spring afternoon, quiet mood, figures small. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.0: 1866, Cuiheng village in Xiangshan county, Guangdong: a small farming village among banana groves and rice paddies near the Pearl River estuary, mud-brick houses with grey tile roofs, a large banyan tree by a pond; a peasant woman with a baby on her back, seen from behind, walks along a paddy dyke past men in conical hats with water buffalo, low green hills and the sea beyond. Bright humid morning, figures small, Qing-era dress and queues. Painted as a Meiji-era Japanese woodblock print illustration, soft colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.1: 1879, Honolulu: a Chinese boy with a queue, in a plain jacket, seen from behind, walks with his older brother through the gate of a school with white wooden buildings and verandas, Hawaiian, Chinese and white schoolboys in Victorian clothes in the yard; palm trees, Diamond Head beyond, sailing ships in the harbour. Bright tropical sun, figures small. Painted as a Meiji-era Japanese woodblock print illustration, soft colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.2: 1887, Hong Kong: a lecture room in a colonial building with tall windows, a skeleton and anatomical charts without legible text, a British doctor in a frock coat lecturing to a handful of Chinese students in long gowns and queues seated at benches, seen from behind; through the window, the harbour with steamers and the hills of Kowloon. Clear daylight, figures small. Painted as a Meiji-era Japanese woodblock print illustration, soft colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.3: 1895, Guangzhou at night: in a dim back room of a shop, a few conspirators in long gowns and queues hurriedly hide crates of rifles and banners while one watches at the door; outside, Qing soldiers with lanterns and old rifles search the narrow lanes; a small boat waits on the Pearl River below to carry a young man away toward Hong Kong. Tense night, lantern light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Meiji-era Japanese woodblock print illustration, soft colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.4: 1896, London: a foggy street in Marylebone with rows of tall Georgian townhouses, one with a Chinese dragon flag over its door; on the pavement outside, a crowd of Londoners in bowler hats and overcoats, newspaper reporters and police constables in tall helmets gather by the railings, gas lamps glowing, a hansom cab waiting. Grey autumn afternoon, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Victorian illustrated-newspaper engraving with light hand colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.6: 1911, Denver: a wide street of brick commercial buildings, streetcars and early automobiles beneath the snowy Rocky Mountains; in a hotel lobby with tall windows, a Chinese man in a Western suit with short hair, seen from behind, stands reading a newspaper with no legible headline, other guests in bowler hats around him. Clear October morning, crisp light, figures small. Painted as a Republican-era woodcut print, bold black and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.8: 1917, Guangzhou: on the Pearl River, a few grey navy gunboats with funnels moored before the arcaded waterfront of the Bund, sailors in white uniforms on deck; ashore, soldiers in grey uniforms and officials in suits gather at the gate of an old cement works used as a headquarters, flags flying, a crowd watching. Hot summer day, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a Republican-era woodcut print, bold black and red. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.9: 1923, Shanghai: in the garden of a two-storey European-style house in the French Concession, plane trees and a lawn, two men in Western suits, seen from behind and small, talk on a veranda over a table with papers and teacups, a few aides waiting; beyond the garden wall, a quiet tree-lined street with rickshaws and a motor car. Soft winter light, no legible text. Painted as a 1920s watercolour sketch, loose washes. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sun-yat-sen.11: 1925, Beijing: a hushed courtyard house of grey brick and tiled roofs in early spring, bare trees, a crowd of mourners in long gowns and Western suits, seen from behind, standing silently in the courtyard; at the gate, students with white flowers and Nationalist flags of blue sky and white sun, and a black motor car waiting. Cold grey light, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a 1920s watercolour sketch, loose washes. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.0: 247 BCE, Carthage: from a hillside on the Byrsa, a wide view over the great Phoenician city, flat-roofed whitewashed houses climbing the slopes, the circular naval harbour with its central island and ship sheds, merchant ships in the rectangular harbour; in a rooftop courtyard of a noble house, women in long robes, seen from behind, hold a newborn while a bearded man in a Punic tunic and cloak looks out to sea. Bright Mediterranean morning, figures small. No Roman legionaries, no arches. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.1: 237 BCE, Gades (Cádiz): a Carthaginian fleet of oared galleys and broad transport ships unloads soldiers, horses and supplies on a beach below the island city with its temple of Melqart on the headland; a bearded general in a bronze cuirass and cloak and a boy of about nine, both seen from behind and small, step ashore together; Iberian tribesmen watch from dunes. Bright Atlantic light, blue sea, no stirrups, no elephants yet. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.2: 221 BCE, Carthago Nova (Cartagena): the walled port city on its hills above a sheltered lagoon harbour; on a parade ground outside the walls, ranks of Libyan spearmen, Iberian warriors in white tunics with purple borders and Numidian horsemen raise their weapons and shout, acclaiming a young commander in a cuirass who stands on a raised platform, seen from behind and small. War elephants beyond, dust, clear sky. No stirrups, no Roman eagles. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.3: 219 BCE, Saguntum: on its long rocky hill above the coastal plain, the walled Iberian city of Saguntum under siege; Carthaginian troops push a wheeled battering ram and siege tower against breached stone walls, defenders on the ramparts throwing javelins and burning missiles, a camp of tents and horses on the plain below, olive groves and the sea beyond. Summer haze, smoke, figures tiny and distant, no gore, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.5: 217 BCE, Lake Trasimene: at dawn, thick mist lies over the lake shore and a narrow strip of flat land beneath wooded hills; a long Roman column in marching order is surprised as Carthaginian, Gallic and Spanish troops charge down from the hills on every side, shapes half-hidden in fog, standards toppling, the grey lake behind. Cold early morning, figures tiny, no gore, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, small tesserae, warm earth colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.8: 195 BCE, Ephesus: the Hellenistic harbour city at the mouth of the Cayster, marble colonnades and a theatre on the hillside, Seleucid ships moored at the quays; on a terrace of the royal residence, an old Carthaginian general in a plain cloak, seen from behind, walks beside a Hellenistic king in a diadem and purple chlamys, courtiers and Macedonian guards with long spears following. Warm afternoon light, figures small. Painted in the manner of a Roman mosaic, small coloured tesserae, warm earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-hannibal.9: 183 BCE, Libyssa in Bithynia: a lonely fortified villa on a hill above the Sea of Marmara, cypress trees and vineyards around; at dusk, Bithynian soldiers and Roman envoys with lictors approach along the coastal road, while inside the villa's courtyard an old man in a cloak, seen from behind, stands alone holding a small cup, looking at the sea. Melancholy evening light, figures small, no bodies shown. Painted in the manner of a Roman mosaic, small coloured tesserae, warm earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.0: 100 BCE, Rome: in the Subura below the Esquiline, an old patrician house with a modest atrium, wax ancestor masks in wall cupboards and an impluvium pool; women in long stolae, seen from behind, gather around a midwife holding a newborn, a household shrine with small bronze gods, while the crowded tenements of the Subura rise outside the doorway. Soft morning light, figures small, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, deep red and black walls. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.1: 75 BCE, the Aegean near the island of Pharmacusa: a fleet of small Roman-hired warships with oars and square sails closes in on a pirate stronghold on a rocky islet, the pirates' light galleys beached below a cliff fort; armed marines leap ashore, pirates throwing down their weapons. Bright midday sea, distant view, figures tiny, no crucifixions or bodies shown. Painted in the style of a Pompeian fresco, deep red and black walls. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.2: 61 BCE, Lusitania in Further Spain: a Roman army column with legionaries in mail and oval shields, eagle standards and pack mules winds through rugged hills toward a hillfort of round stone huts on a summit, Lusitanian warriors on the walls with small round shields and spears; the Roman commander on horseback, seen from behind among officers, points toward the fort. Hot dry summer, oak and scrub, figures small, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.4: 55 BCE, the coast of Kent: Roman warships and transports with oars and square sails lie off white chalk cliffs; legionaries in mail with oval shields jump into the surf and wade ashore behind an eagle standard, while Britons on the beach with chariots, horsemen and blue-painted warriors with long shields wait on the shingle. Grey windy day, choppy sea, figures small, no gore, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, earthy reds and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.5: 52 BCE, Alesia in Gaul: seen from far above, the oppidum on its flat-topped hill, surrounded by two great rings of Roman siege works, ditches, palisades and wooden towers, legionaries manning the ramparts; on the outer plain a vast Gallic relief army charges against the outer wall while horsemen sweep around. Autumn, wooded hills, dust and smoke, figures tiny, no gore, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco, soft greens and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.8: 48 BCE, Alexandria: the great harbour seen from above, the tall Pharos lighthouse on its island, Egyptian and Roman ships burning near the quays, smoke drifting over the warehouses and colonnaded palaces of the Ptolemies; Roman legionaries hold barricades in the palace quarter as crowds of Alexandrian troops press in through the streets. Hot hazy afternoon, figures tiny, no gore. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, deep red and ochre with soft modelling. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.9: 47 BCE, Zela in Pontus: on a hillside in northern Anatolia, Pontic scythed chariots and infantry charge uphill against Roman legionaries who are digging a fortified camp on the ridge; the legions throw down their tools, form ranks with oval shields and drive the enemy back down the slope. Summer, green hills, dust clouds, seen from a distance, figures tiny, no gore, no stirrups. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-caesar.10: 46 BCE, Thapsus on the African coast: a coastal plain beside a salt lagoon, with the walled city of Thapsus by the sea; Roman legions advance on a Pompeian army with its line of Numidian war elephants, which panic and turn back through their own ranks, Roman trumpeters blowing long straight tubae. Bright hot day, dust and sea glare, distant view, figures tiny, no gore. Painted in the style of a Roman mosaic, small tesserae, warm earth colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.0: About 5 CE, Tarsus in Cilicia: a bustling Hellenistic-Roman city on the Cydnus river, colonnaded streets and flat-roofed houses, the snowy Taurus mountains behind; in a courtyard of a Jewish household, a tentmaker's looms of goat-hair cloth stand by the wall while family members in tunics and mantles, seen from behind, gather around a mother with a newborn. Warm morning light, figures small. No churches, no crosses. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, soft earth tones and architectural perspective. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.1: About 33 CE, Jerusalem: in a shaded colonnade of Herod's Temple courts with massive white limestone walls and gilded gate, a teacher in a long mantle sits among a semicircle of young students in tunics and fringed cloaks, seen from behind, listening; worshippers and doves in the bright courtyard beyond, the Mount of Olives in the distance. Midday light, figures small, no legible text, no domes or mosques. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, soft earth tones and architectural perspective. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.2: About 34 CE, Damascus: at night, beneath the massive stone city wall with its houses built along the top, a large rope basket is lowered from a window toward the ground, a man inside it seen from behind, while a few friends above hold the ropes and guards with torches pace at a gate far off; palm trees and orchards beyond, starry sky. Figures small, tense quiet mood. Painted in the style of a Roman fresco from Pompeii, soft earth tones and architectural perspective. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.5: About 50 CE, Corinth: a busy colonnaded market street below the rock of Acrocorinth and its temple, shops with awnings; in an open workshop, a couple and a man in a plain tunic, seen from behind, stitch large panels of leather and goat-hair cloth into tents on a workbench, rolls of hide and tools around, customers passing. Warm Greek afternoon light, figures small, no legible text. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.6: About 55 CE, Ephesus: the great open-air theatre on Mount Pion packed with an angry crowd, people in tunics and cloaks shouting and waving their arms, silversmiths holding up small silver shrines, the marble Arcadian Way leading down to the harbour; a few companions, seen from behind, slip away along a side street. Hot afternoon, dust, figures tiny, no violence shown. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.7: About 57 CE, Jerusalem: in the vast outer court of Herod's Temple, a crowd surges around a man in a travel-worn cloak, seen from a distance, as Roman soldiers in mail and helmets with oval shields hurry down the steps from the Antonia fortress to pull him away; the white marble Temple sanctuary with its gilded facade rising behind. Bright light, dust, figures small, no gore, no domes. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.8: About 59 CE, Malta: a Roman grain ship broken on rocks in a bay, its square sail torn, in a storm's grey aftermath; soldiers, sailors and prisoners in tunics wade and swim ashore clinging to planks, and on the beach islanders light a large fire in the rain; one man, seen from behind, adds an armful of brushwood to it. Cold wind, overcast sky, figures small, no bodies. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.9: About 61 CE, Rome: a rented upper room of a multi-storey tenement, sunlight from a window overlooking tiled roofs and the distant temples on the Capitoline; a man in a plain tunic and cloak, seen from behind, sits talking with a small group of visitors in tunics and veils, a Roman soldier with a light chain at his wrist resting on a stool nearby. Quiet afternoon, warm light, no legible text. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-paul.10: About 65 CE, Aquae Salviae outside Rome: a small group of Roman soldiers leads a grey-bearded prisoner in a cloak along a country road through a quiet marshy valley of springs and pine trees beyond the city walls; a few followers watch from a distance, the aqueducts and walls of Rome on the horizon. Grey dawn light, sorrowful mood, figures tiny, no violence or execution shown. Painted in the style of an early Christian catacomb fresco, soft earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.1: About 582 CE, Bosra in southern Syria: a long camel caravan from Arabia, loaded with leather bales, rests outside the black basalt walls of the Roman city with its colonnades and theatre, near a small stone monastery with a cell; merchants in robes and headcloths water camels at a cistern, seen far off. No central figure is depicted, no prophet shown. Dry golden evening, flat plain. Painted in the style of an Ottoman manuscript painting, gold sky, flat forms, tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.3: 619 CE, Ta'if: a high green mountain town of stone houses with orchards, vineyards and walled gardens among granite hills, cool and fertile above the desert; on the rocky road leading away down toward Mecca, a small cloud of dust far off and townspeople gathered at the town gate. No person is shown in detail, no prophet depicted. Late afternoon light. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, gold sky, landscape dominated. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.6: 625 CE, Mount Uhud north of Medina: a long, reddish-brown granite mountain rising over a dusty plain with palm groves; seen from a great distance, small groups of riders and men on foot with banners move across the plain and up the lower slopes, a small archers' hill to one side, dust drifting. No figure shown in detail or identifiable, no prophet depicted, no gore. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, gold sky, landscape dominated. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.7: 628 CE, Hudaybiyyah on the edge of the sacred territory of Mecca: a large encampment of pilgrims in plain white garments with sacrificial camels garlanded for offering, tents pitched near a well and an acacia tree on a stony plain; envoys on camels ride between this camp and the distant hills of Mecca. No figure shown in detail, no prophet depicted. Clear morning light. Painted in the style of an Ottoman manuscript painting, gold sky, flat forms, tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.9: 630 CE, Tabuk in northwestern Arabia: a vast army of riders on camels and horses camps around palm groves and springs at the oasis, tents spread across the sand under dramatic sandstone mesas, while small delegations of tribesmen arrive from the north on camels. No figure shown in detail, no prophet depicted, no battle. Hot summer haze, gold sky. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, gold sky, landscape dominated. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.10: 632 CE, Mount Arafat near Mecca: a great multitude of pilgrims in simple white garments fills the wide plain around the low granite hill, tents and camels scattered, all facing the hill; seen from a great distance, no single figure singled out or depicted in detail, no prophet shown. Bright afternoon sun, shimmering heat, rocky mountains around. Painted in the style of an Ottoman manuscript painting, gold sky, flat forms, tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-me-muhammad.11: 632 CE, Medina: a quiet oasis town of flat-roofed mud-brick houses among date palms; the simple early mosque, an open courtyard enclosed by mud-brick walls with a roof of palm trunks and fronds on one side, small dwellings opening onto it; townspeople gather silently outside. No domes, no minarets, no figure depicted in detail, no prophet shown. Soft evening light. Painted in the style of an Ottoman manuscript painting, gold sky, flat forms, tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.0: 1137, Tikrit on the Tigris: a fortified castle of mud brick and stone on a high bluff above the broad river, the small town below with flat roofs and palm groves, boats on the water; at night, a family's servants in robes and turbans hurry out of the castle gate with lanterns and a cradle, horses being saddled. Starry night, figures small, no faces in detail. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.1: About 1140, Baalbek: the colossal Roman temple ruins with their six standing columns, converted into a walled citadel, rise over a green valley of the Beqaa with orchards and poplars, snowy Lebanon mountains beyond; in a courtyard within the citadel, a small boy in a robe and turban, seen from behind, plays with a wooden sword near guards in mail. Spring morning light, figures small. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.2: 1154, Damascus: Nur ad-Din's troops in mail and turbans with banners ride through an open gate in the city wall, welcomed by townspeople, the great Umayyad Mosque's dome and minarets rising above flat roofs and gardens, the Barada river and orchards of the Ghouta around; a young rider among the cavalry, seen from behind. Clear spring day, figures small. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.3: 1164, Bilbeis on the eastern edge of the Nile Delta: a walled town of mud brick surrounded by a camp of Frankish knights in mail with kite shields and Fatimid troops; Syrian Turkish and Kurdish soldiers with round shields and bows defend the walls from towers. Hot dusty summer, palms and canals, seen from a distance, figures tiny, no gore. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.4: 1167, Alexandria: the walled city by the sea with its towering Pharos lighthouse, under siege by Frankish galleys in the harbour and a camp of Crusader knights and Fatimid troops on land; defenders in mail and turbans man the towers, while townspeople carry supplies along the walls. Windy afternoon, seen from far above, figures tiny, no gore. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.6: 1174, Damascus: a long column of Ayyubid cavalry in mail coats, turbans over conical helmets and flowing surcoats rides through the open gate of the stone city walls, yellow banners raised, townspeople and notables in robes coming out to greet them. Beyond the walls rise the dome and minaret of the Umayyad Mosque, the citadel and orchards of the Ghouta, with Mount Qasyun behind. Horses with small round shields hanging at saddles, no plate armour, no Ottoman pencil minarets. Warm afternoon light. Painted in the style of an Islamic manuscript painting, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.10: 1191, Arsuf, coast of Palestine: on a dusty coastal plain between the sea and oak woods, a tight column of crusader knights in mail hauberks and flat-topped great helms with kite and heater shields charges out of its marching order, crossbowmen behind them, while light Ayyubid horse archers in turbans and mail wheel away toward wooded hills; the crusader fleet sails alongside offshore. Dust and banners, seen from a distance, no bodies, no plate armour. Painted in the style of a thirteenth-century illuminated manuscript such as the Chronicles of Matthew Paris, flat colours, ink outlines, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-saladin.11: 1193, Damascus: a quiet funeral procession of mourners in plain dark robes and turbans carries a simple bier wrapped in modest cloth through a narrow street toward a small domed tomb beside the high stone walls of the Umayyad Mosque, its arcades and minaret rising above. Soldiers lower their banners, poor townspeople line the walls, and an almost empty treasure chest stands open in a courtyard nearby. No faces in close-up, no Ottoman architecture. Soft grey morning light. Painted in the style of a thirteenth-century illuminated manuscript, flat colours, ink outlines, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-mansa-musa.0: About 1312, Niani on the upper Niger: a royal compound of round and rectangular mud-brick buildings with thatched conical roofs inside an earthen enclosure, set among baobab trees and green savanna by a river. In an open court a mansa, seen small and from a distance, sits under a silk parasol on a raised dais, flanked by guards with spears and bows and griots with drums and balafons, courtiers bowing low and sprinkling dust; gold dust in calabashes is brought from the goldfields. Painted in the style of the Catalan Atlas and a West African Islamic manuscript painting, warm earth tones and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-mansa-musa.1: 1324, the Tuat oases in the central Sahara: a vast caravan of camels arrives at a green oasis of date palms and earthen ksour with crenellated mud walls, water drawn from foggara channels, the travellers in white and indigo robes and turbans unloading sacks of gold dust, servants carrying gold staffs, a king's tent with a parasol pitched under the palms; endless dunes stretch behind under a hot pale sky. Painted in the style of the Catalan Atlas and a medieval Islamic manuscript painting, gold leaf and lapis blue, decorative. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-mansa-musa.4: 1325, Cairo: inside a Mamluk merchant's caravanserai courtyard with stone arcades and carved wooden mashrabiya balconies, Malian officials in white robes and indigo turbans sit on carpets with Cairene merchants in turbans and striped kaftans, weighing small piles of gold on brass balances and handing over loan goods; bales and camels wait in the yard, a stone Mamluk minaret with balconies seen over the roofs. No Ottoman pencil minarets, no legible text on the papers. Painted in the style of a medieval Islamic manuscript painting, gold leaf and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-mansa-musa.5: 1325, Gao on the Niger: a royal caravan of horsemen and camels in white and indigo robes halts on the riverbank before a town of flat-roofed mud-brick houses and a mud-brick mosque with a pyramidal minaret, long pirogues pulled up on the sand. Two young Songhai princes in fine robes are led on horseback to join the train, escorted by Malian guards with spears, townspeople watching from the walls. Bright river light, low acacias. Painted in the style of a West African Islamic manuscript painting, warm earth tones and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-mansa-musa.7: About 1337, Niani: a royal funeral in the mud-brick palace town by the river, a long procession of courtiers in white robes, griots with drums and kora, and guards with lowered spears moving slowly toward a domed mud tomb under baobab trees, women in indigo cloth standing in rows, a riderless horse with gold trappings and a closed parasol carried behind; evening light over the savanna. No bodies shown. Painted in the style of a West African Islamic manuscript painting, warm earth tones and ochres, muted gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.0: 1451, Genoa: the crowded harbour of the Ligurian port, tall striped stone houses and the Lanterna lighthouse above, galleys and round-hulled carracks at the quays. In the foreground a small workshop with a wooden handloom where a weaver works wool, while a boy in a simple tunic and cap, seen from behind, looks out at the ships and sailors loading bales. Fifteenth-century clothing, hose and short doublets, no modern buildings. Painted as a sixteenth-century Italian oil painting with fine detail, warm morning light, calm water. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.1: 1476, off Cape St Vincent and the Portuguese coast: a wide sea-scene of burning Genoese merchant ships under a smoky sky far offshore, and in the foreground a lone sailor in a shirt clinging to a long oar drifting toward a sandy beach below red cliffs; on the horizon, the hills and church towers of the Algarve. Restrained, distant, no bodies. Painted as a sixteenth-century Iberian oil painting with fine detail, dramatic dawn light, heavy waves. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.2: 1492, Santa Fe near Granada: the newly built square camp-town of the Catholic Monarchs with simple whitewashed buildings, royal pavilions and banners of Castile and Aragon, the snowy Sierra Nevada and the red Alhambra on its hill in the distance. In a courtyard a mariner in a dark cloak, seen from behind, kneels before the king and queen seated under a canopy, courtiers and friars around, a sea chart unrolled on a table with no legible text. Painted as a late fifteenth-century Spanish panel painting with fine detail, gold highlights. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.4: 12 October 1492, Guanahani in the Bahamas: on a white sand beach fringed by palms and green scrub, two longboats of Spanish sailors in doublets, caps and steel helmets come ashore, a captain planting a royal banner, while Lucayan Taíno men and women with bare skin and body paint watch curiously from the trees; offshore lie two caravels and a carrack with red crosses on their sails, turquoise shallows and coral. Morning light. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish oil painting with fine detail, warm light, calm water. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.5: Christmas 1492, off Hispaniola: at night a carrack lies heeled over on a coral reef under a moonlit sky, sailors in boats ferrying barrels and timbers to a beach where Taíno canoes help them; on shore, men build a small wooden fort from the ship's planks beside a village of round thatched houses of the cacique Guacanagarí, palms and green hills behind. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.6: 1493, Barcelona: in a Gothic stone hall of the royal palace, a mariner seen from behind kneels before the king and queen seated on a dais under a canopy of cloth of gold, courtiers in rich gowns and velvet caps crowding round, while Taíno men in feather headdresses stand nearby with parrots in cages, cotton and gold ornaments laid on cushions. Tall arched windows, banners. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.7: 1494, La Isabela on the north coast of Hispaniola: a raw new settlement of stone and timber houses, a church and storehouse rising on a low bluff above a bay crowded with seventeen ships, settlers in doublets and helmets unloading horses, pigs and barrels, colonists digging and building, Taíno people watching warily from the forest edge, palms and mountains behind. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.9: 1500, Santo Domingo, Hispaniola: in a small colonial town of stone and timber houses beside the Ozama river, soldiers in breastplates and morion helmets lead a grey-haired man in a plain cloak, his wrists in iron chains, down to a waiting caravel at the riverbank; a royal official in black watches, settlers and friars stand aside in silence, palms and tropical hills behind. Seen from a distance. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.10: 1503, St Ann's Bay, Jamaica: two worm-eaten caravels lie beached side by side in shallow water, their decks roofed over with palm thatch as shelters, sailors in ragged shirts living aboard, Taíno canoes coming out with cassava and fish to trade; a green bay ringed by lush forested hills under a tropical sky. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-columbus.11: 1506, Valladolid in Castile: a modest room in a town house, an old man in a dark gown lying on a curtained bed seen from across the room, a friar and sons at his side, a sea chest, a globe and rolled papers with no legible text on a table; through the window, the brick and stone church towers of Valladolid under a pale May sky. Quiet and sombre. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.0: 1480, northern Portugal: a small granite manor house with a stone coat-of-arms carved blank above the door, set among terraced vineyards and chestnut woods in the hills of Trás-os-Montes, a family in late fifteenth-century dress at the gate; on the road below, a boy page in a short doublet rides off with a servant toward the distant royal court. Soft morning mist in the valley. Painted as a sixteenth-century Portuguese oil painting, fine detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.1: March 1505, Lisbon on the Tagus: a great fleet of over twenty carracks and caravels with red crosses of the Order of Christ on their sails crowds the river before the city, the royal palace on the riverfront and the castle on the hill behind; boats carry soldiers in breastplates and morions and barrels out to the ships, crowds and friars on the quay. Painted as a sixteenth-century Flemish marine picture, fine rigging detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.2: 1509, off Diu in Gujarat: Portuguese carracks with red-cross sails fire broadsides in clouds of smoke against a fleet of Mamluk and Gujarati galleys and dhows near the walled island port, its stone bastions and minarets on the shore, oars broken, sails on fire in the distance. Seen from far off, no bodies, no gore. Painted as a sixteenth-century Flemish marine picture, fine rigging detail, golden smoky light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.3: 1511, Malacca: Portuguese soldiers in breastplates and morion helmets with pikes and arquebuses storm across the river bridge into the city, carracks firing from the estuary; the sultan's wooden palace with tiered roofs, a mosque with a tiered roof, stilt houses and junks in the harbour, defenders with kris and spears and war elephants falling back, smoke over the palms. Distant, no bodies. Painted as a sixteenth-century Flemish oil painting, fine detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.4: 1513, Azemmour on the Atlantic coast of Morocco: Portuguese soldiers in breastplates with pikes and arquebuses skirmish with Moroccan horsemen in white burnouses on a dusty plain outside the walled town on the Oum Er-Rbia river, its ochre walls, gate and minaret behind; in the foreground a wounded officer leaning on comrades limps back toward the lines. Distant, no blood. Painted as a sixteenth-century Portuguese oil painting, fine detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.5: 1517, Seville: the busy riverbank of the Guadalquivir below the Torre del Oro and the Giralda tower of the cathedral, ships loading for the Indies; in a stone hall of the Casa de Contratación nearby, a weathered Portuguese captain seen from behind spreads a globe and charts before Spanish officials in black gowns, with no legible text on the maps. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish oil painting, fine detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.7: 1520, Puerto San Julián in Patagonia: a bleak grey bay under a cold winter sky, five carracks at anchor with lowered yards, a rough camp of tents on a gravel shore, soldiers in helmets and cloaks gathered in a tense crowd around an officer reading a sentence; at a distance a small boat rows two men toward an empty island. Low scrubland, wind, no bodies, no gore. Painted as a sixteenth-century Flemish marine picture, muted cold light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-magellan.9: March 1521, Guam: three battered carracks with torn sails anchor in a blue lagoon off a green island of palms and limestone cliffs, gaunt sailors in rags hauling themselves to the rails, while fleets of fast Chamorro outrigger proas with triangular sails surround them, islanders bringing coconuts and fish; thatched houses raised on latte stone pillars along the beach. Painted as a sixteenth-century engraving in the style of Theodor de Bry, with fine hatched lines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.0: 1483, Eisleben in the county of Mansfeld: a November evening in a small Saxon mining town with steep-roofed half-timbered houses and the tower of St Peter's church, smoke rising from smelting huts in the hills beyond, slag heaps and mine shafts with wooden windlasses; townspeople in late-medieval hoods and cloaks walk to the church with a swaddled baby for baptism. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.1: 1484, Mansfeld: a small town clustered below a hilltop castle, copper mines and smelting furnaces with plumes of smoke on the slopes, miners with lamps and picks walking to work; in a Latin school room, boys in plain tunics sit on benches with slates while a schoolmaster with a rod paces, seen through an open door. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.2: 1498, Eisenach in Thuringia: a snowy street of half-timbered houses below the Wartburg on its wooded hill, a group of poor schoolboys in cloaks and caps singing carols at the doors with breath steaming, a well-to-do townswoman at a doorway giving them bread; church towers and a town gate behind. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.3: 1505, near Stotternheim outside Erfurt: on an open country road in a violent summer thunderstorm, a young law student in a dark cloak and student's cap, seen from behind, has fallen to his knees as lightning strikes a tree nearby, rain sweeping across the fields; far off, the towers of Erfurt cathedral and the walled Augustinian friary. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.4: 1510, Rome: two dusty Augustinian friars in black habits with walking staffs, seen from behind, arrive at the Porta del Popolo and look down on a chaotic Renaissance city of ancient ruins, church domes, the half-built crossing of new St Peter's, crowds of pilgrims, cardinals' retinues on horseback, merchants and street sellers. No modern dome of St Peter's yet. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.6: October 1518, Augsburg: at night a friar in a black habit rides out on a small horse through a narrow postern gate in the city wall, a guide with a lantern leading the way, the towers and gabled merchant houses of the imperial city dark behind under a cloudy moon; earlier, a cardinal's red hat and a hall with candles can be glimpsed through a lit window above. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.7: 1519, Leipzig: in a great vaulted hall of the Pleissenburg castle, two scholars in black gowns face each other from opposite wooden lecterns hung with tapestries, an audience of professors, students with halberd-armed guards and Saxon nobles packed on benches, notaries writing at a table with no legible text. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.8: April 1521, Worms: in a crowded hall of the bishop's palace lit by evening torches, a lone friar in a black habit, seen from behind, stands before a young emperor seated on a canopied throne, surrounded by electors, princes in furred robes, bishops and Spanish guards; a table piled with books, no legible titles. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.9: 1521, Wartburg Castle in Thuringia: a small panelled room high in the castle with a tiled green stove and a window over endless wooded hills, a bearded man disguised as a knight in a plain doublet, seen from behind, writes at a wooden table piled with Greek and Latin books, a candle and ink; no legible text. Autumn forest outside. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.10: 1530, Coburg Fortress: a vast hilltop castle with walls and towers above the Franconian countryside, jackdaws wheeling round its roofs; on a wall walk a stout man in a dark gown, seen from behind, hands a sealed letter to a mounted courier who sets off down the road toward the distant south. Summer light, fields and villages below. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-luther.11: February 1546, Eisleben: a snowy winter street of the mining town at dusk, a funeral procession in black cloaks with torches carrying a draped coffin toward a covered wagon, mounted horsemen of the counts of Mansfeld riding escort, townspeople and miners standing bareheaded along the houses; church bells in the tower above. No bodies visible. Rendered as a sixteenth-century German woodcut in the style of Lucas Cranach's workshop, hand-coloured. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.0: 1769, Ajaccio, Corsica: a sunlit Mediterranean harbour town of tall ochre and pale stone houses with green shutters, a Genoese citadel on the point and fishing feluccas with lateen sails in the bay, maquis-covered mountains behind. A crowd of townspeople in eighteenth-century dress, women in shawls, gathers outside a modest town house as a baby is carried to the cathedral for baptism; French soldiers in white coats and tricorns pass by. Painted as a late eighteenth-century European history painting, oil on canvas, warm light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.1: 1779, Brienne-le-Château in Champagne: a winter courtyard of the royal military school, a long classical building with tall windows run by Minim friars; cadets in blue uniforms with red facings and tricorn hats build snow forts and stage a snowball battle, while a small boy at a distance directs one side; bare trees and the château on its hill behind. Painted as a late eighteenth-century French genre painting, oil on canvas, cold soft light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.2: December 1793, Toulon: from a hill above the harbour at night, French Republican artillery in blue coats and bicornes fire cannon from earthwork batteries toward a British fort, flashes lighting the rain; below, the great natural harbour full of British and Spanish warships, some burning, smoke drifting across the town and the sea, mountains behind. Distant, no gore. Painted as a late eighteenth-century European history painting, oil on canvas, dramatic firelight. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.3: November 1796, Arcole in northern Italy: amid flat marshland and dykes, French soldiers in blue coats and bicornes, with tricolour flags, surge toward a narrow wooden bridge over a canal under Austrian musket fire from white-coated infantry on the far bank, a young general with a flag at the front seen small from behind; smoke, reeds, poplars and a village church tower. No gore. Painted as a late eighteenth-century European history painting, oil on canvas, grey autumn light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.9: 1814, Portoferraio on Elba: a small Mediterranean port with ochre houses climbing a hillside, old Medici forts on the cliffs and fishing boats in the bay; a British frigate lies at anchor while a figure in a grey greatcoat and bicorne, seen small from behind, steps ashore from a launch, greeted by a few officials and a handful of Old Guard grenadiers in bearskins. Calm blue sea, spring light. Painted as a nineteenth-century European oil painting, soft warm light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-napoleon.11: 1821, Longwood on Saint Helena: a lonely low house with a verandah on a windswept green plateau of the volcanic island, gnarled gumwood trees bent by the trade wind, the grey South Atlantic beyond steep cliffs; British redcoat sentries stand at a distance, a few French servants in black wait at the door, and a funeral cortège forms on the road under a heavy sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century British oil painting, muted greens and greys, sombre light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.0: 1809, Shrewsbury: The Mount, a large red-brick Georgian house on a terrace above the River Severn, with a garden of flower beds, a greenhouse and old trees, the spires of the medieval market town behind across the river. A doctor in a dark coat and top hat steps from a carriage at the door while a nurse in a cap holds a baby in the garden, children playing on the lawn. Painted as a nineteenth-century English watercolour, soft greens, gentle spring light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.1: 1826, Edinburgh: the rocky shore of the Firth of Forth at Newhaven at low tide, fishing boats and fishwives in striped skirts, a young student in a frock coat and top hat seen from behind with a fisherman examining sponges and sea creatures in a dredge net; the dark skyline of the Old Town, the castle on its rock and Arthur's Seat in the distance. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour, cool grey light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.2: 1829, near Cambridge: in the fens and woods outside the town, a young man in a tailcoat and top hat, seen from behind, peels bark from an old willow, collecting beetles into glass jars, while an older clergyman-botanist with a vasculum points at plants; behind, the pinnacles of King's College Chapel rise beyond meadows and the River Cam with punts. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour, soft summer light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.3: 27 December 1831, Plymouth Sound: a small three-masted survey brig, HMS Beagle, sets sail under grey winter clouds, sailors in blue jackets and tarred hats aloft in the rigging, a pilot boat and rowing boats around, the breakwater under construction, and the green headlands and town of Plymouth behind; a young gentleman in a cloak stands at the rail seen small from afar. Painted as a nineteenth-century English marine watercolour, cool silver light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.4: 1832, Punta Alta near Bahía Blanca, Argentina: low reddish cliffs of gravel and clay on a wide grey beach, a young naturalist in shirtsleeves and a broad hat, seen from behind, digs out huge fossil bones and a giant armadillo-like shell with a pickaxe, sailors helping with spades and a boat waiting; the survey brig anchored offshore, gauchos on horseback watching from the pampas above. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.5: 1833, Tierra del Fuego: a sheltered cove at Wulaia among dark beech forests and snowy peaks, a whaleboat of British sailors landing three Fuegians in European clothes among a group of Yaghan people in guanaco-skin capes with bark canoes and smoking fires on the shore; the small three-masted Beagle anchored in grey water beyond. Cold misty light, figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.6: 1835, the high Andes between Chile and Argentina: a small mule train with Chilean arrieros in ponchos and wide hats climbs a rocky pass among towering bare peaks and snowfields, while a young naturalist in a coat and hat, seen from behind, kneels to break open layered rocks full of fossil seashells beside a stand of petrified tree trunks. Thin blue air, vast scale. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.8: 1836, the Blue Mountains near Sydney: from a sandstone cliff edge, a lone traveller in a frock coat and hat, seen from behind, looks over a vast valley of blue eucalyptus forest and sheer cliffs, while in the foreground a platypus surfaces in a small creek and kangaroos graze in the open woodland, a convict-built road and a horse waiting behind. Painted as a nineteenth-century natural history watercolour, hazy blue light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.9: 1842, Down House in Kent: a plain three-storey Georgian country house, rendered white, with a bay of tall windows over a wide lawn and old trees, chalky fields and woods around the village of Downe; a young couple in early Victorian dress walk the garden with small children, while workmen alter the house and lay out the gravel Sandwalk path into a copse. Painted as a Victorian watercolour, soft greens and browns, precise detail. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-darwin.11: April 1882, Westminster Abbey: inside the soaring Gothic nave, a funeral procession of pall-bearers in black frock coats carries a coffin draped in black velvet toward the north aisle, crowds of mourners in black in the pews and galleries, choristers in white surplices, candles and pale light falling through tall stained-glass windows. Seen from a distance high above, no faces in close-up, no legible inscriptions. Painted as a Victorian watercolour interior, muted tones, precise detail. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.0: About 1823, Blantyre on the River Clyde: a large stone cotton mill beside a weir, its tall windows lit at dawn, a row of tenement houses for mill families nearby; boys and girls in rough clothes and bare feet file in at the gate, one small boy carrying a book under his arm. Mist on the river, wooded banks, early nineteenth-century Scotland. Figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.1: 1841, Kuruman in the northern Cape: a mission station of a stone church with a thatched roof, whitewashed cottages and irrigated gardens fed by a spring, set in a dry red-earth plain with thorn trees; a wagon drawn by a long team of oxen arrives, a young missionary doctor in a dark coat and peaked cap walking alongside, Tswana people and the missionary family coming to meet them. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, warm dry light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
