tour.life-af-livingstone.2: 1849, Lake Ngami: after crossing the Kalahari, ox-wagons halt at the edge of a vast shimmering lake fringed by reeds, flocks of flamingos and herds of antelope on the shore, Batawana people with canoes nearby; two European travellers in broad hats and a group of Tswana guides look out over the water, dry thornveld stretching behind. Figures small. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.3: 1854, Luanda: a gaunt traveller in a peaked cap riding an ox, with a small band of Makololo men in skins and cloth carrying loads, comes over a hill and sees the Atlantic, the Portuguese colonial city below with whitewashed churches, a fortress on the point, palm trees and sailing ships in the bay. Figures small and weary. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.5: 1856, Quelimane on the Mozambique coast: a small Portuguese river town of whitewashed houses and a church among coconut palms on a broad muddy estuary lined with mangroves, dhows and a British naval brig at anchor; a weather-worn explorer in a peaked cap and his Makololo companions arrive by canoe at the landing. Humid hazy light. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.6: 1859, Lake Nyasa (Malawi): a small paddle steamer and a boat of explorers on a vast blue lake beneath steep mountains, on the shore a fishing village of thatched round huts; in the middle distance a line of captives in wooden slave yokes is marched along the beach by armed traders, villagers watching. Restrained and distant, no violence shown. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.7: 1862, Shupanga on the lower Zambezi: a quiet riverside grave under a great baobab tree beside a Portuguese stone house, a small group of mourners in dark Victorian clothes and African helpers standing with bowed heads, a paddle steamer moored on the broad brown river behind, rain clouds hanging low over flat green floodplain. Figures small, no faces. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.8: 1866, Zanzibar: the white stone town with carved wooden doors and flat roofs on the waterfront, dhows with lateen sails in the harbour; on the beach an expedition gathers, porters lifting bales and boxes, sepoys and African carriers, camels, buffaloes and donkeys, a leader in a peaked cap seen from behind directing the loading of boats for the mainland. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.9: July 1871, Nyangwe on the Lualaba: a wide riverbank market of thatched stalls and canoes, where hundreds of women traders flee in panic toward the water as gunsmoke rises from armed men at the edge of the market, canoes crowding the broad brown river; a lone European figure watches helplessly from a distance under a tree. No bodies, no gore, violence distant and implied. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and sombre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.10: November 1871, Ujiji on Lake Tanganyika: a crowd of townspeople in white robes and Arab traders gathers in a village of thatched huts and palms by the vast lake, as a caravan arrives with an American flag and porters with loads; in the centre two small figures in pale clothing, one in a peaked cap, one in a helmet, face each other and lift their hats. Figures small, mountains across the water. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and luminous. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-af-livingstone.11: 1873, Chitambo's village near Lake Bangweulu: in swampy country of reeds and mvula trees, African companions bury a small box beneath a great tree marked with a carving, while others wrap a long bundle in bark and calico to carry; a band of porters prepares for the long march to the coast, grey rain clouds over the marsh. Figures small, no faces, no bodies shown. Painted as a nineteenth-century travel watercolour, misty and sombre. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.0: 1348, Tunis: a sombre view over the white Hafsid city with the minaret of the Zaytuna Mosque, flat roofs and domes, the lake and port beyond; in a narrow street, funeral processions of men in white burnouses and turbans carry shrouded biers toward the cemetery gate, while a boy watches from a doorway of a house with tiled courtyard. No bodies visible. Painted in the manner of a Maghrebi manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.1: 1354, Fez: the Marinid royal city of Fes el-Jdid, with green-tiled roofs and minarets, the old medina crowding the valley below; in a courtyard of the palace with zellij tilework and carved stucco, secretaries in turbans and white robes write at low desks before a sultan seated on cushions, guards at the doors and, beyond a gate, the dark walls of a prison. No legible text. Painted in the manner of a Maghrebi manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.2: 1362, Granada: the red walls and towers of the Alhambra on its hill above the city, the snowy Sierra Nevada behind; in a courtyard with a long pool and arcades of slender columns and carved stucco, a scholar in turban and robes arriving on horseback is welcomed by a Nasrid sultan and his vizier in fine robes, courtiers and musicians around. No later Palace of Charles V. Painted in the manner of a Maghrebi-Andalusian manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.3: 1364, Seville: inside the newly built Mudéjar palace of the Alcázar, a courtyard of carved stucco arches, tiles and a reflecting pool, a Castilian king in a fur-trimmed robe and crown with knights in surcoats receives a Muslim envoy in white robes and turban and his small retinue bearing gifts of silks and horses; orange trees and the Giralda tower beyond the walls. Painted in the manner of a Mudéjar and Maghrebi manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.4: 1365, Béjaïa: a port city climbing steep green slopes above a bay, white walls, a kasbah and the great sea gate, galleys and merchant ships at anchor; in the palace a minister in turban and robes gives audience to Berber tribal chiefs in burnouses, horses waiting in the courtyard, mountains of Kabylia behind. Painted in the manner of a Maghrebi manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.6: 1378, Tunis: in the library of the Zaytuna Mosque, rows of horseshoe arches and wooden bookcases full of bound manuscripts, a turbaned scholar seated on a carpet surrounded by open volumes, students copying at low desks, light falling through a courtyard door; no legible text. Painted in the manner of a Maghrebi manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.7: 1384, Mamluk Cairo: in a court of justice within a madrasa with striped stone arches and carved wooden ceilings, a Maghrebi judge in a white burnous, seen from across the hall, sits on a carpet hearing petitioners while clerks write; outside, stone Mamluk minarets and domes. Far beyond, a ship founders in a storm at sea on the horizon. No legible text, no Ottoman minarets. Painted in the manner of a Mamluk manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.8: 1387, Mecca: pilgrims in white ihram cloths circle the Kaaba under its black covering in the open courtyard of the Haram, its arcades and simple medieval minarets around, the dry rocky hills of the Hijaz behind; a caravan of camels from Egypt rests outside the town. No sacred figures depicted, no modern buildings or clock tower. Painted in the manner of a Mamluk manuscript painting, warm ochres and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.9: January 1401, Damascus: an elderly scholar in white robes and turban is lowered on a rope from the battlements of the besieged city walls at dawn, while beyond spreads the vast tent camp of Timur's army, horsemen with banners and siege engines, the dome of the Umayyad Mosque behind the walls. Figures small. No gore. Painted in the manner of a Mamluk and Timurid manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-ibn-khaldun.10: 1406, Cairo: a funeral procession of judges and scholars in white robes and large turbans carrying a bier out through the stone gate of Bab al-Nasr toward the Sufi cemetery outside the walls, mourners following, Mamluk domes and minarets of the city behind, dusty desert light. No bodies visible, no Ottoman minarets. Painted in the manner of a Mamluk manuscript painting, warm ochres and greens. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.0: About 1469, Sines on the Alentejo coast: a small fishing port below a squat medieval stone castle on a cliff, whitewashed houses and a chapel above a sandy bay, fishing boats drawn up on the beach and a caravel at anchor; fishermen haul nets while the governor's household in late fifteenth-century dress gathers at the castle gate. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese illuminated armada book, fine ink with watercolour, pale blue sea with wave patterns. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.2: November 1497, the Cape of Good Hope: four Portuguese ships, carracks and a caravel with red crosses on their sails, battle heavy grey-green swells and a strong wind around a rugged rocky headland with a flat-topped mountain behind, seabirds and whales in the sea, storm clouds breaking into light. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese illuminated armada book, ships drawn in fine ink with watercolour, wave patterns. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.3: March 1498, Mozambique Island: a low coral island with a small Swahili town of flat-roofed coral-stone houses and a mosque among palms, dhows with lateen sails in the harbour, local traders in white robes and turbans rowing out toward three Portuguese ships with red-cross sails; on shore, armed men gather tensely on the beach. Turquoise water and reef. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Portuguese chart illustration, fine detail, bright colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.6: September 1499, Lisbon: two weather-beaten ships with patched red-cross sails come up the Tagus to Belém, crowds of townspeople, friars and courtiers on the riverbank, sailors unloading sacks of pepper and spices, the royal palace on the waterfront and the castle above the city on its hill. Painted in the style of a Portuguese sixteenth-century illuminated navigation chart illustration, vivid and detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.7: 1502, Kilwa on the Swahili coast: a heavily armed Portuguese fleet of many carracks with red-cross sails and cannon ports lies close to the island town of coral-stone houses, a great domed mosque and a palace on the cliff; in the foreground an envoy in robes and turban rows out with gifts and chests while Portuguese soldiers in breastplates wait aboard. Turquoise sea. Painted in the style of a Portuguese sixteenth-century illuminated navigation chart illustration and Indian miniature colours, vivid and detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.8: 1502, off Calicut on the Malabar coast: Portuguese carracks with red-cross sails fire cannon toward the shore, smoke drifting over a palm-lined beach of wooden houses and temples with tiled sloping roofs, local boats fleeing; far out at sea a large burning ship on the horizon. Restrained and distant, no bodies. Monsoon sky. Painted in the style of a Portuguese sixteenth-century illuminated navigation chart illustration and Indian miniature colours, vivid and detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.9: September 1524, Goa: a large Portuguese fleet anchored in the broad Mandovi river before the walled city, churches and whitewashed houses among palms; on the quay soldiers in breastplates and morions form ranks, friars and officials in black gowns bow as an elderly viceroy in a dark velvet cloak, seen from behind, steps ashore under a canopy. Painted in the style of a Portuguese sixteenth-century illuminated navigation chart illustration and Indian miniature colours, vivid and detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-da-gama.10: Christmas Eve 1524, Cochin: a quiet evening in the small Portuguese town on the backwaters, a simple whitewashed church with candles glowing in its door, friars and soldiers in dark cloaks gathered in mourning outside, Chinese fishing nets and palms along the waterfront, carracks at anchor in the lagoon under a dusky sky. Painted in the style of a Portuguese sixteenth-century illuminated navigation chart illustration and Indian miniature colours, muted and detailed. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.0: About 1494, Granada: the city just after its fall to Castile, the red walls of the Alhambra on its hill under the snowy Sierra Nevada, Castilian banners now on its towers; below, in the Albaicín quarter of white houses and gardens, a Muslim family in Andalusian robes and veils gathers in a tiled courtyard with a fountain as a newborn is shown to relatives, Castilian soldiers passing in the street outside. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Ottoman-Maghrebi manuscript painting, fine line, warm ochres, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.1: About 1500, Fez: a refugee family from Andalusia in robes and veils, with mules loaded with chests, enters the crowded medina through a tiled horseshoe-arched gate, flat-roofed houses, minarets and the green roofs of the Qarawiyyin mosque beyond; in a madrasa courtyard nearby, boys sit on mats around a teacher. No legible text. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Ottoman-Maghrebi manuscript painting, fine line, warm ochres, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.2: About 1510, Timbuktu: a camel caravan from the north arrives at the sandy edge of the Saharan town, flat-roofed mud-brick houses and the great Djinguereber mosque with its pyramidal minaret and protruding wooden beams; merchants in white and indigo robes trade salt slabs, books and cloth, scholars in turbans at a mosque door, a young envoy with his uncle seen from behind. Painted in the style of a West African Islamic manuscript painting, warm earth tones and ochres, bright desert light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.3: 1517, Cairo: the Ottoman army in tall white börks and red kaftans, with janissaries and cannon, marches through the Bab Zuwayla gate into Mamluk Cairo, its stone minarets with balconies and carved domes rising above crowded streets, Mamluk horsemen in feathered turbans riding away into the distance, Cairenes watching from mashrabiya windows. No Muhammad Ali Mosque, no pencil minarets yet. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Ottoman-Maghrebi manuscript painting, fine line, warm ochres, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.4: 1520, Rome: inside Old St Peter's, the long early-Christian basilica with columns and timber roof, the new crossing piers of Bramante rising beyond under scaffolding; a man in white robes kneels at a font among priests in vestments and cardinals in red, the Medici pope seen small on a throne under a canopy, Roman nobles watching. No later dome. Painted in the style of an Italian Renaissance fresco, clear light, rich colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.5: 1524, Bologna: a scholar's study in a Renaissance palazzo with arched windows over red-brick towers and porticoed streets; a man in a dark scholar's gown and cap, seen from behind, works at a wooden desk among open books in different scripts, a Jewish physician-scholar in a gown and cap beside him pointing to a page, candles and inkwells; no legible text. Painted in the style of an Italian Renaissance oil painting, warm light, fine detail. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.6: 1526, Rome: a quiet room in a Renaissance palace with coffered ceiling and a window over domes, ruins and terracotta roofs of Rome, a scholar in a dark gown seated at a desk binding a thick finished manuscript, maps of Africa without legible text on the wall, a globe and astrolabe nearby, warm afternoon light. Painted in the style of an Italian Renaissance oil painting, fine detail, golden light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eg-leo-africanus.7: 1527, a harbour on the coast near Tunis: a lone traveller in a hooded burnous, seen from behind, steps from a small lateen-sailed ship onto a stone quay, porters and merchants in turbans around, the white city of flat roofs and minarets of the Zaytuna Mosque behind under a hazy sky; far out at sea, smoke hangs on the northern horizon. Uncertain, wistful mood. Painted in the style of a sixteenth-century Ottoman-Maghrebi manuscript painting, fine line, warm ochres, gold and lapis blue. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.0: 1807, Nice: the old harbour of Lympia below the castle hill, ochre and pink houses with green shutters, fishing boats and small brigantines moored at the quay, sailors in striped shirts and red caps hauling cargo; a seafaring family stands at the door of a harbourside house while a boy watches the ships, the Maritime Alps blue behind. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.1: 1834, Genoa: in a narrow street of tall houses running down to the harbour, a young sailor in a cloak, seen from behind, slips away at dusk while Piedmontese soldiers in shakos and grey-blue coats search doorways with lanterns; the Lanterna lighthouse and ships' masts in the background, a posted notice on a wall with no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.2: 1836, Rio de Janeiro: a sailing brig enters the vast Guanabara Bay under the Sugarloaf peak and green forested mountains, the colonial city of whitewashed houses and church towers along the shore; in a dockside tavern, Italian exiles in frock coats and sailors gather around a table plotting, seen through the door. No modern buildings or Christ statue. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.3: 1839, Laguna in southern Brazil: small armed schooners fight in a lagoon among sand dunes and green hills, cannon smoke drifting over the water; on the shore a dark-haired young woman in a long skirt, seen from a distance, stands on a hillside watching a sailor in a red shirt come ashore. Gauchos on horseback, a small colonial church. No gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.4: 1843, Montevideo: the besieged city on its peninsula with its cathedral towers, rooftops and the Cerro hill across the bay; on the walls a legion of volunteers in plain red woollen shirts and dark caps drill with muskets beside a black flag with a volcano, soldiers of the defence in other uniforms, ships in the harbour. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.5: June 1849, the Janiculum hill in Rome: defenders in red shirts and the varied uniforms of the Roman Republic hold the walls and the Villa Corsini gardens against French infantry in blue coats and red trousers, cannon smoke rising over pines; below, the domes and roofs of Rome and St Peter's. Distant, no gore. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.6: August 1849, Mandriole near Ravenna: a lonely farmhouse in flat marshland of reeds and pine woods near the Adriatic, a small band of exhausted fugitives in cloaks carrying a woman on a makeshift stretcher toward the door, a peasant family holding a lantern at dusk, distant Austrian white-coated cavalry on the horizon. Sombre, no faces in close-up. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.7: 1850, Staten Island, New York: a modest wooden farmhouse with a porch near the shore, a small candle workshop behind with vats and racks of tallow candles, two men in shirtsleeves at work; across the Narrows, sailing ships and early steamers on the harbour, wooded hills. Painted as a nineteenth-century American Hudson River School oil painting, soft golden light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.8: May 1860, Marsala in western Sicily: two paddle steamers anchored off a low coast of salt pans and white windmills, boats full of volunteers in red shirts and grey trousers with muskets landing on the quay, the walled town and its baroque church dome behind, British warships at anchor nearby; townspeople watching. Bright Mediterranean light. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.9: September 1860, Naples: a huge jubilant crowd of Neapolitans waving tricolour flags fills the streets of the city, a small open carriage with a bearded man in a red shirt and poncho passing slowly toward the royal palace; Vesuvius smoking gently across the bay, balconies hung with banners. Figures small, no faces in close-up. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.10: August 1862, Aspromonte in Calabria: in a high chestnut and pine forest on the mountain, a column of red-shirted volunteers halts as Italian royal infantry in dark blue coats and kepis advance between the trees, a little musket smoke; a wounded leader sits under a large pine tree tended by companions. Distant, no blood. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-eu-garibaldi.11: 1882, Caprera off Sardinia: a white single-storey farmhouse on a granite island of rocks, Mediterranean scrub and windswept pines, a few cultivated fields, stone walls, goats and an old horse; family and old comrades in red shirts stand quietly outside, the turquoise sea and the Maddalena islands beyond under a grey June sky. Painted as a nineteenth-century Italian Risorgimento oil painting in the manner of the Macchiaioli, clear light, small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-buddha.1: About 534 BCE, Kapilavastu: at night, the gateway of a palace of timber and thatch with arched roofs and wooden railings, guards asleep against the posts; a saddled white horse with a groom walks out through the open gate toward the moonlit forest, its rider shown only as an empty saddle under a parasol held aloft, in the aniconic manner of early Buddhist art. Women in draped garments sleep inside the hall, the Himalayan foothills faint behind. Painted in the style of early aniconic Buddhist relief (Sanchi and Bharhut), soft stone tones with gentle colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-buddha.4: About 527 BCE, Rajagriha: a ring of rocky green hills around the Magadhan capital with its rough stone walls; outside the town, in a grove of tall bamboo, a king in a turban and jewelled ornaments, with attendants holding parasols and fly-whisks, pours water from a golden pitcher before an empty seat beneath a tree, monks with shaven heads in robes watching. No figure of the Buddha shown. Rendered as a Sanchi-style sandstone relief carving, warm buff stone, dense foliage and animals. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-buddha.5: About 520 BCE, Shravasti: in a park outside the city, carts are unloading gold coins that servants lay edge to edge to cover the ground, as a wealthy merchant in a turban and draped dhoti watches with a prince; beyond, a monastery of wooden huts and halls rises among mango trees, monks in robes walking its paths, and an empty seat under a tree marks the teacher's presence. No figure of the Buddha shown. Painted in the style of early aniconic Buddhist relief carving from Sanchi and Bharhut, soft sandstone tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-buddha.6: About 484 BCE, near Vaishali: during the monsoon, a rough thatched shelter at the edge of a village, rain falling on palms and paddy fields, a group of monks in saffron robes kneeling in sorrow around an empty seat with a cloth laid upon it, one elderly attendant monk bowing his head; the brick walls and gateways of Vaishali in the misty distance. No figure of the Buddha shown. Painted in the style of early aniconic Buddhist relief carving from Sanchi and Bharhut, soft sandstone tones, grey monsoon light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.0: About 304 BCE, Pataliputra: the great Mauryan capital on the Ganges, enclosed by a massive wooden palisade with towers and a moat, inside it halls with polished columns and arched thatched roofs; in a palace courtyard women in draped garments and heavy jewellery carry a newborn on a cushion before courtiers and an elderly king, elephants with caparisons at the gate, boats on the river. Painted in the style of early Indian relief sculpture, warm stone tones with gentle colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.1: About 285 BCE, Ujjain: a busy walled city of brick and timber on the Shipra river, a young viceroy in a turban and draped garments, seen small on a caparisoned elephant, receives officials at the city gate; beyond, on a hill at nearby Vidisha, a merchant's house where a woman in fine cloth stands with attendants among mango trees. Painted in the style of early Indian relief sculpture, warm stone tones, sunlit. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.2: 268 BCE, Pataliputra: a coronation in a vast pillared hall of polished stone columns with a timber roof, courtiers in turbans and draped dhotis, ministers and generals lining the hall, priests pouring sacred water over a ruler seated on a throne under a white parasol, seen from far down the hall; guards with spears and war elephants outside. Painted in the style of early Indian relief sculpture, muted stone tones, solemn and grand. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.4: About 259 BCE, Bodh Gaya: a royal procession of elephants, chariots and attendants with parasols halts in a grove where a great pipal tree stands within a wooden railing, an empty stone seat beneath it; an emperor in a turban and jewels kneels in reverence with offerings of flowers, monks in robes nearby, villagers watching from the edge of the Niranjana river. No figure of the Buddha shown. Painted in the style of early Indian relief carving, warm stone colours, sunlit. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.8: About 249 BCE, Lumbini: in a grove of sal trees beside a pond in the Terai, workmen haul a tall polished sandstone pillar upright with ropes and wooden frames, its surface carrying faint indistinct lines, while a royal party with parasols and monks in saffron robes watches; the Himalayan foothills rise behind in morning mist. No legible writing. Painted in the style of ancient Sri Lankan murals (Sigiriya), warm ochres and greens, flowing outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-ashoka.9: 232 BCE, Pataliputra: an evening view of the great palace by the Ganges, lamps lit along its galleries, a long procession of monks in saffron robes, ministers in white and townspeople carrying flowers and lamps moving slowly toward a funeral pyre platform on the riverbank, boats with lamps drifting on the water. Sombre and quiet, no bodies shown. Painted in the style of ancient Sri Lankan murals (Sigiriya), warm ochres and greens, flowing outlines. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ca-timur.0: 1336, near Kesh (Shahrisabz) in Transoxiana: a camp of round felt yurts of the Barlas clan in a green valley below snow-capped mountains, horses grazing, women in tall headdresses and long robes gathering around one yurt, nomad horsemen with bows returning from the hunt, the mud-brick walls of a small town and orchards in the distance. Painted in the style of a Timurid Persian miniature, gold and lapis blue, crowded figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ca-timur.3: 1387, Isfahan: seen from a distance, the walled Persian city with its turquoise domes smoking under a darkened sky, Timurid horsemen with yak-tail standards camped on the plain outside, and in the middle distance tall stone towers built by the troops, shown only as grim pale cairns without any visible remains. No gore. Painted in the manner of a Timurid miniature from the Zafarnama, rich colours and gold sky. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ca-timur.7: 1401, Damascus: the city in flames seen from a hill, the dome of the Umayyad Mosque wreathed in smoke, Timurid soldiers carrying away loot on camels and carts; in the foreground, in a richly patterned tent, an elderly Maghrebi scholar in white turban kneels before a ruler seated on carpets among commanders, scribes and attendants. No gore. Painted as a Timurid Persian miniature in the style of Bihzad's workshop, crowded small figures, rich blues and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.0: 1869, Porbandar on the Gujarat coast: a narrow street of tall whitewashed and carved wooden houses near the sea, a three-storey ancestral house with balconies, women in bright saris and men in dhotis and turbans gathered at its door to celebrate a birth; beyond, the harbour with wooden dhows and the Arabian Sea. Seen from a distance, no faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.1: 1888, London: a foggy Victorian street outside the gate of the Inner Temple, red-brick Georgian chambers and the Temple Church, hansom cabs and gas lamps; a slight young Indian law student in a top hat and frock coat, seen from behind, walks among barristers in black gowns and wigs. No faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones, soft fog. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.2: June 1893, Pietermaritzburg railway station in Natal: a cold winter night on a lamplit platform with a corrugated iron roof, a steam train standing, a slim young Indian lawyer in a frock coat and turban, seen from behind, sitting alone on a bench with his luggage beside him as the train pulls out. No faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones, cold blue night light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.3: September 1906, Johannesburg: inside the old Empire Theatre, a packed mass meeting of some three thousand Indian men in turbans, caps and frock coats raising their hands to take a vow, speakers on a distant stage; outside, the mining town's corrugated-iron roofs and mine headgear. Seen from above at a distance, no faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.4: About 1917, Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad: simple whitewashed low buildings with tiled roofs under neem trees on the high bank of the wide Sabarmati river, men and women in white khadi spinning on charkhas on a verandah, others drawing water and tending a garden; washermen on the sandbanks below. Seen from a distance, no faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.5: 1917, Champaran in Bihar: in a flat green countryside of indigo fields and mango groves, crowds of barefoot peasants in dhotis queue under a tree to give their accounts to volunteers writing at small tables, a British planter's bungalow with indigo vats in the distance. No legible text. Seen from a distance, no faces in close-up. Painted as a 1920s Indian watercolour illustration, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.8: Autumn 1931, London: a crowd of East End people in cloth caps and coats on a grey street of brick terraces outside Kingsley Hall, welcoming a slight figure in a white dhoti and shawl, seen from behind; red double-decker buses, chimneys and a damp sky. All figures small and anonymous. Painted in the style of a 1940s Indian woodcut print, black and white with spot colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-gandhi.10: Winter 1946, Noakhali, East Bengal: a small procession of a few people in plain white khadi walks single file along a narrow raised earthen path between flooded paddy fields and betel-nut palms, led far ahead by a thin elderly man with a walking stick, seen small from behind. A bamboo footbridge over a canal, thatched village huts among banana trees, a few villagers watching warily from doorways, faint smoke from a burnt hut far off. Soft hazy morning light. No violence or casualties shown, no legible text. Painted as a gentle Bengal School watercolour, soft grey-green washes, quiet hopeful mood, no figure shown up close. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.0: 1469, Talwandi near Lahore, Punjab: a small village of flat-roofed mud-brick houses around a well at dawn, a modest courtyard house where women in long veils and men in turbans and simple kurtas gather quietly outside, a village accountant's low desk with cloth-bound ledgers under the verandah, buffaloes and a bullock cart nearby, wheat fields and a few kikar trees stretching to the horizon, a single lamp glowing in a doorway. Figures small, no faces as subject, no legible text, no Sikh gurdwara buildings yet. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.2: c. 1502, Varanasi on the Ganges: on the broad stone ghats stepping down to the river, a turbaned teacher in a simple robe and his companion Mardana holding a rebab sit small among a ring of holy men, ash-smeared ascetics, Brahmins with sacred threads and saffron-clad sadhus, debating under a large parasol. Low temple shrines with modest spires, boats on the wide river, bathers in the water, morning sun on the far sandy bank. Figures seen from a distance, no faces as subject, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.3: c. 1518, Mecca: in the open sanctuary around the black-draped Kaaba, a traveller in a simple robe and turban lies resting with his feet toward the shrine, seen small and from behind, while a few pilgrims in white garments and a robed attendant gesture toward him; arcades of the mosque, low flat-roofed houses and bare rocky hills around the valley under a hot pale sky. Figures small, no faces as subject, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.4: c. 1519, Baghdad: on the edge of the old city by the Tigris, a turbaned traveller and his companion with a rebab sit small in a garden outside a domed tomb, surrounded by Sufi dervishes in patched cloaks and tall felt caps and a few curious townsmen; palm groves, mud-brick walls, a ruined minaret and river boats in the soft evening light. Figures seen from a distance, no faces as subject, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.5: 1520, Saidpur in the Punjab: seen from a low hill, Mughal horsemen in quilted coats and turbans with bows ride through the gates of a walled town of mud-brick houses, smoke rising from a few roofs, townspeople led away in a distant line; on the hillside in the foreground a turbaned teacher in a simple robe and a companion with a rebab, seen small from behind, watch in sorrow. No gore, no bodies, violence kept distant and restrained, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sa-nanak.6: c. 1539, Kartarpur on the Ravi river: a simple farming settlement of mud-brick houses and a modest open hall, men and women working together in green fields, a communal kitchen where people of all castes sit in rows on the ground sharing food, an elderly teacher with a white beard, seen small from behind, ploughing beside a disciple; the river and wide plain beyond in warm afternoon light. Figures small, no faces as subject, no domed gurdwara, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Punjabi janamsakhi manuscript painting, flat bright colours, simple forms. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.0: 774, Sanuki province on Shikoku: a manor of the provincial Saeki clan with thatched and bark-roofed halls on raised wooden floors, an earthen wall and gate, rice paddies and low rounded hills around; women in long Nara-period robes and men in court-style tunics and caps gather on a veranda in early summer light, a small figure carrying a swaddled infant seen from behind. Distant inland sea glinting. No tiled castles, no later samurai armour. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.1: 791, Nagaoka-kyō: the courtyard of the state academy, plain timber halls with tiled roofs and vermilion pillars in Tang-influenced style, young students in pale court robes and black caps kneeling in rows on mats reading scrolls before a lecturer; one young student, seen small from behind, walks out through the gate toward distant wooded mountains. Autumn maples. No legible text, no later Japanese castle architecture. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.2: c. 795, Cape Muroto on Shikoku: a young ascetic in a ragged dark robe sits in meditation at the mouth of a sea cave on the rocky headland, seen small from behind, facing the vast Pacific; huge waves breaking on black rocks, wind-bent pines on the cliffs, the morning star bright in a dawn sky over the horizon. Wild, lonely and luminous. No buildings, no other figures nearby. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.3: 804, the coast of Fujian near Chi'an: a battered Japanese envoy ship, a large wooden vessel with rush-mat sails and a broken mast, lies beached in a rocky cove after a storm; envoys in court robes and monks in dark robes wade ashore and are met cautiously by Tang local officials and fishermen with conical hats. Green coastal hills, fishing huts, grey storm clouds clearing. Figures small, no faces as subject. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.5: 806, Dazaifu in Kyushu: the government headquarters with tiled roofs and vermilion pillars set among green hills, a monk in dark robes, seen small from behind, waits in the courtyard of a nearby temple beside lacquered chests of scrolls, ritual bronze vajras and bells and rolled mandala paintings being unpacked by attendants; officials in court dress watch from a hall. Plum blossoms, soft spring light. No legible text. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.6: 809, Takaosan-ji in the mountains northwest of Heian-kyō: a mountain temple of bark-roofed halls among tall cedars, a monk in dark robes, seen small from behind, performs an esoteric ritual before a fire altar with attendants; a court messenger in formal robes and black lacquered cap arrives up the stone path with a gift from the emperor. Autumn maples blazing red, mist in the valley. No legible text. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.7: 816, Mount Kōya: a high forested plateau ringed by eight peaks, a monk in dark robes with a staff and a few disciples, seen small, stand in a clearing among giant cedars where carpenters begin raising the first timber frame of a hall; by legend a hunter with a black and a white dog leads the way. Morning mist drifting between the peaks. No finished pagodas yet, no modern buildings. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.8: 821, Mannō-ike in Sanuki: a wide valley where hundreds of villagers in simple hemp clothing carry earth in baskets on poles and pound it into a great curved embankment of a reservoir, while a monk in dark robes on a rise, seen small from behind, directs the work with an arched spillway design; rice fields below, low green hills, summer sky with clouds. No machinery. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.9: 823, Tō-ji in Heian-kyō: the great official temple beside the Rashōmon gate in the planned grid capital, broad gravel courtyard, tiled lecture hall with vermilion pillars, monks in dark and saffron robes in procession carrying ritual implements, an imperial envoy in court dress arriving by ox-cart, carpenters on scaffolding finishing a new hall. Cherry blossoms, spring light. No five-storey pagoda yet, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-kukai.10: 835, Mount Kōya: a quiet monastery deep in the cedar forest at dusk, a small wooden hall with a closed door where a few monks in dark robes kneel outside in prayer, seen from behind; lanterns glowing, mist between the giant trees, a lone stone path leading in. Calm, reverent and still; no figure shown inside, no modern stone lantern rows or tombstones. Painted in the style of a Japanese Kamakura-period emakimono biography scroll, fine line, mineral colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.0: 1537, Nakamura village in Owari province: a cluster of thatched farmhouses among flat rice paddies and irrigation ditches on the Owari plain, peasants in short indigo hemp kimono and straw hats transplanting rice, a mother carrying a small child on her back walking along a dike, seen small from behind; a distant wooden fort on a low hill, Mount Ontake hazy on the horizon. Early summer, many tiny figures. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.1: c. 1558, Kiyosu Castle in Owari: a fortified residence of wooden halls behind earthen ramparts and moats, a lord in armour and lacquered hat stepping out of a gateway onto a gravel courtyard on a frosty morning, while a small low-ranking servant in a plain kimono kneels and offers his straw sandals, seen from a distance; retainers with spears and horses waiting. No tall white stone-based keep. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.2: 1573, Nagahama on Lake Biwa: a new castle rising on the lakeshore, labourers hauling stones on sledges and carpenters raising the timber frame of a keep, a small castle town of merchant houses being laid out, boats unloading timber at a wharf; samurai overseers with banners on the ramparts, the wide blue lake and Chikubu island beyond, mountains under gold-leaf clouds. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.3: 1582, Takamatsu in Bitchū: a small castle stands isolated in a vast brown lake created by a long earthen dike built across the plain, its walls half submerged, while a besieging army camps on the surrounding hills with banners and tents; a single messenger on horseback gallops into the commander's curtained camp at dusk. Rain clouds, many tiny figures, no gore. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.4: 1582, Yamazaki between the Tennōzan hill and the Yodo river: two armies clash on a narrow plain, ranks of ashigaru with long pikes and matchlock arquebuses firing puffs of smoke, mounted samurai with sashimono banners charging up the wooded slope of Tennōzan, the river and marshes beside; summer heat haze. Bird's-eye view, distant figures, no gore. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.5: 1583, Osaka: a huge construction site on a plateau above the river delta, tens of thousands of labourers hauling enormous granite blocks on wooden sledges with ropes to build towering stone walls, a black-lacquered keep with gilded roof ornaments beginning to rise, wide moats being dug; boats bringing stones along the river, a city spreading below. No modern reinforced concrete keep, many tiny figures. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.6: 1587, Hakata in Kyushu: the harbour town of wooden merchant houses and warehouses, a Portuguese carrack with tall masts anchored in the bay, a few Jesuit priests in black cassocks walking down to small boats at the shore, watched by samurai with banners and townspeople; the warlord's encampment on a hill above with curtains and standards. Summer, gold-leaf clouds. No legible text. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, bright colours, many tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-hideyoshi.9: 1598, Fushimi Castle on Momoyama hill south of Kyoto: the castle's gilded keep and white-walled halls among autumn maples at dusk, the castle town below quiet, retainers in dark formal kamishimo hurrying across courtyards with lanterns; in the far distance a line of returning ships on the sea under gold clouds. Mournful, still mood, no figure shown up close. Painted in the style of a Momoyama-period folding screen, gold-leaf clouds, vivid colours, tiny figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.0: 1644, Ueno in Iga province: a small castle town in a mountain basin, modest samurai houses with board fences and thatched roofs along a stream, a farmhouse where a family in simple kimono gathers in an earthen-floored room, a woman carrying a newborn on the veranda seen from behind; rice paddies and wooded hills in late autumn, persimmons on bare branches. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.1: c. 1680, Fukagawa in Edo: a small thatched hut beside the Sumida river with a young banana plant in its garden, a man in a plain monk's robe sitting on the veranda seen from behind, a few visiting poets with brushes and paper; across the river the roofs of Edo, timber barges and a wooden bridge, evening light. No legible text. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.2: 1684, the Ise shrines: a traveller in a straw hat and dark robe with a walking stick, seen small from behind, stands outside the plain unpainted cypress-wood shrine buildings with thatched roofs behind wooden fences, under towering cedars; pilgrims in white crossing the Uji bridge over a clear river, autumn wind and fallen leaves. No vermilion torii, no legible text. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.4: 1689, Matsushima Bay: hundreds of small pine-covered islands scattered across calm silver water, a small boat with a boatman ferrying two travellers in straw hats, seen small from behind; a temple roof among pines on the shore, fishing boats in the distance, early summer haze. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.5: 1689, Hiraizumi: a grassy rise overlooking a wide river plain where tall summer grasses wave over the faint mounds of vanished palaces, a traveller in a straw hat and his companion sit on the slope, seen small from behind, gazing toward the Kitakami river and distant mountains; a small old temple hall among cedars nearby. Hot still summer light. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.6: 1689, Yamadera (Risshaku-ji): steep stone steps climbing a forested crag of grey rock, small temple halls perched on the cliffs, a traveller in a straw hat and dark robe pausing on the stairs, seen small from behind; deep summer stillness, cedar trees, a hazy valley below. Mood of silent heat and cicada song. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.7: 1689, Ōgaki in Mino: a small castle town by a river at autumn, a group of friends and disciples in kimono greeting a weary traveller in a straw hat at a riverside landing, a flat-bottomed boat ready to set off downstream, willows and rice fields with harvested sheaves. Figures small, gentle farewell mood. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.8: 1690, Genjūan near Lake Biwa: a tiny thatched hermitage on a wooded hillside above the lake, a figure in a monk's robe sitting by the open shutters seen from behind, a water jar and a small brazier; below, the wide silver lake with sailboats and distant Mount Hiei, summer cicadas and pines. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-jp-basho.9: 1694, Osaka: a quiet back room of a merchant house in late autumn, shoji screens half open onto a small garden with withered grasses, a group of disciples in kimono kneeling quietly around a low bed, seen from behind and at a distance; beyond the roofs, a vast withered field under a pale sky with a single crow. No faces as subject. Painted in the style of a haiga, as in Yosa Buson's illustrations of Bashō's journey, light ink and colour, spare brushwork, much empty space. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kr-yi-sunsin.0: 1545, Hanseong, the Joseon capital: a modest yangban household inside the city walls, a tiled-roof hanok with an earthen wall and courtyard, women in long skirts and short jackets and a servant carrying water, men in white robes and black horsehair gat hats at the gate; beyond the roofs the Bugaksan mountain and the palace's tiled halls. Spring willows. Figures small, seen from a distance, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Joseon-era documentary painting, fine ink line, soft blue and green colours, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kr-yi-sunsin.1: 1587, Nokdun Island on the Tumen River: a small wooden stockade on a flat river island amid autumn millet fields, Jurchen horsemen in fur hats with bows riding out of the northern hills, Joseon soldiers in quilted coats and broad-brimmed helmets defending the palisade with bows and spears, farmers fleeing toward the gate; the wide river and Manchurian hills beyond. Distant view, restrained, no gore. Painted in the style of a Joseon-era documentary painting, fine ink line, soft blue and green colours, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kr-yi-sunsin.2: 1591, Yeosu harbour: a naval base on a sheltered bay, shipwrights building a turtle ship on a slipway, its covered roof being fitted with iron spikes and a dragon-head prow, panokseon warships with two-level decks drilling in formation on the water, sailors rowing, banners on a hillside command post; green islands and mountains. Bird's-eye view, many small figures. Painted in the style of a Joseon-era documentary painting, fine ink line, soft blue and green colours, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kr-yi-sunsin.3: May 1592, Okpo bay off Geoje Island: a line of Korean panokseon warships with banners firing cannon toward Japanese transport ships moored in a cove, smoke and flames rising from several Japanese vessels, Japanese troops on the shore scattering into the hills; green islands, calm water, morning light. No turtle ship in this battle, no gore. Painted in the style of a Joseon-era documentary painting of a naval battle, fine ink line, soft blue and green colours, many small boats, bird's-eye view. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-kr-yi-sunsin.5: 1597, Hanseong: a cart carrying a prisoner in a wooden cage, seen small from behind, escorted by soldiers with spears through a city gate in the rain, townspeople in white standing along the road in silent sympathy; the tiled roofs of government offices and the city walls behind, grey sky. Restrained, no torture or violence shown. Painted in the style of a Joseon-era documentary painting, fine ink line, soft blue and green colours, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.0: 1485, Medellín in Extremadura: a small Castilian town of whitewashed houses with red tile roofs below a hilltop castle, an old Roman bridge across the Guadiana river, a modest stone manor house where townspeople in late fifteenth-century tunics and hose and women in long gowns and headdresses gather, sheep and dry oak pastures around. Figures small, warm spring light, no legible text. Painted as an early sixteenth-century Spanish illuminated manuscript scene, fine ink line, soft colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.1: c. 1515, Santiago de Cuba: a newly founded Spanish settlement of timber and palm-thatched houses and a small church around a plaza on a deep green bay, a few caravels anchored in the harbour, Spanish colonists in doublets and morion helmets, horses and pigs, Taíno labourers carrying loads; forested mountains rising behind. Figures small, no violence. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.3: 1519, Tlaxcala in the highlands of Mexico: a solemn meeting on a plain before the stone walls of a hilltop city, Tlaxcalan lords in white cotton cloaks with feather insignia offering gifts of food and cloth to a group of Spanish soldiers in steel breastplates with horses and a few cannon, an interpreter woman between them; maguey fields and the volcano La Malinche behind. No gore. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.5: 1521, Texcoco on the eastern shore of the lake: a long canal dug by thousands of Tlaxcalan and Texcocan labourers leads to the lake, where small Spanish brigantines, low open boats about a dozen metres long with a single mast and rows of oars, are being launched; armoured Spaniards, native allies with feathered shields, the distant island city of Tenochtitlan on the water, volcanoes beyond. No tall ocean ships, no bodies. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.7: 1525, the jungles on the march to Honduras: a long column of Spanish soldiers in rusted breastplates with horses and native porters struggling through swamps and dense rainforest, crossing a river on a makeshift log bridge, a few captive Aztec lords in cotton cloaks walking under guard; a giant ceiba tree, mist and rain. Grim mood, no execution or violence shown. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.8: 1528, Toledo: the hilltop city above the Tagus gorge, a procession arriving at the royal Alcázar with Spanish attendants and Aztec nobles in feather cloaks, carriers bearing jaguars in cages, parrots, gold and featherwork as gifts; courtiers in black velvet doublets without large ruffs watching from a gallery. Figures small, no legible text. Painted as an early sixteenth-century Spanish illuminated manuscript scene, fine ink line, soft colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.9: 1535, the Bay of La Paz, Baja California: a few Spanish ships anchored in a turquoise bay ringed by dry desert hills and cardón cacti, soldiers and colonists dragging boats onto a white beach, a few thatched huts begun; local Pericú people watching from the rocks. Harsh sun, sparse, isolated mood. Painted in the style of the Lienzo de Tlaxcala, a colonial-era native pictorial manuscript, ink line with soft colour on cloth. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.10: October 1541, the bay of Algiers: a great Spanish imperial fleet of galleys and carracks struck by a violent autumn storm, ships driven onto the shore, soldiers in armour struggling through rain and mud below the white walls of the city on its hillside, the Ottoman fortress and minarets beyond. Distant view, dark sky, no bodies. Painted as a sixteenth-century Spanish tapestry design, as in the Conquest of Tunis tapestries, fine detail, muted colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-mx-cortes.11: 1547, Castilleja de la Cuesta near Seville: a quiet Andalusian village house with whitewashed walls and a tiled courtyard with orange trees, a few servants and a priest in black walking in through the gate at dusk, seen from behind; olive groves and the distant towers of Seville on the plain below. Calm, mournful mood, no figure shown up close. Painted as an early sixteenth-century Spanish illuminated manuscript scene, fine ink line, soft colours. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.0: 1783, Caracas: a large colonial townhouse with whitewashed walls, red tile roof and an inner patio with arcades and a fountain, a household of Creole family members in late eighteenth-century dress and enslaved servants gathered around a nurse holding an infant, seen from a distance; beyond the roofs, church towers and the green Ávila mountain under a tropical sky. Soft morning light. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.1: c. 1800, Madrid: a quiet street of tall stone and brick houses with iron balconies near a royal palace, a young Creole gentleman in a dark tailcoat and high collar walking with a tutor, seen small from behind, past carriages and Madrileños in capes and bicorne hats; the dome of a church and a pale Castilian sky. No legible text. Painted as an early nineteenth-century European oil genre painting, soft light, muted palette, figures small. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.2: 1805, Monte Sacro on the outskirts of Rome: a grassy hill dotted with ancient ruins and umbrella pines at sunset, a young man in a dark tailcoat and his older tutor, seen small from behind, standing on the summit with the domes of Rome and the Roman Campagna spread out below in golden haze. Solemn, romantic mood. Painted as an early nineteenth-century European oil genre painting, soft light, muted palette, figures small. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.3: 1812, Cartagena de Indias: the walled Caribbean port with massive stone ramparts, bastions and bell towers, sailing ships in the bay, a few exiled officers in worn uniforms stepping off a small boat onto the quay, seen from behind, greeted by local patriots in white shirts; palm trees, hot bright light. A printing press glimpsed through an arched doorway, no legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.4: 1815, Kingston, Jamaica: a modest Georgian house with a wooden veranda and louvred shutters on a hillside above the harbour, a man in a dark coat writing at a table on the veranda, seen small from behind, papers scattered; British merchant ships and a frigate in the blue bay below, palm trees and the Blue Mountains behind. No legible text. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.7: 1821, the savanna of Carabobo in Venezuela: a wide grassy plain between low wooded hills, columns of patriot infantry in blue coats and white trousers advancing through a gap in the hills, llanero lancers on horseback sweeping across the plain, Spanish royalist lines in white and blue retreating amid drifting gunsmoke; tropical sky with towering clouds. Figures small and distant, no wounded shown. Painted as an early nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, warm earth tones, wide panoramic composition, soft afternoon light. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-bolivar.9: August 1824, the plain of Junín in the high Andes of Peru: a vast treeless grassland at over four thousand metres beside a lake, ringed by snowy peaks, patriot cavalry with long lances and royalist horsemen clash in a swirling dust cloud with lances and sabres only, no gunsmoke, a general on a white horse watching from a rise, seen small from behind. Thin cold air, low golden sun, no wounded shown. Painted as an early nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, warm earth tones, wide panoramic composition. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.0: 1778, Yapeyú on the Uruguay River: a former Jesuit mission town with a large stone church, long low houses with tiled roofs and arcades around a grassy plaza, Guaraní people in white cotton clothing working and walking, a Spanish governor's residence where a few officials in tricorn hats stand at the door; the broad river and subtropical forest beyond. Hot humid light. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.1: July 1808, Bailén in Andalusia: dry hills with olive groves under a fierce summer sun, Spanish infantry in white and blue uniforms and cavalry in a line along a ridge, a long column of French troops with tall shakos laying down their standards in the distance, a small whitewashed town behind. Dust and heat haze, figures small, no wounded shown. Painted as an early nineteenth-century Spanish oil battle painting, warm earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.2: 1812, Buenos Aires: on a parade ground near the Río de la Plata, a newly raised regiment of mounted grenadiers in dark blue uniforms and tall shakos with sabres drilling in rows on horseback, a commanding officer watching from horseback, seen small from behind; the low whitewashed colonial town, the cabildo tower and a muddy river shore with tall-wheeled carts. Bright morning. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.3: February 1813, San Lorenzo on the Paraná: grenadiers in dark blue on horseback charge out from behind the walls of a whitewashed Franciscan monastery down the high riverbank, meeting a column of royalist marines landed from small sailing ships on the wide brown river; dawn mist and gunsmoke, figures small and distant, no wounded shown. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.4: c. 1816, Mendoza at the foot of the Andes: a camp of adobe barracks and a parade ground at El Plumerillo, soldiers in blue uniforms drilling with muskets, workshops where men cast cannon and sew uniforms, mule trains loaded with supplies, poplar trees and irrigated vineyards; the snowy wall of the Andes looms behind under a clear sky. Many small figures. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.6: April 1818, the plain of Maipú near Santiago de Chile: patriot infantry in blue advancing across fields toward royalist troops on a low rise, cavalry charging on the flanks, cannon smoke drifting, adobe farm buildings and poplars, the snow-capped Andes dominating the horizon in autumn light. Figures small and distant, no wounded shown. Painted as a nineteenth-century South American oil history painting, soft light, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.9: 1824, Brussels: a quiet cobbled street of tall gabled brick houses in the old town, a man in a dark civilian frock coat and top hat walking hand in hand with a young girl, seen small from behind, toward a modest house; Gothic church towers, grey northern sky and light drizzle. Calm, exile mood. Painted as an early nineteenth-century European oil genre painting, soft light, muted palette, figures small. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-san-martin.10: 1850, Boulogne-sur-Mer: a modest town house on a sloping street of the old walled town above the harbour, a window lit at dusk, the English Channel grey beyond, fishing boats in the port and the dome of a church under construction; a few townspeople in mid-nineteenth-century dress passing below. Quiet, elegiac mood, no figure shown up close. Painted as an early nineteenth-century European oil genre painting, soft light, muted palette, figures small. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.0: 1732, Popes Creek, Westmoreland County, Virginia: a modest brick and timber plantation house with a steep shingled roof and tall chimneys on a gentle rise above a tidal creek flowing into the Potomac, tobacco fields, a few outbuildings, enslaved workers in the fields, a woman in a long gown and cap carrying an infant on the porch seen from a distance; tall tulip poplars, soft February light. Painted as an eighteenth-century engraving with hand colouring, fine hatched lines, figures small and distant. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.1: December 1753, the frozen wilderness of northwestern Pennsylvania: a small party of travellers in fur caps, blanket coats and leggings, with a Seneca guide and pack horses, trudges through deep snow along a forest trail toward a small French log fort with a palisade and a white flag beside a frozen creek; bare trees and grey winter sky. Figures small, seen from behind. Painted as an eighteenth-century engraving with hand colouring, fine hatched lines, figures small and distant. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.3: July 1755, the Monongahela River near Fort Duquesne: in a dense forest clearing, British redcoat columns in disorder amid gunsmoke under the trees, a tall young officer on horseback, seen small from behind, rallying Virginia militia in blue to cover the retreat across a shallow ford; French and Native fighters hidden among the trees. Distant, restrained, no bodies or wounded shown. Painted as an eighteenth-century engraving with hand colouring, fine hatched lines, figures small and distant. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.4: c. 1759, Mount Vernon on the Potomac: a modest two-storey wooden Virginia farmhouse with a shingled roof on a high bluff, newly being enlarged by carpenters, a couple in mid-eighteenth-century dress arriving by carriage with two small children, enslaved workers in the fields and at outbuildings; the broad Potomac river and Maryland shore beyond, spring trees. No later long columned piazza yet, figures small. Painted in the style of a late eighteenth-century oil history painting, as by John Trumbull, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.5: July 1775, Cambridge Common, Massachusetts: a grassy common with a great elm tree and wooden colonial houses and Harvard's brick college buildings behind, ranks of New England militiamen in homespun coats and hunting shirts with muskets assembled in uneven lines, a tall officer in a blue and buff uniform on horseback reviewing them, seen small from behind; summer haze. No legible text. Painted in the style of a late eighteenth-century oil history painting, as by John Trumbull, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.6: Night of 25 December 1776, the Delaware River: sleet and snow over a wide dark river choked with ice floes, long flat-bottomed Durham boats ferrying Continental soldiers in ragged coats and tricorn hats, horses and small cannon, men poling and pushing ice aside, a commander standing in one boat seen from behind and small; lanterns, the far shore wooded and dim. Cold blue-grey light. Painted in the style of a late eighteenth-century oil history painting, as by John Trumbull, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.7: Winter 1777-78, Valley Forge, Pennsylvania: rows of rough log huts with mud-chinked walls and smoking chimneys on snowy rolling hills, soldiers in tattered coats and blankets gathering firewood and drilling in lines under an officer in a Prussian-style uniform, a stone farmhouse headquarters in the distance by a creek. Bleak grey sky, figures small, no bodies. Painted in the style of a late eighteenth-century oil history painting, as by John Trumbull, many small figures. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-washington.11: December 1799, Mount Vernon: the white wooden mansion with its long columned piazza overlooking the Potomac in a light snowfall at dusk, a single lit upstairs window, a physician's horse tethered at the door, enslaved workers and household members standing quietly on the lawn, seen from a distance; bare trees and a grey river. Quiet, mournful mood. Painted as an early nineteenth-century American hand-coloured engraving. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.0: 1774, Albemarle County, Virginia: a wooden plantation house on a gentle hill with brick chimneys, rolling green piedmont fields and woods, the Blue Ridge mountains hazy behind; a woman in a long gown and cap carrying an infant on the porch and a few farmhands at a split-rail fence, seen from a distance. Late summer light. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.1: 1801, Washington: the unfinished federal city, a muddy avenue through fields and stumps, the sandstone President's House standing white and almost alone, a young man in a dark coat and riding boots carrying a leather portfolio walking toward its door, seen small from behind; the Capitol's one completed wing on a distant hill, the Potomac beyond. No legible text. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.2: 1803, Pittsburgh at the meeting of the Allegheny and Monongahela rivers: a frontier town of log and brick houses with smoking chimneys, a long wooden keelboat with a single mast on the riverbank being finished by boatbuilders, crates and barrels loaded aboard, a few men in buckskin and tricorn hats pushing off onto the low Ohio River; wooded hills, late summer haze. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.3: May 1804, Camp Dubois on the Illinois bank opposite the mouth of the Missouri: a small log hut camp in spring woods, a keelboat with a square sail and two pirogues setting off upriver on the muddy Missouri, men in buckskin and army coats poling and rowing, a few settlers waving from the bank; cottonwoods and rain clouds clearing. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.4: Winter 1804, Fort Mandan on the upper Missouri: a triangular log fort with a palisade on a snowy riverbank, nearby earth-lodge villages of the Mandan and Hidatsa with round domed lodges and smoke rising, people in buffalo robes crossing the frozen river, a young Shoshone woman with a cradleboard and a man in a capote walking toward the fort, seen small. Pale cold sky. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.5: June 1805, the Great Falls of the Missouri: a wide river plunging over a long series of rocky cascades with clouds of spray and a rainbow, open prairie stretching flat on both sides, a few men in buckskin hauling dugout canoes on crude wooden wheels across the dry grassland, buffalo grazing far off. Bright summer light. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.6: August 1805, Lemhi Pass on the Continental Divide: a high grassy saddle between rounded mountains, a small party in buckskin standing at the crest seen from behind, gazing west at range after range of snowy peaks; below, a Shoshone camp of hide tipis with a herd of horses, mounted Shoshone riders approaching. Clear thin air, golden late summer light. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.8: July 1806, the Two Medicine River in Montana: a cottonwood grove on a riverbend beneath bluffs, a small camp with three or four horses at dawn, figures of explorers and Blackfeet riders seen far off in a tense confrontation, a few horses galloping away across the open plain; the Rocky Mountains along the horizon. Restrained, distant, no bodies or wounds shown. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-na-lewis.9: September 1806, St. Louis: a French colonial river town of stone and vertical-log houses with steep roofs and galleries on a bluff above the Mississippi, townspeople in early nineteenth-century dress crowding the landing to cheer as weather-beaten dugout canoes with men in worn buckskin come ashore; a few flatboats, autumn sun. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
