tour.life-na-lewis.10: October 1809, Grinder's Stand on the Natchez Trace, Tennessee: a lonely log inn with two cabins joined by a dogtrot under a stone chimney, a single horse tethered outside, a narrow sunken trail winding through dark autumn forest at dusk; a faint lamp glowing in one window. Melancholy and quiet, no figures up close, no violence or weapons shown. Painted in the style of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour of the American West, as by Karl Bodmer, soft greens and greys. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.0: 1928, Rosario, Argentina: a broad avenue of Italianate apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies near the Paraná river, a 1920s motor car and a horse-drawn cart passing, a young couple in late-1920s clothes carrying a swaddled baby out of a doorway, seen small from behind; plane trees, grain silos and river steamers in the distance. Soft winter light, no legible text. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.1: 1952, Machu Picchu: the terraced Inca ruins on a narrow ridge among steep green peaks wrapped in drifting cloud, Huayna Picchu rising behind, two young travellers in rumpled jackets with rucksacks, seen small from behind, sitting on a stone wall looking out; a few llamas grazing on the terraces. No tourist crowds, no modern signage, no legible text. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.2: 1953, Buenos Aires: the neoclassical columned faculty of medicine building on a wide avenue, students in dark suits and a few in white coats on the steps, early 1950s cars and a green trolleybus passing, a young man with a rucksack walking toward a railway station, seen small from behind; jacaranda trees, bright spring afternoon. No legible text. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.4: 1955, Mexico City: a modest apartment building on a quiet street in the Colonia Tabacalera, a few young men in shirtsleeves gathered talking on an iron balcony at night, seen from the street below, lamplight in the windows; 1950s cars parked under jacaranda trees, the dome of the Monument to the Revolution looming nearby. Figures small, no faces as subject, no legible text. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.5: December 1956, the Sierra Maestra in eastern Cuba: a small band of bearded men in olive drab with rifles and packs climbing a steep jungle trail through dense forest and ferns, seen small from behind, a peasant guide in a straw hat leading them; misty mountain ridges, royal palms, a thatched bohío in a clearing below. Restrained mood, no combat shown. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.6: December 1958, Santa Clara, Cuba: a low colonial town with pastel houses and a church tower, an armoured train derailed on the tracks at the edge of town, rebels in olive drab moving cautiously along a street, townspeople watching from doorways, smoke rising in the distance. Seen from a rooftop, figures small, no casualties shown. Painted as a 1950s documentary watercolour, muted greens and ochres. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.7: 1959, Havana: the massive stone ramparts of La Cabaña fortress on the hill across the harbour mouth, the Morro lighthouse beside it, bearded rebel soldiers in olive drab walking along the battlements, seen small; across the blue channel the Malecón and the city's skyline with 1950s cars along the seafront. Bright tropical light, no violence shown. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.8: December 1964, New York: the slab tower of the United Nations Secretariat and the low curved General Assembly building beside the East River, a row of flags along First Avenue, a few delegates in dark overcoats walking in, inside glimpsed through the glass a vast blue-and-gold hall with a distant figure in olive-green fatigues at the rostrum. Grey winter afternoon, no legible text. Painted as a mid-twentieth-century documentary watercolour, muted tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sam-guevara.9: 1965, the western shore of Lake Tanganyika in eastern Congo: a remote camp in steep forested hills above the vast lake, a few Cuban and Congolese fighters in mixed uniforms gathered around a radio and maps under a thatched shelter, boats on the shore below, mountains across the water hazy in heat. Weary mood, figures small, no combat shown, no legible text. Painted as a 1960s documentary watercolour, muted earth tones. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.0: 1861, Calamba, Laguna: a spacious bahay na bato family house with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storey with capiz-shell sliding windows, beside a church and a plaza; rice and sugarcane fields stretch to Laguna de Bay, Mount Makiling rising behind. Townspeople in barong and baro't saya gather at the door, a nursemaid with an infant on the balcony, seen from a distance. Soft June light. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.1: 1872, Intramuros, Manila: a narrow street inside the old stone walls, the arcaded Ateneo Municipal school building with a church beside it, schoolboys in white shirts and dark trousers hurrying in through a gateway, a calesa horse cart passing, friars in brown habits walking under umbrellas. Morning tropical sun, figures small, no legible text. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.2: 1882, Madrid: a wide boulevard on a crisp winter day, the neoclassical façade of the Central University on Calle San Bernardo, students in dark frock coats and capes walking in, a slight young Filipino student with books under his arm seen small from behind, horse-drawn trams and gas lamps along the street. No legible text. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.3: 1886, Heidelberg: the red sandstone castle ruins on a wooded hillside above the Neckar river and the old stone bridge, a university eye clinic building in the town below, a young doctor in a dark frock coat walking along the riverbank under blossoming trees, seen small from behind; students in caps, rowing boats on the river, spring light. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.4: 1887, Berlin: a small print shop in a courtyard workshop, a hand-fed iron printing press and stacks of freshly printed sheets drying on lines, a few printers in aprons and a young man in a dark suit checking pages at a table, seen from behind; tall windows onto a grey Berlin street with gas lamps. No legible text on the pages. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.5: 1888, London: the great domed circular Reading Room of the British Museum, rows of long desks radiating from the centre, readers bent over books under green lamps, a small young man in a dark suit at one desk seen from behind copying from an old leather-bound volume; soft light falling from the high glass dome. No legible text. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.6: 1891, Ghent: a narrow canal lined with tall stepped-gable guild houses, barges moored, a modest printing house where a young man in a worn overcoat carries a bundle of printed sheets out the door, seen small from behind; medieval church towers under a grey Flemish sky. Thrifty, solitary mood, no legible text. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.7: 1891, Hong Kong: a street of colonial arcaded buildings climbing toward Victoria Peak, a small doctor's clinic on an upper floor with open shutters, Chinese and Filipino patients waiting on the veranda, rickshaws and sedan chairs in the street below, the harbour crowded with junks and steamships. Humid bright light, figures small, no legible signboards. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.8: c. 1893, Dapitan on Mindanao: a small settlement of nipa-thatched houses on stilts by a beach, a simple schoolhouse where barefoot boys sit with a teacher under a tree, a clinic hut and a hand-dug water system, coconut palms and a calm blue bay, a Spanish church in the distance. Peaceful, tropical light, figures small. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-sea-rizal.9: 30 December 1896, Bagumbayan field in Manila: an open grassy field by the sea at dawn, a large crowd of townspeople held back behind a line of Spanish and native soldiers in white uniforms and straw hats, a lone figure in a black suit standing small and far off facing Manila Bay; the walls of Intramuros and the sunrise over the city. Solemn, no shooting or body shown. Painted as a late nineteenth-century Filipino academic oil painting in the manner of Félix Resurrección Hidalgo, soft natural light, muted palette. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.0: 1254, Venice: a merchant's Venetian-Byzantine house with pointed arched windows rising straight from a canal, gondolas and cargo boats unloading bales at the water gate, merchants in long robes and caps on a wooden quay, a woman in a veil holding an infant at an upper balcony seen from a distance; the domes of San Marco and a busy lagoon behind. No Renaissance palazzi, no gondola cabins. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.1: 1271, Acre: the crusader port city with massive sea walls, towers and a crowded harbour of galleys and round ships, a small group of Venetian merchants in tunics and caps, one a youth, seen from behind receiving sealed letters from a cleric in robes at the gate of a stone church; Templar knights in white mantles, Arab traders, palm trees. No legible text. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.2: c. 1272, Hormuz on the Persian Gulf: a hot flat island port with low whitewashed houses and wind towers, dhows with stitched planks and palm-fibre sails moored at the shore, merchants unloading spices and horses; a small party of Venetians in tunics, seen from behind, inspects a flimsy ship, then turns toward a camel caravan heading inland to brown mountains. Glaring sun. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.3: c. 1273, Kashgar: an oasis town of mud-brick walls, flat roofs and orchards at the foot of snowy mountains, a camel caravan with Venetian travellers in dusty cloaks winding through the gate, Turkic townspeople in felt hats and long coats at a bazaar of melons, cotton and carpets, poplar trees along irrigation channels. No later blue-tiled mosques. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.5: c. 1285, Hangzhou (Quinsai): the West Lake ringed by hills and pagodas, pleasure boats with painted cabins on the water, a stone-arched bridge and a long causeway lined with willows, crowds of townspeople in Song and Yuan-period robes, a few Mongol officials on horseback, a European traveller in a tunic and cap seen small from behind on the causeway. Spring mist. Painted in Yuan-dynasty court painting style like Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.6: 1291, Zaitun (Quanzhou): a great harbour where a fleet of fourteen large four-masted junks with battened sails is preparing to sail, porters loading crates and bales, a princess's covered sedan chair escorted by Mongol officials in fur-trimmed robes down to the wharf, three Venetians seen small from behind; stone bridges, temples and warehouses along the shore. Painted in Yuan-dynasty court painting style like Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.7: 1292, the north coast of Sumatra: a fortified camp of timber stockades and palm-thatched huts on a beach where large Chinese junks lie at anchor waiting for the monsoon, sailors and soldiers in Yuan dress fishing and building, local people in sarongs trading from outrigger canoes; dense rainforest, heavy tropical clouds. Figures small. Painted in Yuan-dynasty court painting style like Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.8: c. 1293, Tabriz: a great Ilkhanid city of brick domes, caravanserais and bazaars beneath mountains, a royal Mongol encampment of tents outside the walls where a veiled princess on horseback is received by courtiers in Mongol robes and Persian turbans; three Venetian travellers stand small among the crowd, seen from behind. No Ottoman-style minarets. Painted in the style of an Ilkhanid Persian manuscript painting, as in the illustrated Jami al-Tawarikh, ink and colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.9: 1295, Venice: three weary travellers in worn Tatar-style robes, seen small from behind, knock at the water gate of a Venetian-Byzantine merchant house on a canal while surprised relatives and servants peer from arched windows; boats on the canal, onlookers on a wooden bridge, the lagoon glittering in afternoon light. No Renaissance palazzi, no Rialto stone bridge. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.10: 1298, Genoa: inside a stone prison hall with a vaulted ceiling and a barred window looking onto a harbour of galleys, a few captives in tunics, one seated dictating with gestures while another writes on parchment at a rough table, seen from a distance; light falling through the window. No legible text. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-marco-polo.11: 1324, Venice: a quiet chamber in a merchant house at dusk, a priest and family members gathered by a curtained bed, seen from behind and at a distance; through a pointed arched window, the canal with gondolas and the bell towers of Venice in soft evening light; a small chest of eastern treasures and a Tatar paiza tablet on a table. Calm, elegiac mood, no legible text. Painted in the style of a fourteenth-century Venetian manuscript illumination, as in the Livre des merveilles, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.1: 1326, Mecca: the sanctuary of the Great Mosque with the black-draped Kaaba at its centre within a colonnaded courtyard, pilgrims in white ihram garments circling, a traveller in a white turban seen from behind among them, the surrounding flat-roofed houses and bare rocky hills; night with lamps and a crescent moon. No modern towers, no Ottoman domes. Painted in the style of a Maqamat manuscript illustration of al-Wasiti, flat colours, gold background. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.2: c. 1331, Kilwa on the Swahili coast: a coral-stone town on an island with a great domed mosque and a cliff-top palace, dhows with lateen sails in the turquoise harbour, Swahili merchants in white robes and turbans trading ivory and gold, a North African traveller seen from behind stepping ashore; coconut palms and baobabs. Bright tropical light. Painted in the style of a Maqamat manuscript illustration of al-Wasiti, flat colours, gold background. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.3: c. 1332, Constantinople: the land walls and domes of the city with Hagia Sophia on its hill, a grand procession of Byzantine nobles in silk robes coming out to greet a princess arriving with a caravan of Turkic riders and wagons from the steppe; a traveller in a turban seen small from behind among the escort. Golden light, no Ottoman minarets. Painted in the style of a Maqamat manuscript illustration of al-Wasiti, flat colours, gold background. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.4: 1334, Delhi: the vast audience hall of Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq in the fortified city with sloping stone walls, courtiers and soldiers lined up in ranks, elephants with caparisons, a traveller in a North African turban and robe seen from behind bowing far down the hall before a distant throne under a canopy; gifts of robes and gold presented. No Mughal domes or marble. Painted as a Persian miniature-style manuscript illustration, flat colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.5: 1343, the Maldives: a small low island of white sand and coconut palms in a turquoise lagoon, a coral-stone mosque with a thatched roof, islanders in simple wraps carrying cowrie shells and coir rope, a traveller in a turban seated as a judge under a palm shelter hearing a case, seen from a distance; outrigger boats at the shore. Painted as a Persian miniature-style manuscript illustration, flat colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.7: 1348, Damascus: the Umayyad Mosque's courtyard and minarets in the walled city, a great crowd of Muslims, Christians and Jews in procession with bare feet carrying holy books toward the mosque to pray against the plague, a traveller in a turban seen from behind at the edge; empty streets, a grey heavy sky. No bodies shown, no legible text. Painted in the style of a medieval Islamic manuscript miniature, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.8: c. 1350, Granada: the hill of the Alhambra with its red fortress walls and towers above a city of white houses and gardens, the snowy Sierra Nevada behind; a traveller in a North African turban and cloak on horseback, seen from behind, rides up a cypress-lined path with an escort. Clear spring light, no later Renaissance palace of Charles V. Painted in the style of a medieval Islamic manuscript miniature, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.10: 1355, Fez: a courtyard of a Marinid madrasa with carved cedar, zellij tiles and a central fountain, a scholar sitting cross-legged writing on paper while an older traveller in a white turban recounts his journeys beside him, seen from a distance; a few students and a court official listening, the green-roofed city beyond. No legible text. Painted in the style of a medieval Islamic manuscript miniature, bright colours and gold. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-ibn-battuta.11: c. 1369, Tangier: a quiet hillside cemetery above the whitewashed town and its minaret, a small modest whitewashed tomb under a fig tree, a few mourners in white cloaks seen from behind; the blue Strait of Gibraltar and the distant Spanish coast at sunset. Peaceful, elegiac mood, no legible text. Painted in the style of a Maqamat manuscript illustration of al-Wasiti, flat colours, gold background. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-genghis-khan.0: c. 1162, the Onon River valley in Mongolia: a small camp of a few round felt gers beside a winding river in a wide green valley with forested hills, a woman in a long deel holding a newborn wrapped in felt at the door, horses and sheep grazing, smoke rising from the gers, a lonely, humble camp under a vast sky. Figures small, no faces as subject. Painted in Yuan-dynasty handscroll style like Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-genghis-khan.2: 1209, Zhongxing, capital of Western Xia: the walled city with Buddhist pagodas and tiled palace roofs on the plain beside the Yellow River, a Mongol army of horsemen camped around it, a breached dyke flooding the plain; a delegation of Tangut officials in robes leaving the gate with tribute of camels and a veiled princess on horseback. Distant panoramic view, no gore. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll in the manner of Liu Guandao's steppe horsemen, ink and colour on silk. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
tour.life-genghis-khan.7: 1221, the Indus River near Attock: Mongol cavalry in fur hats and lamellar armour line a high riverbank above a broad, fast-flowing river, while far below a lone horseman in a turban plunges his horse into the water and swims for the far shore; rocky hills, dust, distant scattered troops, no bodies or gore. Painted in the style of an Ilkhanid Persian manuscript painting, as in the illustrated Jami al-Tawarikh, ink and colour. One single unified scene, no panels or insets.
